```{=html}
    <a class="report-id" href="#ZTTHV02P294A">ZTTHV02P294A</a>
    <div class="sira-source-line" lang="en" dir="ltr"><span class="source-label">Source:</span> <a href="../references.html#ref-ZTTH" class="source-link"><span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Khaythamah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Tārīkh al-kabīr al-safar al-thālith</span></a>, vol. 2 pp. 294-63</div>
  </header>
  <div class="witness-text">
    حدثنا أبي قال حدثنا يعقوب بن إبراهيم قال حدثنا أبي عن ابن إسحاق قال حدثني العلاء بن عبد الرحمن بن يعقوب مولى الحرقة قال كان جدي يعقوب مكاتبا لمالك بن أوس بن الحدثان النصري وكانت أمه مولاة لرجل من الحرقة من جهينة فولدت له أبي عبد الرحمن وجدي مكاتبا فعتق بعتاقة أمه فدخل به الخرقي بعد ما عتق جدي على عثمان بن عفان يسأله له اللحق في الديوان ابن أوس بن الحدثان فقال مولاي قد أعتق أبوه فحراقي ولاؤه فاختصما إلى عثمان فقضى به للحرقي فنحن اليوم موالي الحرقة. <span class="page-no" title="end of page 294 of vol. 2">§</span> <span class="page-no" title="end of page 63 of vol. 3">§</span>
```

```{=html}
  </header>
  <div class="witness-text">
    حدثنا يعقوب حدثنا أبي عن ابن إسحاق حدثني حكيم بن حكيم بن عباد بن حنيف عن محمد بن مسلم بن عبيد الله بن شهاب عن علي بن حسين عن أبيه عن جده علي بن أبي طالب قال دخل علي رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وعلى فاطمة من الليل فأيقظنا للصلاة قال ثم رجع إلى بيته فصلى هويا من الليل قال فلم يسمع لنا حسا قال فرجع إلينا فأيقظنا وقال قوما فصليا قال فجلست وأنا أعرك عيني وأقول إنا والله ما نصلي إلا ما كتب لنا إنما أنفسنا بيد الله فإذا شاء أن يبعثنا بعثنا. قال فولى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وهو يقول ويضرب بيده على فخذه ما نصلي إلا ما كتب لنا ما نصلي إلا ما كتب لنا <a href="https://quran.com/18/54" class="quran" title="Qurʾān 18.54" target="_blank">وكان الإنسان أكثر شيء جدلا</a>
  </div>
</article>
```

```{=html}
  <div class="witness-text">
```

#### <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">أم سلمة</span>


```{=html}

  <header class="sira-report-header" lang="en" dir="ltr">

    <a class="report-id" href="#HBHXV44P210A">HBHXV44P210A</a>

  </header>
  <div class="witness-text">
    حدثنا يعقوب قال حدثني أبي عن ابن إسحاق قال حدثني أبو عبيدة بن عبد الله بن زمعة عن أمه زينب ابنة أبي سلمة وعن أبيه عبد الله بن زمعة عن أم سلمة زوج النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قالت كانت ليلتي التي يصير إلي فيها رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فذكر معنى حديث ابن أبي عدي قال <span class="page-no" title="end of page 210 of vol. 44">§</span> ابو عبيدة أولا يشد لك هذا من الأثر إفاضة رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم من يومه ذلك قبل أن يمسي حدثنا يعقوب قال حدثنا أبي عن ابن إسحاق قال حدثني محمد بن جعفر بن الزبير عن يزيد بن رومان عن خالد مولى الزبير بن نوفل قال حدثتني زينب ابنة أبي سلمة عن أمها أم سلمة هذا الحديث <span class="page-no" title="end of page 211 of vol. 44">§</span> <span class="page-no" title="end of page 55 of vol. 5">§</span>
  </div>
</article>
```

#### <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">رائطة امرأة عبد الله بن مسعود</span>


```{=html}
<article class="sira-report" id="HBHXV25P494A" lang="ar" dir="rtl">
  <header class="sira-report-header" lang="en" dir="ltr">
    <span class="report-label">Passage</span>
    <a class="report-id" href="#HBHXV25P494A">HBHXV25P494A</a>
    <div class="sira-source-line" lang="en" dir="ltr"><span class="source-label">Source:</span> <a href="../references.html#ref-HBHX" class="source-link"><span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Ḥanbal</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad</span></a>, vol. 25 p. 494</div>
  </header>
  <div class="witness-text">
    حدثنا يعقوب حدثنا أبي عن ابن إسحاق قال حدثني هشام بن عروة عن أبيه عن عبيد الله بن عبد الله بن عتبة عن رائطة امرأة عبد الله بن مسعود وأم ولده وكانت امرأة صناع اليد قال فكانت تنفق عليه وعلى ولده من صنعتها قالت فقلت لعبد الله بن مسعود لقد شغلتني أنت وولدك عن الصدقة فما أستطيع أن أتصدق معكم بشيء فقال لها عبد الله والله ما أحب إن لم يكن في ذلك أجر أن تفعلي فأتت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فقالت يا رسول الله إني امرأة ذات صنعة أبيع منها وليس لي ولا لولدي ولا لزوجي نفقة غيرها وقد شغلوني عن الصدقة فما أستطيع أن أتصدق بشيء فهل لي من أجر فيما أنفقت قال فقال لها رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أنفقي عليهم فإن لك في ذلك أجر ما أنفقت عليهم
  </div>
</article>
```

#### <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">سلمى مولاة رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم</span>


::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Parallel passages: `HBHXV43P360A`

```{=html}
<section class="sira-variant-scroll" lang="ar" dir="rtl" aria-label="Variant group">
<div class="sira-variant-inner">

<article class="sira-report sira-variant-card" id="HBHXV43P360A" lang="ar" dir="rtl">
  <header class="sira-report-header" lang="en" dir="ltr">
    <span class="report-label">Variant</span>
    <a class="report-id" href="#HBHXV43P360A">HBHXV43P360A</a>
    <div class="sira-source-line" lang="en" dir="ltr"><span class="source-label">Source:</span> <a href="../references.html#ref-HBHX" class="source-link"><span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Ḥanbal</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad</span></a>, vol. 43 p. 360</div>
  </header>
  <div class="witness-text">
    <span class="variant-id">VAR_TDSHV04P306A</span> <span class="variant-id">VAR_HYGHV01P150A</span> حدثنا يعقوب قال حدثنا أبي عن ابن إسحاق قال حدثني هشام بن عروة عن أبيه عن عائشة زوج النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قالت أتت سلمى مولاة رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أو امرأة أبي رافع مولى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم إلى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم تستأذنه على أبي رافع قد ضربها قالت قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم لأبي رافع ما لك ولها يا أبا رافع قال تؤذيني يا رسول الله فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم بم آذيتيه يا سلمى قالت يا رسول الله ما آذيته بشيء ولكنه أحدث وهو يصلي فقلت له يا أبا رافع إن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قد أمر المسلمين إذا خرج من أحدهم الريح أن يتوضأ فقام فضربني فجعل رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يضحك ويقول يا أبا رافع إنها لم تأمرك إلا بخير
  </div>
</article>


<article class="sira-report sira-variant-card" id="TDSHV04P306A" lang="ar" dir="rtl">
```

```{=html}
    <div class="sira-source-line" lang="en" dir="ltr"><span class="source-label">Source:</span> <a href="../references.html#ref-HBHX" class="source-link"><span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Ḥanbal</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad</span></a>, vol. 43 pp. 332-333</div>
  </header>
  <div class="witness-text">
    <span class="variant-id">VAR_MNMQV01P215A</span> حدثنا يعقوب قال حدثنا أبي عن ابن إسحاق قال حدثني محمد بن إبراهيم بن الحارث التيمي عن أبي سلمة بن عبد الرحمن بن عوف <span class="page-no" title="end of page 332 of vol. 43">§</span> عن عائشة زوج النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قالت كان الناس يصلون في مسجد رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم في رمضان بالليل أوزاعا يكون مع الرجل الشيء من القرآن فيكون معه النفر الخمسة أو الستة أو أقل من ذلك أو أكثر يصلون بصلاته قالت فأمرني رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ليلة من ذلك أن أنصب له حصيرا على باب حجرتي ففعلت فخرج إليه رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم بعد أن صلى العشاء الآخرة قالت فاجتمع إليه من في المسجد فصلى بهم رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ليلا طويلا ثم انصرف رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فدخل وترك الحصير على حاله فلما أصبح الناس تحدثوا بصلاة رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم بمن كان معه في المسجد تلك الليلة قالت وأمسى المسجد راجا بالناس فصلى بهم رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم العشاء الآخرة ثم دخل بيته وثبت الناس قالت فقال لي رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ما شأن الناس يا عائشة قالت فقلت له يا رسول الله سمع الناس بصلاتك البارحة بمن كان في المسجد فحشدوا لذلك لتصلي بهم قالت فقال اطو عنا حصيرك يا عائشة قالت ففعلت وبات رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم غير غافل وثبت الناس مكانهم حتى خرج رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم إلى الصبح <span class="page-no" title="end of page 333 of vol. 43">§</span> فقالت فقال أيها الناس أما والله ما بت والحمد لله ليلتي هذه غافلا وما خفي علي مكانكم ولكني تخوفت أن يفترض عليكم فاكلفوا من الأعمال ما تطيقون فإن الله لا يمل حتى تملوا قال وكانت عائشة تقول إن أحب الأعمال إلى الله أدومها وإن قل. : HBHXV43P332A deals with Muḥammad praying in ʿĀʾishah&#x27;s house. Might also be placed in ritual after *hijrah*.
  </div>
</article>

    <span class="variant-id">VAR_HBHXV43P332A</span> حدثنا عبيد الله بن سعد ثنا عمي ثنا أبي عن ابن إسحاق حدثني محمد بن إبراهيم بن الحارث التيمي عن أبي سلمة عن عائشة رضي الله عنها قالت كان الناس يصلون في مسجد رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم في رمضان بالليل أوزاعا يكون مع الرجل الشيء من القرآن فيكون معه النفر الخمسة أو الستة وأقل من ذلك وأكثر يصلون بصلاته قالت فأمرني رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ليلة من ذاك أن أنصب له حصيرا على باب حجرتي ففعلت فخرج رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم بعد أن صلى العشاء الآخرة فاجتمع إليه من في المسجد فصلى بهم رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ليلا طويلا ثم انصرف فدخل وتركت الحصير على حاله فلما أصبح الناس تحدثوا بصلاة رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم بمن كان في المسجد تلك الليلة فأمسى المسجد زاخا بالناس فصلى بهم رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم صلاة العشاء الآخرة ثم دخل بيته وثبت الناس فقال لي رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ما شأن الناس فقلت له سمع الناس بصلاتك البارحة بمن كان في المسجد فحشدوا لذلك لتصلي بهم قال اطوي عنا حصيرك يا عائشة ففعلت فبات رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم غير غافل وثبت الناس مكانهم حتى خرج إليهم إلى الصبح فقال أيها الناس أما والله ما بت والحمد لله ليلتي غافلا ما خفي علي مكانكم ولكني تخوفت أن يفرض عليكم اكلفوا من العمل ما تطيقون فإن الله لا يمل حتى تملوا. <span class="page-no" title="end of page 215 of vol. 1">§</span> <span class="page-no" title="end of page 1914 of vol. 4">§</span>
```

```{=html}
    <div class="sira-source-line" lang="en" dir="ltr"><span class="source-label">Source:</span> <a href="../references.html#ref-BRSX" class="source-link"><span class='ref-author'>Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Istīʿāb fī maʿrifat al-aṣḥāb</span></a>, vol. 4 p. 1913</div>
  </header>
  <div class="witness-text">
    وقيل مسيكة مولاة عبد الله بن أبي بن سلول فيها نزلت ولا تكرهوا فتياتكم على البغاء إن أردن تحصنا لتبتغوا عرض الحياة الدنيا وكان ابن أبي يكرهها على ذلك فتأبى وتمتنع منه لإسلامها هكذا قال الزهري هي معاذة وقال الأعمش عن أبي سفيان عن جابر اسمها مسيكة والصحيح ما قاله ابن شهاب إن شاء الله تعالى ذكر إبراهيم ابن سعد عن ابن إسحاق قال حدثني محمد بن مسلم بن شهاب الزهري قال كانت معاذة مولاة عبد الله بن أبي بن سلول امرأة مسلمة فاضلة وكانت تأبى عليه مما يدعوها إليه قال ثم إن معاذة عتقت فكانت فيما بلغني ممن بايع النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم بيعة النساء فتزوجها بعد ذلك سهل بن قرظة أخو بني عمرو بن عوف فولدت له عبد الله بن سهل وأم سعيد بنت سهل ثم هلك عنها أو فارقها فتزوجها الحمير بن عدي القاري أخو بني خطمة فولدت له توأما الحارث بن الحمير وعدي بن الحمير وأم سعد بنت الحمير <span class="page-no" title="end of page 1913 of vol. 4">§</span> ثم فارقها فتزوجها عامر بن عدي رجل من بني خطمة فولدت له أم حبيبة بنت عامر قال وكانت معاذة بنت عبد الله بن جبير بن الضرير بن أمية بن خدارة ابن الحارث بن الخزرج قال أبو عمر قول ابن شهاب هذا يدل على أن الأوس والخزرج كان يسبي بعضهم بعضا في الجاهلية ويملكون ما يسبون كسائر ما كانت العرب تصنعه.
  </div>
</article>
```

Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 43) to P043H.
[^comment-RZZIV03P425A-1]: This passage is most similar to one found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P240C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 240), although there are significant differences and this version does not have the last line found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī). It also does not seem to appear elsewhere in the corpus. According to <a href="../references.html#ref-ZTTH" class="source-ref">ZTTHV01P386A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Khaythamah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Tārīkh al-kabīr al-safar al-thālith</span>, vol. 1 p. 386) there is a mistake in the <em>isnād</em> and Ibn Isḥāq&#x27;s name was dropped between Ibn Saʿd and Ibn Shihāb.

Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 240) and a more detailed passage is also found in <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. [^comment-ZTTHV01P168B-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-ZTTH" class="source-ref">ZTTHV01P168B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Khaythamah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Tārīkh al-kabīr al-safar al-thālith</span>, vol. 1 p. 168) is a continuation of <a href="../references.html#ref-ZTTH" class="source-ref">ZTTHV01P167A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Khaythamah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Tārīkh al-kabīr al-safar al-thālith</span>, vol. 1 p. 167) that lists <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī) as the witness. This passage is located in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) beginning on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P251E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 251), and provides a list on the names of those who submitted through the efforts of Abū Bakr, although the tribal names are truncated in <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī), and <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) inserts more narrative. There are also a few differences in the people listed or in how their names are rendered. <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P251E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 251) gives the name as Ṭalḥah b. ʿUbayd Allāh b. ʿUthmān not Ṭalḥah b. ʿAbd Allāh. <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P253D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 253) and <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P253E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 253) list Qudāmah and ʿAbd Allāh b. Maẓʿūn b. Ḥabīb, as the brothers of ʿUthmān b. Maẓʿan. Only ʿUthmān is listed in <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī). <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P256G</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 256) gives a different tribal designation for ʿĀmir b. Rabīʿah. <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P258B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 258) lists Fāṭimah <em>bint</em> al-Mujallil as the wife of Ḥāṭib b. al-Ḥārith, not as Asmāʾ <em>bint</em> al-Mujallil, as in <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī). <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P259H</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 259) gives the name as Umaynah <em>bint</em> Khalaf and not Humaymah <em>bint</em> Khalaf. This appears to be the only instance, besides <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī), where the list of those early submitters is provided in this form. <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī) includes a similar list but formatted differently and includes other name variations.
[^comment-ZTKXV01P386D-1]: Passage occurs in the biography of ʿĀmir b. Rabīʿah and is also found in the same form in <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī). ʿĀmir b. Rabīʿah is mentioned as an ally of the Āl al-Khaṭṭāb in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on several occasions: in reference to those who submitted at the invitation of Abū Bakr (<a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P256A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 256)), those who were among the first to migrate to Abyssinia (<a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P322A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 322)--also see <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī)), among those who participated in the Raid of ʿAbd Allāh b. Jaḥsh (<a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P602A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 602)), and in the list of submitters present at Badr (<a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P684B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 684)). He is also listed in <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī) as among the first to arrive in Madīnah. Placement will be inserted in each of the places listed in other witnesses.
[^comment-ZTKXV02P744A-1]: This passage is a common name clarification entry. Placement is based on location of first reference to Ṣuhayb b. Sinān in the text, which is the reference to his submission at the invitation of Abū Bakr. It is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām.
[^comment-ZTTHV01P170A-1]: Passage is smilar to that found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P262D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 262) although the text is phrased differently.
[^comment-ZTKXV01P402D-1]: This passage, a longer version of <a href="../references.html#ref-ZTTH" class="source-ref">ZTTHV02P086D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Khaythamah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Tārīkh al-kabīr al-safar al-thālith</span>, vol. 2 p. 86), gives the name as ʿIyāḍ b. Ḥimād al-Majāshiʿī, although his name is normally given as ʿIyāḍ b. Ḥimār al-Majāshiʿī. He is not located in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. The passage, not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām, is set in the context of Muḥammad&#x27;s preaching in Mecca prior to the migration. This tradition, although not attributed to Ibn Isḥāq, is also found in the <em>Saḥīḥ Muslim</em> (Book 40, 6853). The speech is reminiscent of the presentation Jaʿfar b. Abī Ṭālib made to the Negus when they first migrated to Abyssinia (see <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P334C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 334)), in its tone but not in its exact phrasing. It is clearly situated in the Meccan period, between the beginning of public preaching in 613 but before the Year of Sorrow in 619, with it most likely being toward the earlier end or the period. <a href="../references.html#ref-IHJS" class="source-ref">IHJSV01P022A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Ḥāzim</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Jawāmiʿ al-sīrah wa khams risāʾil akhrā li-Ibn Ḥazm</span>, vol. 1 p. 22) states that Muḥammad referred to ʿIyāḍ b. Ḥimār as “Ḥaramī” because the Quraysh “were among the Ḥums and the <em>Banū</em> Mujāshaʿ were from the <em>Ḥillah</em>.” This refers to the pre-Islamic Quraysh religious movement, known as the Ḥums, that developed, according to Ibn Isḥāq (see <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P199A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 199)) around the time of Muḥammad’s birth. The Quraysh drew a distinction between themselves, who are from the <em>Ḥaram</em>, and the people, or “<em>ḥillah</em>,” who were required to abandon their impure clothing prior to doing <em>tawaf</em> or to burn them once they were done. Muḥammad implied that ʿIyāḍ was so pious that it was as if he were from the <em>Ḥaram</em>. The occasion of the first meeting between ʿIyāḍ and Muḥammad occurred when ʿIyād attempted to give Muḥammad a camel as a gift, which Muḥammad refused unless ʿIyāḍ submitted, which he did (see <a href="../references.html#ref-NSHX" class="source-ref">NSHXV03P311A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Mālik b. Muḥammad b. Ibrāhīm al-Nīsābūrī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Sharaf al-muṣṭafā</span>, vol. 3 p. 311)). The passage is placed provisionally around the first pigrimage season after the beginning of public preaching (approximate to <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P270A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 270)) as this sets the context for such a meeting.
[^comment-ZTTHV02P086D-1]: The fragment contains a reference to ʿIyāḍ b. Ḥimār al-Majāshiʿī. He is not mentioned in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. but he is quoted by <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) in other texts. The passages in this complex are not found elsewhere. ʿIyāḍ b. Ḥimār b. Abī Ḥimār b. Nājīyah b. ʿAqāl b. Muḥammad b. Sufyān b. Mujāshaʿ b. Dārim al-Majāshiʿī al-Dārimī al-Baṣrī was a companion who related material to al-Ḥasan al-Basrī. He was widely reputed to be an ascetic (<em>mutaqashshif</em>) (<a href="../references.html#ref-RZJX" class="source-ref">RZJXV06P407D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Jarḥ waʾl-taʿdīl</span>, vol. 6 p. 407) and see <a href="../references.html#ref-BNTH" class="source-ref">BNTHV03P308B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Ḥibbān</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Thiqāt</span>, vol. 3 p. 308)). In addition to being cited in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī), he is also quoted by <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī), but not in al-Ṭabarī&#x27;s <em>Tārīkh al-rusul waʾl-mulūk</em>.
[^comment-HBHXV11P609A-1]: This section is similar to the text located in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) found in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P289A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 289).
[^comment-TRJXV01P582A-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-TRJX" class="source-ref">TRJXV01P582A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Muʿāfāʾ</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Jalīs al-ṣāliḥ al-kāfī waʾl-anīs al-nāṣiḥ al-shāfī</span>, vol. 1 p. 582) is similar to the passage found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) beginning on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P293C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 293) with some important differences.
[^comment-DYSAV01P128A-1]: Placement is based on content. This passage is found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām but is similar to <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P305D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 305) to p. 037D that discusses Dhū al-Qarnayn in the context of Qurʾān 18:83-85. Also see <a href="../references.html#ref-KTHB" class="source-ref">KTHBV09P301A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Kathīr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Bidāyat waʾl-nihāyah</span>, vol. 9 p. 301) for a similar account from Ibn Isḥāq quoted without a witness. For Ibn Isḥāq&#x27;s commentary on Qurʾān 18:83 via <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī), see <a href="../references.html#ref-TBJX" class="source-ref">TBJXV15P371A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Ṭabarī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Jāmiʿ al-bayān ʿan tāʾwīl āy al-Qurʾān</span>, vol. 15 p. 371), <a href="../references.html#ref-TBJX" class="source-ref">TBJXV15P389A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Ṭabarī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Jāmiʿ al-bayān ʿan tāʾwīl āy al-Qurʾān</span>, vol. 15 p. 389), <a href="../references.html#ref-TBJX" class="source-ref">TBJXV15P390A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Ṭabarī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Jāmiʿ al-bayān ʿan tāʾwīl āy al-Qurʾān</span>, vol. 15 p. 390), <a href="../references.html#ref-RZTX" class="source-ref">RZTXV09P2876A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Tafsīr al-Qurʾān al-ʿaẓīm</span>, vol. 9 p. 2876). For commentary via the witness of <a href="WYSAU.html" class="witness-link">WYSAU</a> (Yaḥyā b. Saʿīd b. Abān al-Qurashī al-Umawī al-Kūfī), see <a href="../references.html#ref-BYTX" class="source-ref">BYTXV06P193A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Muḥammad b. Ibrāhīm al-Thaʿlabī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Al-Kashf waʾl-bayān ʿan tafsīr al-Qurʾān</span>, vol. 6 p. 193), <a href="../references.html#ref-WHWX" class="source-ref">WHWXV03P166A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAlī b. Aḥmad b. Muḥammad al-Wāḥidī al-Nīsābūrī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Wasīṭ fī tafsīr al-Qurʾān al-majīd</span>, vol. 3 p. 166). Without a witness, see <a href="../references.html#ref-MKHX" class="source-ref">MKHXV06P4320A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Makkī b. Ḥammūsh b. Muḥammad al-Andalusī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Al-Hidāyah ilā bulūgh al-nihāyah</span>, vol. 6 p. 4320), <a href="../references.html#ref-MKHX" class="source-ref">MKHXV06P4465A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Makkī b. Ḥammūsh b. Muḥammad al-Andalusī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Al-Hidāyah ilā bulūgh al-nihāyah</span>, vol. 6 p. 4465), <a href="../references.html#ref-MATB" class="source-ref">MATBV03P337A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Māwardī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Tafsīr al-Māwardī</span>, vol. 3 p. 337), <a href="../references.html#ref-JHQX" class="source-ref">JHQXV11P045A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Qurṭubī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Jāmiʿ li-aḥkām al-Qurʾān</span>, vol. 11 p. 45) to p. 53A. For references to the story of Dhū al-Qarnayn witnessed by <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī), see <a href="../references.html#ref-BKHT" class="source-ref">BKHTV01P535A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Muḥammad b. Ismāʿīl b. Ibrāhīm al-Bukhārī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Takhrīj al-aḥādith al-marfūʿat al-musnadah fī kitāb al-tārīkh al-kabīr</span>, vol. 1 p. 535), <a href="../references.html#ref-BKHB" class="source-ref">BKHBV01P225A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Muḥammad b. Ismāʿīl b. Ibrāhīm al-Bukhārī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh al-kabīr</span>, vol. 1 p. 225), <a href="../references.html#ref-RNXX" class="source-ref">RNXXV01P270A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Suhaylī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Rawḍ al-unuf fī sharḥ al-Sīrah al-Nabawīyah li-Ibn Hishām</span>, vol. 1 p. 270); for <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī), see <a href="../references.html#ref-SBIA" class="source-ref">SBIAV04P1451A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Abū al-Shaykh al-Iṣbahānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-ʿAẓmah</span>, vol. 4 p. 1451), <a href="../references.html#ref-SBIA" class="source-ref">SBIAV04P1479A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Abū al-Shaykh al-Iṣbahānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-ʿAẓmah</span>, vol. 4 p. 1479), <a href="../references.html#ref-TDSH" class="source-ref">TDSHV17P332A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn ʿAsākir</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh madīnat Dimashq</span>, vol. 17 p. 332), <a href="../references.html#ref-TDSH" class="source-ref">TDSHV42P324A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn ʿAsākir</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh madīnat Dimashq</span>, vol. 42 p. 324). This appears to be the only intsance of a transmission from Wahb b. Munabbih b. Ḥazn al-Anṣārī in the <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī) corpus, as of this writing.
[^comment-HBFXV01P118A-1]: This passage is analogous to a text found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P318B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 318).
[^comment-HBFXV01P237A-1]: This passage is not found elsewhere in the corpus. Placement deals with a discussion of Abū Bakr and the freeing of Bilāl. Placement is based on content.
[^comment-SHKMV01P100A-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Provisional placement due to content and relation to the Bilāl story.
[^comment-HBFXV01P095A-1]: This collection of variations are analogous to a passage found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P319C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 319).
[^comment-HBHXV43P342A-1]: Sahlah <em>bint</em> Suhayl is mentioned three times in the redaction of Ibn Hishām (<a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P322A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 322) as one of the first to migrate to Abyssinia, vol. 1, 365A as one of the first to return from Abyssinia, and vol. 2, 368H where she is mentioned again as one of the returnees from Abyssinia (for this reference, see <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī) and <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī)). She is also mentioned in <a href="WMSAH.html" class="witness-link">WMSAH</a> (Muḥammad b. Salamah b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Bāhilī al-Ḥarrānī), <a href="WASKA.html" class="witness-link">WASKA</a> (ʿAbdah (ʿAbd al-Raḥmān) b. Sulaymān al-Kilābī al-Kūfī), <a href="WAHWA.html" class="witness-link">WAHWA</a> (ʿAlāʾ b. Hārūn al-Wāsiṭī), and <a href="WHAYA.html" class="witness-link">WHAYA</a> (Yazīd b. Hārūn al-Wāsiṭī) but in different contexts. This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām but appears to be an aside common in Ibn Isḥāq. Placement is based on her first mention.
[^comment-ZTKXV01P386D-1]: Passage occurs in the biography of ʿĀmir b. Rabīʿah and is also found in the same form in <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī). ʿĀmir b. Rabīʿah is mentioned as an ally of the Āl al-Khaṭṭāb in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on several occasions: in reference to those who submitted at the invitation of Abū Bakr (<a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P256A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 256)), those who were among the first to migrate to Abyssinia (<a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P322B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 322)--also see <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī)), among those who participated in the Raid of ʿAbd Allāh b. Jaḥsh (<a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P602A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 602)), and in the list of submitters present at Badr (<a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P684B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 684)). He is also listed in <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī) as among the first to arrive in Madīnah. Placement will be inserted in each of the places listed in other witnesses.
[^comment-ZTTHV01P190A-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-ZTTH" class="source-ref">ZTTHV01P190A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Khaythamah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Tārīkh al-kabīr al-safar al-thālith</span>, vol. 1 p. 190) refers to Abū Sabrah b. Abī Ruhm b. ʿAbd al-ʿUzzā. He is mentioned by <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P322C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 322) and vol. 1, 329A as one of the first migrants to Abyssinia, vol. 1, 368A as one of those who returned from Abyssinia, vol. 1, 479A as one of the migrants to Madīnah, and vol. 1, 685B as one of the participants at the Battle of Badr. Placement is based on reference to migration to Abyssinia in reference to vol. 1, 322A. He is also mentioned in this context by <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī) and <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī).
[^comment-TKXXV04P025A-1]: The actual passage in <a href="../references.html#ref-TKXX" class="source-ref">TKXXV04P025A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Saʿd</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Ṭabaqāt al-kubrā</span>, vol. 4 p. 25) is: &quot;وقال محمد بن عمر وهاجر جعفر إلى أرض الحبشة في الهجرة الثانية ومعه امرأته أسماء بنت عميس وولدت له هناك عبد الله وعونا ومحمدا فلم يزل بأرض الحبشة حتى هاجر رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم إلى المدينة ثم قدم عليه جعفر من أرض الحبشة وهو بخيبر سنة سبع وكذلك قال محمد بن اسحاق,&quot; which suggests that Ibn Isḥāq said the same thing, or something similar to, al-Wāqidī. It is a summary passage that may have been created by Muḥammad b. Saʿd and may not reflect the actual text of Ibn Isḥāq. The passage up to &quot;وولدت له&quot; follows <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P323B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 323) exactly. Jaʿfar&#x27;s return from Abyssinia is mentioned on vol. 2, 359A in a form similar to that found here, and he is described as receiving a share of the spoils from Khaybar on vol. 2, 351A, although not in the same form as in <a href="../references.html#ref-TKXX" class="source-ref">TKXXV04P025A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Saʿd</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Ṭabaqāt al-kubrā</span>, vol. 4 p. 25). It should be noted that the redaction of Ibn Hishām places Jaʿfar&#x27;s return from Abyssinia after the story of Khaybar so it is not clear if Ibn Isḥāq understood this to happen before or after the events at Khaybar. <a href="../references.html#ref-TBRC" class="source-ref">TBRCV11P494A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Ṭabarī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh al-rusul waʾl-mulūk</span>, vol. 11 p. 494) to <a href="../references.html#ref-TBRC" class="source-ref">TBRCV11P495A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Ṭabarī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh al-rusul waʾl-mulūk</span>, vol. 11 p. 495) quotes the passage &quot;فلم يزل بأرض الحبشه حتى هاجر رسول الله ص الى المدينة ثم قدم عليه من ارض الحبشه وهو بخيبر سنه سبع&quot; as coming from al-Wāqidī, but does not provide an <em>isnād</em>. <a href="../references.html#ref-MZTX" class="source-ref">MZTXV05P051A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Mizzī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Tahdhīb al-kamāl fī asmāʾ al-rijāl</span>, vol. 5 p. 51) quotes the entire passage as found in Ibn Saʿd’s <em>Ṭabaqāt</em> but does not provide a source. I have included in the reconstruction only that portion of the passage that can reasonably be attributed to Ibn Isḥāq.
[^comment-TKXXV04P076A-1]: The quotation found on <a href="../references.html#ref-TKXX" class="source-ref">TKXXV04P076A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Saʿd</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Ṭabaqāt al-kubrā</span>, vol. 4 p. 76) does not mention ʿAmr b. Saʿīd b. al-ʿĀṣ directly. I have added the name of the subject of the biographical passage from which it is taken for the sake of clarity. He is mentioned by <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P323C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 323) in the context of the flight to Abyssinia.
[^comment-TKXXV04P087A-1]: Muʿayqīb b. Abī Fāṭimah is mentioned by <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P323I</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 323) in the context of the flight to Abyssinia. Also note, <a href="../references.html#ref-TKXX" class="source-ref">TKXXV04P087A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Saʿd</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Ṭabaqāt al-kubrā</span>, vol. 4 p. 87) may include non-Ibn Isḥāq material and it has been left unredacted to preserve the original passage.
[^comment-TKXXV04P090A-1]: al-Aswad b. Nawfal is mentioned by <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P324F</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 324) in the context of the flight to Abyssinia. Also note, <a href="../references.html#ref-TKXX" class="source-ref">TKXXV04P090A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Saʿd</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Ṭabaqāt al-kubrā</span>, vol. 4 p. 90) includes non-Ibn Isḥāq material and it has been left unreadcted to preserve the original passage. There are no references to Umm Layth in the redaction of Ibn Hishām.
[^comment-TKXXV04P091A-1]: Abū al-Rūm b. ʿUmayr b. [^comment-TKXXV04P096A-1]: ʿAyyāsh b. Abī Rabīʿah follows Salamah b. Hishām in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P327A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 327). The passage on <a href="../references.html#ref-TKXX" class="source-ref">TKXXV04P096A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Saʿd</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Ṭabaqāt al-kubrā</span>, vol. 4 p. 96) does not appear on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P327A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 327) where reference to to Asmāʾ <em>bint</em> Salamah and their children is not mentioned. Asmāʾ <em>bint</em> Salamah is not mentioned in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Reference to Muḥammad b. ʿUmar is not redacted for the sake of clarity and to preserve the passage as it appears in Ibn Saʿd’s <em>Ṭabaqāt</em>.
[^comment-ZTTHV01P189G-1]: ʿAyyāsh b. Abī Rabīʿah is mentioned in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P327C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 327) in the context of the flight to Abyssinia.
[^comment-TKXXV04P153B-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-TKXX" class="source-ref">TKXXV04P153B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Saʿd</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Ṭabaqāt al-kubrā</span>, vol. 4 p. 153) is quoted in the context of the biography of Nabīh b. ʿUthmān, who Muḥammad b. ʿUmar claimed migrated to Abyssinia. The redaction of Ibn Hishām does not mention Nabīh b. ʿUthmān. Placement is based on this statement found on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P328B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 328).
[^comment-TDSHV12P094A-1]: Ḥajjāj b. al-Ḥārith is not mentioned in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. According to <a href="../references.html#ref-TDSH" class="source-ref">TDSHV12P095A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn ʿAsākir</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh madīnat Dimashq</span>, vol. 12 p. 95), in the witness of Muḥammad b. Salamah, Ibn Isḥāq places Ḥajjāj b. al-Ḥārith at the Battle of Ajnādayn during the conquest of Syria (c. 13/634). These appear to be the only two references made to Ḥajjāj b. al-Ḥārith in the Ibn Isḥāq corpus.

Idrīs b. The passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Placement at the end of the <em>Isrāʾ</em> section.
[^comment-HBHXV27P317A-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-HBHX" class="source-ref">HBHXV27P317A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Ḥanbal</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad</span>, vol. 27 p. 317) is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. It is similar to a passage in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P398B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 398) set in the aftermath of the night journey when Abū Bakr defends the prophet against those who don&#x27;t believe the story. <a href="../references.html#ref-ZZBX" class="source-ref">ZZBXV08P370A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Abū Bakr Aḥmad b. ʿAmr al-Bazzār</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad al-Bazzār</span>, vol. 8 p. 370) places a similar account witnessed from Ibn Isḥāq by Yaʿlā b. ʿUbayd as a part of Abū Bakr&#x27;s defense.
[^comment-HBHXV18P256A-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-BYTX" class="source-ref">BYTXV06P308A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Muḥammad b. Ibrāhīm al-Thaʿlabī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Al-Kashf waʾl-bayān ʿan tafsīr al-Qurʾān</span>, vol. 6 p. 308) suggests the passage is apocalyptic in nature. <a href="../references.html#ref-KTHQ" class="source-ref">KTHQV05P373A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Kathīr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Tafsīr al-Qurʾān al-ʿAẓīm</span>, vol. 5 p. 373) places the passage during the <em>Isrāʾ</em> just prior to the meeting of Jesus. Passage in not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām but if it is part of the <em>Isrāʾ</em> it should be placed around <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV1P405A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 405). A similar passage is also found in <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī) in several places and <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-SMJX" class="source-ref">SMJXV02P1363A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Mājah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Sunan Ibn Majāh</span>, vol. 2 p. 1363), <a href="../references.html#ref-MYWX" class="source-ref">MYWXV02P377A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Abū Yaʿlā Aḥmad b. ʿAlī al-Mawṣilī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad</span>, vol. 2 p. 377), <a href="../references.html#ref-NSSX" class="source-ref">NSSXV02P268B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Abū ʿAbd Allāh al-Ḥākim al-Nīsābūrī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Mustadrak ʿalā al-ṣaḥīḥīn</span>, vol. 2 p. 268), <a href="../references.html#ref-NSSX" class="source-ref">NSSXV04P535B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Abū ʿAbd Allāh al-Ḥākim al-Nīsābūrī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Mustadrak ʿalā al-ṣaḥīḥīn</span>, vol. 4 p. 535), <a href="../references.html#ref-MZSH" class="source-ref">MZSHV03P450F</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Mizzī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Tuḥfat al-ashrāf bi-maʿrifat al-aṭrāf</span>, vol. 3 p. 450), <a href="../references.html#ref-KTHQ" class="source-ref">KTHQV05P373B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Kathīr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Tafsīr al-Qurʾān al-ʿAẓīm</span>, vol. 5 p. 373), and <a href="../references.html#ref-AAMZ" class="source-ref">AAMZV04P199C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Abī Bakr b. Ismāʿīl al-Būṣīrī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Miṣbāḥ al-zujājah fī zawāʾid Ibn Mājah</span>, vol. 4 p. 199).

Abī ʿĪsā al-Shāmī) in reference to Qurʾān 51:54-56 and by <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) and <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī) but not quoted in al-Ṭabarī&#x27;s <em>Tārīkh al-rusul waʾl-mulūk</em>. This appears to be an alternative story about the command to fight the Quryash. ʿIyāḍ b. Ḥimār al-Mujāshiʿī is not mentioned elsewhere in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. al-Mujāshiʿī (d. ?) was a Baṣran who related traditions to several important <em>ḥadīth</em> enthusiasts, including al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī (<a href="../references.html#ref-MZTX" class="source-ref">MZTXV22P565B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Mizzī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Tahdhīb al-kamāl fī asmāʾ al-rijāl</span>, vol. 22 p. 565)). Rabīʿah is mentioned as an ally of the Āl al-Khaṭṭāb in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on several occasions: in reference to those who submitted at the invitation of Abū Bakr (<a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P256A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī)), among those who were the first to migrate to Madīnah (vol. 1, 470B--also see <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī)) among those who participated in the Raid of ʿAbd Allāh b. Jaḥsh (vol. 1, 601F to 602A), and in the list of submitters present at Badr (vol. 1, 684B). Placement will be inserted in each of the places listed in other witnesses.

Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 470). The final passage following the last poem is not in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. <a href="../references.html#ref-BBKH" class="source-ref">BBKHV03P295A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Muḥammad b. Isḥāq b. al-ʿAbbās al-Makkī al-Fākihī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Akhbār makkah fī qadīm al-dahr wa-ḥadīthih</span>, vol. 3 p. 295) appears to be the only witnessed version of the event in the Ibn Isḥāq corpus besides <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī), although it is mentioned in several non-witnessed accounts attributed to Ibn Isḥāq.
[^comment-ZTTHV02P042A-1]: A similar passage is found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P474E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 474). This refers to the migration of ʿUmar b. al-Khaṭṭāb and ʿAyyāsh b. Abī Rabīʿah, and refers to a &quot;longer account&quot; about efforts of Abū Jamīl b. Hishām and his brother al-Ḥārith to disuade ʿAyyāsh. In <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī), the account is longer and refers to Abū Jahl not Abū Jamīl. <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī) has a much longer account more similar to <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī).
[^comment-NYMXV04P2227A-1]: Unlike <a href="../references.html#ref-ZTTH" class="source-ref">ZTTHV02P042A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Khaythamah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Tārīkh al-kabīr al-safar al-thālith</span>, vol. 2 p. 42), which refers to Abū Jamīl, <a href="../references.html#ref-NYMX" class="source-ref">NYMXV04P2227A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Abū Nuʿaym</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Maʿrifat al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 4 p. 2227) refers to Abū Jahl as do <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) and <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī).

Oddly, this fragment is not otherwise extant in the corpus.

Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 488).
[^comment-BKHBV08P240A-1]: A similar passage is found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P494A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Wāhib used to chop up wooden images and gave them to Umm Khulthūm as fire wood before the beginning of submission. A similar passage is also found in <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī). This story does not seem to be extant in <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī). Might also be placed in biography section.
[^comment-ZTTHV01P366A-1]: A similar passage is found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P494D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 494) and describes the prophet&#x27;s first week in Madīnah. <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P494B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 494) forms a part of this passage. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī) and <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī)) is different from that found in <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī), <a href="WBSAB.html" class="witness-link">WBSAB</a> (Bakr b. Sulaymān al-Aswārī al-Baṣrī), <a href="WJHZA.html" class="witness-link">WJHZA</a> (Jarīr b. Ḥāzim b. Zayd b. ʿAbd Allāh b. [^comment-HBHXV37P465A-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-HBHX" class="source-ref">HBHXV37P464A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Ḥanbal</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad</span>, vol. 37 p. 464) indicates that the dispute in which Sahl b. Saʿd was involed dealt with the location of the first <em>masjid</em>. This seems to refer to <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P494D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 494) and story of the those who invited Muḥammad to settle with different clans in Madīnah. One of those was the <em>Banī</em> Sāʿidah, of which Sahl was a member. It appears that Ibn Isḥāq is stating that Sahl was only of those involved in the dispute.
[^comment-HBHXV18P265A-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-KTHS" class="source-ref">KTHSV02P312A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Kathīr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrat al-nubuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 312) places this statement after the <em>hijrah</em> just after the completion of the Prophet&#x27;s <em>masjid</em> in Madīnah. This passage is not in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Placement provisional to accord with the middle of the narrative found in Ibn Hishām on vol. 1, 497.
[^comment-ZTTHV01P368A-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Placement provisional based on content.

Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 496) and describes th building of the Prophet&#x27;s <em>masjid</em> upon his arrival in Madīnah. This fragment is located in longer accounts also found in <a href="WBSAB.html" class="witness-link">WBSAB</a> (Bakr b. Sulaymān al-Aswārī al-Baṣrī), <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Ḥāzim b. Zayd b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Shajāʿ al-Azdī al-ʿAtkī al-Baṣrī).
[^comment-HBHXV38P221A-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. It is usually attributed to ʿUrwah b. al-Zubayr and not to ʿUmar b. ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUrwah, as it is in the Ibn Isḥāq corpus (see, as an example, <a href="../references.html#ref-HYMZ" class="source-ref">HYMZV01P011E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Nūr al-Dīn ʿAlī b. Abī Bakr Haythamī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Majmaʿ al-zawāʾid wa-manbaʿ al-fawāʾid</span>, vol. 1 p. 11) and <a href="../references.html#ref-SYDX" class="source-ref">SYDXV06P203G</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Suyūṭī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Durr al-manthūr</span>, vol. 6 p. 203)), although <a href="../references.html#ref-ZZBX" class="source-ref">ZZBXV10P448A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Abū Bakr Aḥmad b. ʿAmr al-Bazzār</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad al-Bazzār</span>, vol. 10 p. 448) to p. 454A gives the <em>isnād</em> as Khālid b. Yūsuf from his father Yūsuf b. Khālid, from Jaʿfar b. Saʿd b. Samurah, from Khubayb b. Sulaymān, from his father Sulaymān b. Samurah, that he read from his father that it originated from Samurah b. Jundub. <a href="../references.html#ref-RJSB" class="source-ref">RJSBV03P173C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Rajab</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Fatḥ al-bāri sharḥ Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī</span>, vol. 3 p. 173) quotes Aḥmad b. Ḥanbal from Ibn Isḥāq, but without a witness. None of the sources place the passage in a historical context. It is obviously post migration, but when is not clear. It is placed after the building of the prophet&#x27;s <em>masjid</em> since this seems like a logical place, although it is clear from Ibn Hishām&#x27;s redaction, in the discussion of the initial entry into Madīnah, that prayer rooms in houses were already common.
[^comment-BKHBV06P167A-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-BKHB" class="source-ref">BKHBV06P167A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Muḥammad b. Ismāʿīl b. Ibrāhīm al-Bukhārī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh al-kabīr</span>, vol. 6 p. 167) refers to عمر بن عبد الله بن عروة بن الزبير بن العوام القرشي الأسدي. This seems to be a reference and not necessarily a quotation. ʿUmar b. ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUrwah is not among the authorities cited by Ibn Isḥāq in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī). He is cited in <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī) and <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī). This is inserted in the first reference to ʿUmar b. ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUrwah as an aside. All searches for ʿUmar b. ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUrwah in the corpus completed.

[^comment-ZTKXV01P118A-1]: This is a name clarification and may not be an actual quotation from any Ibn Isḥāq1 work. He is mentioned in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P505C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 505) as Abū Dharr Barīr b. Junādah al-Ghifārī. In <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī) he is also listed on <a href="../references.html#ref-ZTKX" class="source-ref">ZTKXV02P677B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Khaythamah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Tārīkh al-kabīr sifr al-thānī</span>, vol. 2 p. 677) as Abū Dharr Yazīd b. Ḥumādah al-Ghifārī. This appears to be the only instance in the entire pre-modern corpus that the name is rendered as Abū Dharr Barr. Passage will be placed beneath the first reference to the full name in <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī).

Saʿd’s teacher and one of the major sources for Ibn Saʿd’s <em>Ṭabaqāt</em>. I have left the short quotation in the passage for clarity&#x27;s sake.

Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 508) dealing with the prior modes of summoning people to prayer. [^comment-SBDAV01P093F-1]: The <em>isnād</em> after Ibn Isḥāq is: حدثنا أحمد بن محمد البغدادي حدثنا عبيد الله بن سعد حدثنا عمي حدثني أبي عن. The source for this passage, Samurah b. Jundub, only transmits one tradition in the redaction of Ibn Hishām, vol. 2, 96A. The context of the questions from the Rabbis fits with the type of comment Ibn Isḥāq used when quoting Samurah in p. 096A.
[^comment-ZTTHV01P376A-1]: A similar passage is found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P515C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 515) in the section detailing the Rabbis who opposed the prophet.
[^comment-TDSHV29P103B-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām although parts of the fragment are found in various parts of Ibn Hishām&#x27;s redaction and commentary. Reference to the renaming of ʿAbd Allāh b. Salām is found on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P515C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 515). The renaming of ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. ʿAwf is discussed on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P631B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 631). There is no mention of the phrase &quot;ʿAbd Allāh <em>zād</em> Ḥanbal&quot; in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) or elsewhere in the corpus. The phrase is strange and it is not clear what it means. &quot;<em>zād</em>,&quot; if taken from the root &quot;زيد&quot; means to &quot;increase&quot; or &quot;to be more sufficient.&quot; &quot;Ḥanbal,&quot; as a noun, refers to a wornout fur coat.&quot; ʿAbd Allāh b. Salām&#x27;s original name, &quot;al-Ḥuṣayn,&quot; means &quot;fox.&quot; It might be a play on words, meaning the name &quot;ʿAbd Allāh&quot; is better than a wornout fox fur coat. <a href="../references.html#ref-TDSH" class="source-ref">TDSHV58P313A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn ʿAsākir</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh madīnat Dimashq</span>, vol. 58 p. 313) compares <em>zād</em> Ḥanbal to <em>burnus</em>, a type of long woolen cloak. The passage is odd in that ʿAbd Allāh b. Salām was originally one of the Rabbis who opposed the Prophet and ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. ʿAwf was one of the earliest submitters in Mecca. Why these are set together is not clear. Placement provisional to be placed following the discussion of the renaming of ʿAbd Allāh b. Salām at <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P515B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 515).

Placement of passage is based on al-Ṭabarī&#x27;s comment.
[^comment-SBDAV01P094B-1]: The <em>isnād</em> after Ibn Isḥāq is حدثنا أحمد بن محمد البغدادي حدثنا عبيد الله بن سعد حدثنا عمي حدثني أبي عن. <a href="../references.html#ref-ARKH" class="source-ref">ARKHV01P201A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. ʿAlī al-Rāzī al-Khaṣāṣ al-Ḥanafī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Aḥkām al-Qurʾān</span>, vol. 1 p. 201) discusses a tradition similar to this that is also related by Anas. In the discussion, Aḥmad b. ʿAlī al-Rāzī al-Khaṣāṣ says that it refers to the revelation of Qurʾān 2:179: وَلَكُمْ فِي الْقِصَاصِ حَيَاةٌ يَا أُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ.

[^comment-BRWXV14P400A-1]: This passage is in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Appears to tell the backstory for the issue that led to the confrontation with the <em>Banū</em> Qurayẓah.Should be placed just prior to <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P566D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 566) although there is a roughly analogous story in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on vol. 1, 540 that is part of the preamble to the story of the attack on the Qurayẓah. For similar passages see <a href="WMSAH.html" class="witness-link">WMSAH</a> (Muḥammad b. Salamah b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Bāhilī al-Ḥarrānī).
[^comment-NSKXV06P330A-1]: A similar passage is found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P566D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 566) in the section dealing with Qurʾān verse regarding the <em>Banū</em> Qurayẓah. For an analogous passage also see <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī). A passage touching on the same subject but written differently is also found in <a href="WMSAH.html" class="witness-link">WMSAH</a> (Muḥammad b. Salamah b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Bāhilī al-Ḥarrānī).
[^comment-NSKXV09P257A-1]: Passage is not in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Qurʾān 112 is mentioned in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P571G</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 571) in the context of questions the prophet received from members of the Jewish community. It is then followed by an aside about how to act when reciving Qurʾān 112:001. Similar passages are found in <a href="WIMTR.html" class="witness-link">WIMTR</a> (Ibrāhīm b. al-Mukhtār al-Tamīmī al-Rāzī), <a href="WSABZ.html" class="witness-link">WSABZ</a> (Saʿīd b. Bazīʿ), and <a href="WYWAT.html" class="witness-link">WYWAT</a> (Yaḥyā b. Wāḍiḥ al-Anṣārī Abū Tumaylah). <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī) discusses the verse in a way analogous to <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P572B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 572). <a href="WSABZ.html" class="witness-link">WSABZ</a> (Saʿīd b. Bazīʿ) also contains a passage that treats the verse in yet another form not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām as does <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī). Placement is based on content and similar asides that are found on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P571G</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 571).

Placement is based on content and the beginning of ritual practices, in this instance, treating the issue of ablutions for every prayer and its abrogation (approximate to <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P584D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 584)). Of this tradition, Muḥammad b. ʿĪsā b. Sawrah al-Tirmidhī states: وقد روى هذا الحديث محمد بن إسحاق عن محمد بن إبراهيم عن أبي سلمة عن زيد بن خالد عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم وحديث أبي سلمة عن أبي هريرة وزيد بن خالد عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم كلاهما عندي صحيح لأنه قد روي من غير وجه عن أبي هريرة عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم هذا الحديث وحديث أبي هريرة إنما صح لأنه قد روي من غير وجه وأما محمد فزعم أن حديث أبي سلمة عن زيد بن خالد أصح وفي الباب عن أبي بكر الصديق وعلي وعائشة وابن عباس وحذيفة وزيد بن خالد وأنس وعبد الله بن عمرو وابن عمر وأم حبيبة وأبي أمامة وأبي أيوب وتمام بن عباس، وعبد الله بن حنظلة وأم سلمة وواثلة وأبي موسى (see <a href="../references.html#ref-TMSX" class="source-ref">TMSXV01P034B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Tirmidhī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Sunan al-Tirmidhī</span>, vol. 1 p. 34)). This passage is one of the most frequently related traditions in the Ibn Isḥāq corpus with 88 witnessed variations across 13 witnesses. The largest collection of variations are in <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī). Also see <a href="WAKMW.html" class="witness-link">WAKMW</a> (Aḥmad b. Khālid b. Mūsā al-Wahbī al-Kindī) (VAR_<a href="../references.html#ref-STBX" class="source-ref">STBXV05P243F</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Ṭabarānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Muʿjam al-kabīr</span>, vol. 5 p. 243), <a href="../references.html#ref-DRKN" class="source-ref">DRKNV01P126B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Dāraquṭnī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Kitāb al-nuzūl</span>, vol. 1 p. 126), <a href="../references.html#ref-TJJX" class="source-ref">TJJXV01P455B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ḥamzah b.
