[^comment-BKHBV06P462B-1]: This passage is cited in the biography of ʿAṭāʾ, a <em>mawlā</em> of Umm Ṣabīyyah.
[^comment-ZZBXV02P121B-1]: Aḥmad b. ʿAmr al-Bazzār, in his <em>al-Baḥr al-zakhkhār al-maʻrūf bi-Musnad al-Bazzār</em>, follows this with the comment: واللفظ لفظ سعيد بن بزيع وهذا الحديث قد روي عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم من وجوه لا نعلمه يروى عن علي عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم إلا من هذا الوجه بهذا الإسناد.
[^comment-THQXV01P070C-1]: According to <a href="../references.html#ref-THQX" class="source-ref">THQXV01P071C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Muḥammad al-Ṭaḥāwī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Aḥkām al-Qurʾān al-karīm</span>, vol. 1 p. 71) and p. 71D, this traditon is also related via: حدثنا علي بن معبد قال حدثنا يعقوب قال حدثنا أبي عن ابن إسحاق قال حدثني محمد بن الحارث التيمي عن أبي سلمة بن عبد الرحمن عن زيد بن خالد عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم مثله and حدثنا علي حدثنا يعقوب قال حدثنا أبي عن ابن إسحاق قال حدثني سعيد المصري عن عطاء مولى أم صبية عن أبي هريرة عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم مثله.
[^comment-THSMV01P43A-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-THSM" class="source-ref">THSMV01P43A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Muḥammad al-Ṭaḥāwī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Sharḥ maʿānī al-āthār</span>, vol. 1 p. 43) states that this tradition is also related via: حدثنا علي بن معبد قال ثنا يعقوب بن إبراهيم قال ثنا أبي عن أبي إسحاق عن محمد بن إبراهيم بن الحارث التميمي عن أبي سلمة بن عبد الرحمن عن زيد بن خالد عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم مثله and حدثنا علي بن معبد قال ثنا يعقوب قال ثنا أبي عن أبي إسحاق قال حدثني سعيد المقبري عن عطاء مولى أم صبية عن أبي هريرة عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم مثله. Although the <em>isnād</em> mistakenly refers to Abī Isḥāq instead of Ibn Isḥāq.
[^comment-IMAQV01P038A-1]: Ibn al-Maḥāmilī states, in his <em>Amālī</em>, that &quot;سنده ضعيف جدا&quot;.
[^comment-MGHSV01P1031B-1]: The <em>isnād</em> mistakenly omits <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī).
[^comment-HYGHV04P352F-1]: The <em>isnād</em> mistakenly omits <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī).
[^comment-AAIBV01P290C-1]: Aḥmad b. Abī Bakr b. Ismāʿīl al-Būṣīrī goes on to say, &quot;قال وثنا روح بن عبد المؤمن المقرئ قال ثنا يعقوب بن إبراهيم بن سعد بن إبراهيم العوفي فذكره قلت ورواه الإمام أحمد بن حنبل في مسنده ثنا يعقوب بن إبراهيم فذكره وسيأتي هذا الحديث مع جملة أحاديث من هذا النوع في كتاب افتتاح الصلاة.&quot;
[^comment-ZTTHV01P377B-1]: A version of this passage is located in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P590F</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 590) that discusses the date of the <em>hijrah</em>. Also see <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī).
[^comment-ZTTHV01P377C-1]: Fragment is similar to one located in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P590F</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 590) to <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P591D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 591). This refers to the first raid undertaken by the Prophet&#x27;s community after the <em>hijrah</em>. For references to the Raid on the Abwāʾ, although not to this specific fragment, also see <a href="WSABZ.html" class="witness-link">WSABZ</a> (Saʿīd b. Bazīʿ), <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī), <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī), <a href="WBSAB.html" class="witness-link">WBSAB</a> (Bakr b. Sulaymān al-Aswārī al-Baṣrī), and <a href="WJHZA.html" class="witness-link">WJHZA</a> (Jarīr b. Ḥāzim b. Zayd b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Shajāʿ al-Azdī al-ʿAtkī al-Baṣrī).
[^comment-MDMXV01P273A-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām but is similar in context to the story of the peace with the <em>Banī</em> Damrah found on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P591D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 591). For an analogous passage but with more details via the witness of Salamah b. al-Faḍl, see <a href="../references.html#ref-MDMX" class="source-ref">MDMXV01P273A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Mandah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Maʿrifat al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 1 p. 273), <a href="../references.html#ref-THRX" class="source-ref">THRXV01P409A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn al-Athīr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Usd al-ghābah fī maʿrifat al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 1 p. 409) (Ibn al-Faḍl has been dropped from the <em>isnād</em> but includes the name of his student, al-Faḍl b. Ghanim); via witness of Bakr b. Sulaymān, see <a href="../references.html#ref-BKHB" class="source-ref">BKHBV02P087A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Muḥammad b. Ismāʿīl b. Ibrāhīm al-Bukhārī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh al-kabīr</span>, vol. 2 p. 87); without a witness, see <a href="../references.html#ref-MDMX" class="source-ref">MDMXV01P418A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Mandah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Maʿrifat al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 1 p. 418) and <a href="../references.html#ref-HJRS" class="source-ref">HJRSV01P451A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Iṣābah fī tamyīz al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 1 p. 451).
[^comment-DWNXV04P015A-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Placement is based on content.
[^comment-NSKXV06P251A-1]: The content of the above passage suggests it is related to the marriage of ʿĀʾishah to Muḥammad. The redaction of Ibn Hishām does not describe the event. <a href="../references.html#ref-TBRC" class="source-ref">TBRCV02P398A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Ṭabarī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh al-rusul waʾl-mulūk</span>, vol. 2 p. 398) places it in <em>Shawwāl</em> of the 1AH. The placement of the passage is approximate.
[^comment-JJKXV06P259A-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-JJKX" class="source-ref">JJKXV06P259A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Jurjānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Kāmil fī ḍuʿafāʾ al-rijāl</span>, vol. 6 p. 259) varies significantly with other versions of this tradition.
[^comment-DRQLV15P067A-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-DRQL" class="source-ref">DRQLV15P067A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Dāraqutnī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-ʿIlal al-wārdah fī al-aḥādīth al-nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 15 p. 67) variues significantly with other versions of this tradition.
[^comment-ZTTHV01P378A-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-ZTTH" class="source-ref">ZTTHV01P378A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Khaythamah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Tārīkh al-kabīr al-safar al-thālith</span>, vol. 1 p. 378) appears to follow from <a href="../references.html#ref-ZTTH" class="source-ref">ZTTHV01P377E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Khaythamah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Tārīkh al-kabīr al-safar al-thālith</span>, vol. 1 p. 377) with the same <em>isnād</em> that includes <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī) to AMIB. This fragment is a shorter version of what is found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P598E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 598) to <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P599A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 599) and overlaps with the following story of the Raid on al-ʿUshayrah (sometimes rendered al-ʿUshrah or al-ʿAshrah). Also see <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī) for a more detailed account.
[^comment-WHWXV04P499A-1]: A passage similar to this fragment is also found <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P599D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 599) to <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P600A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 600) The above renders the battle name differently from the redaction of Ibn Hishām but the context and details indicates this is the correct placement. Note that the Qurʾān passages found in <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī) are not mentioned in the redaction of Ibn Hishām.
[^comment-HJRQV02P074A-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Placement is based on content.
[^comment-AFQMV01P040A-1]: A similar passage in found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P601F</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 601) in reference to the Raid of ʿAbd Allāh b. Jaḥsh in the context of the revelation of Qurʾān 2:217.
[^comment-ZTKXV01P386D-1]: Passage occurs in the biography of ʿĀmir b. Rabīʿah and is also found in the same form in <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī). ʿĀmir b. Rabīʿah is mentioned as an ally of the Āl al-Khaṭṭāb in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on several occasions: in reference to those who submitted at the invitation of Abū Bakr (<a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P256A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 256)), those who were among the first to migrate to Abyssinia (<a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P322B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 322)--also see <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī)), among those who participated in the Raid of ʿAbd Allāh b. Jaḥsh (<a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P601F</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 601) to <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P602A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 602)), and in the list of submitters present at Badr (<a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P684B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 684)). He is also listed in <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī) as among the first to arrive in Madīnah. Placement will be inserted in each of the places listed in other witnesses.
[^comment-BBKHV01P471A-1]: Context refers to the killing of ʿAmr b. al-Ḥaḍramī during the raid of ʿAbd Allāh b. Jaḥsh described in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P601F</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 601) to p. 606A. This poem is not mentioned in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. The redaction of Ibn Hishām includes one poem attributed to Abū Bakr about the raid on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P605C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 605). References to the raid are found in <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī), <a href="WZAZA.html" class="witness-link">WZAZA</a> (Zakarīyā b. Abī Zāʾidah), <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī).
[^comment-ZTTHV01P385A-1]: Portions of this fragment appear in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P606C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 606), in reference to the change of the <em>qiblah</em> to <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P606D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 606) referring to the Battle of Badr, although the phrasing is different, and <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) does not include dates in the section. No analogous fragments are found elsewhere in the corpus.
[^comment-BLJXV04P18A-1]: Similar to the passage found in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P607D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 607) but it does not include the poem and the verbiage is different.
[^comment-TKXXV04P007A-1]: This passage is similar to that found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) beginning on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P628G</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 628) and continuing to vol. 1, 629C.
[^comment-DYHJV01P024A-1]: This passage is similar to that found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) beginning on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P633B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 633).
[^comment-ZTKXV02P649A-1]: This passage is similar to that found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) beginning on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P633C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 633).
[^comment-HBHXV43P380A-1]: Similar passage found in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P638F</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 638) in the aftermath of Badr when Muḥammad orders that the dead among the attacking Quraysh be thrown into a pit, the so-called &quot;prayer of the people of the pit.&quot; In addition to <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī), the passage is also found in <a href="WBSAB.html" class="witness-link">WBSAB</a> (Bakr b. Sulaymān al-Aswārī al-Baṣrī) and <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī).
[^comment-HBHXV37P414B-1]: This passage is similar to that found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) beginning on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P642E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 642), although the above is slightly longer and contains more detail.
[^comment-NYMXV06P2967C-1]: A similar passage is located in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P645B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 645), about the disposition of prisoners after Badr. A similar fragment is mentioned in an unwitnessed passage found in <a href="../references.html#ref-STRD" class="source-ref">STRDV01P250B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Ṭabarānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Al-Rawḍ al-dānī</span>, vol. 1 p. 250), <a href="../references.html#ref-SYTH" class="source-ref">SYTHV01P309B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Sayyid al-Nās</span>, <span class='ref-title'>ʿUyūn al-athar fī funūn al-maghāzī waʾl-shamāʾil waʾl-siyar</span>, vol. 1 p. 309), <a href="../references.html#ref-KTHS" class="source-ref">KTHSV02P475B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Kathīr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrat al-nubuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 475), <a href="../references.html#ref-KTHB" class="source-ref">KTHBV03P306C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Kathīr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Bidāyat waʾl-nihāyah</span>, vol. 3 p. 306), <a href="../references.html#ref-IHMS" class="source-ref">IHMSV05P477B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Humām Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Wāḥid al-Sīwāsī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Faḥt al-qadīr</span>, vol. 5 p. 477), and <a href="../references.html#ref-HJRS" class="source-ref">HJRSV07P228F</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Iṣābah fī tamyīz al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 7 p. 228); also see <a href="WBSAB.html" class="witness-link">WBSAB</a> (Bakr b. Sulaymān al-Aswārī al-Baṣrī) <a href="../references.html#ref-KKMK" class="source-ref">KKMKV01P064B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Khalīfah b. Khayyāṭ al-Shaybānī al-ʿAṣfarī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad Khalīfah b. Khayyāṭ</span>, vol. 1 p. 64), <a href="../references.html#ref-STBX" class="source-ref">STBXV22P393B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Ṭabarānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Muʿjam al-kabīr</span>, vol. 22 p. 393), <a href="../references.html#ref-TLBX" class="source-ref">TLBXV06P2722C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn al-ʿAdīm</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Bughyat al-ṭalab fī taʾrīkh Ḥalab</span>, vol. 6 p. 2722), and <a href="../references.html#ref-TLBX" class="source-ref">TLBXV06P2803D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn al-ʿAdīm</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Bughyat al-ṭalab fī taʾrīkh Ḥalab</span>, vol. 6 p. 2803); <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-TBRB" class="source-ref">TBRBV02P460B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Ṭabarī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh al-rusul waʾl-mulūk (1967)</span>, vol. 2 p. 460); and <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-THRX" class="source-ref">THRXV06P209C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn al-Athīr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Usd al-ghābah fī maʿrifat al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 6 p. 209), <a href="../references.html#ref-DHSL" class="source-ref">DHSLV01P373E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Dhahabī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Siyar aʿlām al-nubalāʾ</span>, vol. 1 p. 373), and <a href="../references.html#ref-DHTI" class="source-ref">DHTIV02P119B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Dhahabī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh al-Islām</span>, vol. 2 p. 119).
[^comment-ZTTHV02P222A-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-ZTTH" class="source-ref">ZTTHV02P222A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Khaythamah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Tārīkh al-kabīr al-safar al-thālith</span>, vol. 2 p. 222) is placed in the events of the year 10, the same year of the Farewell Pilgrimage, in the biographical entry for Nubayh b. Wahab b. ʿUthmān b. Abī Ṭalḥah b. ʿAbd al-ʿUzzā b. ʿUthmān b. ʿAbd al-Dār b. Quṣayy. According to <a href="../references.html#ref-TKXX" class="source-ref">TKXXV05P330C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Saʿd</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Ṭabaqāt al-kubrā</span>, vol. 5 p. 330), Nubayh b. Wahab died during the civil disturbance of al-Walīd b. Yazīd b. al-Mālik, circa 125-6/743-4. Nubayh b. Wahab is only mentioned once in the redaction of Ibn Hishām (above) and is not mentioned elsewhere. Placement of this passage is based on the only reference to Nubayh b. Wahab in the Ibn Isḥāq corpus.
[^comment-TKXXV03P054A-1]: The material on <a href="../references.html#ref-TKXX" class="source-ref">TKXXV03P054A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Saʿd</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Ṭabaqāt al-kubrā</span>, vol. 3 p. 54) to p. 55A is similar to the passage on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P646C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 646) to p. 647A. The passage following &quot;بالعدسة فقتله&quot; is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām but a similar passage following the same structure as <a href="../references.html#ref-TKXX" class="source-ref">TKXXV03P054A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Saʿd</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Ṭabaqāt al-kubrā</span>, vol. 3 p. 54) is found in <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī) and <a href="WJHZA.html" class="witness-link">WJHZA</a> (Jarīr b. Ḥāzim b. Zayd b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Shajāʿ al-Azdī al-ʿAtkī al-Baṣrī). <a href="WHAYA.html" class="witness-link">WHAYA</a> (Yazīd b. Hārūn al-Wāsiṭī) includes a brief entry, similar to <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī) in <a href="../references.html#ref-ZTTH" class="source-ref">ZTTHV01P167A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Khaythamah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Tārīkh al-kabīr al-safar al-thālith</span>, vol. 1 p. 167). The passage begins with the assertion from Abū Rāfiʿ, who was enslaved by al-ʿAbbās, that they had secretly submitted in Mecca. The text does not explain why al-ʿAbbās did not reveal his submission to Muḥammad after he was captured at Badr.
[^comment-ZTTHV01P167A-1]: Similar passage found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P646C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 646) but worded differently with <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) providing more detail.
[^comment-TKXXV04P008A-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Similar passages are found in <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī), <a href="WHAYA.html" class="witness-link">WHAYA</a> (Yazīd b. Hārūn al-Wāsiṭī), and <a href="WMSAH.html" class="witness-link">WMSAH</a> (Muḥammad b. Salamah b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Bāhilī al-Ḥarrānī).
[^comment-TKXXV04P009A-1]: This passage is not found in redaction of Ibn Hishām. Guillaume (p. 310), based on <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī) in <a href="../references.html#ref-TBRC" class="source-ref">TBRCV02P463A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Ṭabarī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh al-rusul waʾl-mulūk</span>, vol. 2 p. 463), places it after <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P647A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 647). <a href="../references.html#ref-TKXX" class="source-ref">TKXXV04P009A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Saʿd</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Ṭabaqāt al-kubrā</span>, vol. 4 p. 9) and <a href="../references.html#ref-ZTKX" class="source-ref">ZTKXV01P168A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Khaythamah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Tārīkh al-kabīr sifr al-thānī</span>, vol. 1 p. 168) are similar to passages via <a href="WMSAH.html" class="witness-link">WMSAH</a> (Muḥammad b. Salamah b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Bāhilī al-Ḥarrānī) in <a href="../references.html#ref-SFMX" class="source-ref">SFMXV01P506A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Yaʿqūb b. Sufyān al-Fārisī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Maʿrifah waʾl-tārīkh</span>, vol. 1 p. 506) and <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī) in <a href="../references.html#ref-TBRC" class="source-ref">TBRCV02P463A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Ṭabarī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh al-rusul waʾl-mulūk</span>, vol. 2 p. 463). The account demonstrates the anxienty of the prophet for the wellbeing of al-ʿAbbās. Placement is based on the logical flow of the passage and on the narrative structure priovided in al-Ṭabarī’s <em>Taʾrīkh</em>, which quotes Ibn Isḥāq at length.
[^comment-TKXXV04P009B-1]: Passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām but would logically follow the passage found on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P646A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 646) to p. 647A. It recounts the freeing al-ʿAbbās after his capture Badr. For a similar passage see <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī), <a href="WHAYA.html" class="witness-link">WHAYA</a> (Yazīd b. Hārūn al-Wāsiṭī), <a href="WAIYA.html" class="witness-link">WAIYA</a> (ʿAbd Allāh b. Idrīs b. Yazīd al-Awdī al-Zaʿāfarī), and <a href="WMSAH.html" class="witness-link">WMSAH</a> (Muḥammad b. Salamah b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Bāhilī al-Ḥarrānī).
[^comment-ZTKXV01P171A-1]: This passage is found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Similar passage found in <a href="WHAYA.html" class="witness-link">WHAYA</a> (Yazīd b. Hārūn al-Wāsiṭī).
[^comment-DHRSV11P214A-1]: A similar passage is found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P648C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 648), referring to the aftermath of the Battle of Badr. A similar passage is also found in <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī) and <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī), both of which include a poem inserted between the first and second halves of the passage, missing in <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī).
[^comment-ZTKXV01P169B-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām but a section dealing with Mikraz b. Ḥafs&#x27; ransom of Suhayl b. ʿAmr is mentioned at the end of <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P648C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 648) and appears to refer to the same incident found here.
[^comment-ZTKXV01P169C-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Placement is based on reference to Suhayl b. ʿAmr and the similarity of the content found in <a href="../references.html#ref-ZTKX" class="source-ref">ZTKXV01P169B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Khaythamah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Tārīkh al-kabīr sifr al-thānī</span>, vol. 1 p. 169).
[^comment-TKXXV03P003A-1]: This is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. The placement is based on content that mentions names of those who witnessed Badr. This list of names is not mention in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. The would come after <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P677A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 677) that begins the list of names for those who wtinessed Badr.
[^comment-DRQMV02P670A-1]: Placement is based on its association with the aftermath of the Battle of Badr. Not mentioned in the redaction of Ibn Hishām but approximate to <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P649A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 649). The event mentioned at the beginning of the passage in <a href="../references.html#ref-DRQM" class="source-ref">DRQMV02P670A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Dāraquṭnī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Muʾtalif waʾl-mukhtalif</span>, vol. 2 p. 670) is cited by <a href="../references.html#ref-HHAT" class="source-ref">HHATV02P439A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Razzāq b. Hammām al-Ḥumayrī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Tafsīr</span>, vol. 2 p. 439), <a href="../references.html#ref-TBJX" class="source-ref">TBJXV17P292A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Ṭabarī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Jāmiʿ al-bayān ʿan tāʾwīl āy al-Qurʾān</span>, vol. 17 p. 292), <a href="../references.html#ref-RZTX" class="source-ref">RZTXV08P2589A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Tafsīr al-Qurʾān al-ʿaẓīm</span>, vol. 8 p. 2589), and others who cite ʿAbd al-Razzāq b. Hammām al-Ḥumayrī&#x27;s <em>Tafsīr</em> as the source, referring to Qurʾān 24:33. This event or verse is not mention in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. <a href="../references.html#ref-KTMX" class="source-ref">KTMXV01P367A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿUmar b. Shabbah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Kitāb taʾrīkh al-Madīnah al-munawwarah</span>, vol. 1 p. 367) and <a href="../references.html#ref-KTHQ" class="source-ref">KTHQV06P055A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Kathīr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Tafsīr al-Qurʾān al-ʿAẓīm</span>, vol. 6 p. 55) link this event to the Battle of Badr. While this is clearly a biographical entry, Ibn Isḥāq frequently linked events and biographical information together. Placement of <a href="../references.html#ref-DRQM" class="source-ref">DRQMV02P670A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Dāraquṭnī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Muʾtalif waʾl-mukhtalif</span>, vol. 2 p. 670) in the section on the aftermath of Badr. <a href="../references.html#ref-BRSX" class="source-ref">BRSXV04P1913C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Istīʿāb fī maʿrifat al-aṣḥāb</span>, vol. 4 p. 1913) and <a href="../references.html#ref-HJRS" class="source-ref">HJRSV08P317B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Iṣābah fī tamyīz al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 8 p. 317) as well as <a href="../references.html#ref-DRQM" class="source-ref">DRQMV02P670A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Dāraquṭnī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Muʾtalif waʾl-mukhtalif</span>, vol. 2 p. 670) will also be placed in the biographical section. Ibn Isḥāq, in <a href="../references.html#ref-BKHB" class="source-ref">BKHBV04P300A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Muḥammad b. Ismāʿīl b. Ibrāhīm al-Bukhārī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh al-kabīr</span>, vol. 4 p. 300) lists her name as &quot;أم الصهباء.&quot;
[^comment-BRSXV04P1913C-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-BRSX" class="source-ref">BRSXV04P1913C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Istīʿāb fī maʿrifat al-aṣḥāb</span>, vol. 4 p. 1913) is the biography of Muʿādhah <em>bint</em> ʿAbd Allāh.
[^comment-ZTTHV01P184A-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-ZTTH" class="source-ref">ZTTHV01P184A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Khaythamah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Tārīkh al-kabīr al-safar al-thālith</span>, vol. 1 p. 184) not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Placed here due to similarity of content with <a href="../references.html#ref-ZTKX" class="source-ref">ZTKXV01P268A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Khaythamah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Tārīkh al-kabīr sifr al-thānī</span>, vol. 1 p. 268) and <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P648C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 648) to p. 649.
[^comment-ZTKXV01P169D-1]: This passage is similar to one found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P649F</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 649) and discusses the proposed punishment for Suhayl b. Bayḍāʾ. He is mentioned as one of the participants in the flight to Abyssinia in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P322C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 322) and <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P329F</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 329). Daʿd <em>bint</em> Jaḥdam is only mentioned once in the redaction of Ibn Hishām in reference to the flight to Abyssinia on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P329F</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 329).
[^comment-HBHXV04P195A-1]: This appears to be a longer version of <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P651C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 651). A similar passage is also found in <a href="WHAYA.html" class="witness-link">WHAYA</a> (Yazīd b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 683) among the list of submitters present at Badr. He is also mentioned in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P476D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 476) as arriving is Madīnah with ʿUmar among the initial wave of emigrants.
[^comment-ZTKXV01P199A-1]: This is an identification fragment drawn from entries that begin with “<em>khā</em>.” It refers to Khawlī b. Abī Kawlī, an ally of ʿUmar who arrived in Madīnah with him in the initial wave of emigrants to the city (see <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P476D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 476)). He is also mentioned in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P683J</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 683) as one of the participants at Badr. Muḥammad b. Saʿd lists his name as Khawlī b. ʿAmr b. Zuhayr b. Khaythamah b. Abī Ḥimrān who was al-Ḥārith b. Muʿāwiyah b. al-Ḥārith b. Mālik b. ʿAwf b. Saʿd b. ʿAwf b. Ḥuraym b. Juʿfī b. Saʿd al-ʿAshīrah b. Mālik b. Add b. Madhḥaj. He was an ally of ʿUmar’s father al-Khaṭṭāb b. Nufayl b. ʿAbd al-ʿUzzā. In addition to Badr, he also participated at Uḥud, the Trench, and all of the other major battles with the prophet. He died during the caliphate of ʿUmar (c. 634-644 CE—see <a href="../references.html#ref-TKXX" class="source-ref">TKXXV03P299B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Saʿd</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Ṭabaqāt al-kubrā</span>, vol. 3 p. 299)). There are many unwitnessed references to him. He does not appear to be mentioned in any other witnessed versions.

Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-ZTKX" class="source-ref">ZTKXV01P386D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Khaythamah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Tārīkh al-kabīr sifr al-thānī</span>, vol. 1 p. 386) is more similar than that found on <a href="../references.html#ref-TDSH" class="source-ref">TDSHV25P325A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn ʿAsākir</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh madīnat Dimashq</span>, vol. 25 p. 325).

Rabīʿah and is also found in the same form in <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī). ʿĀmir b. Rabīʿah is mentioned as an ally of the Āl al-Khaṭṭāb in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on several occasions: in reference to those who submitted at the invitation of Abū Bakr (<a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P256A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 256)), those who were among the first to migrate to Abyssinia (<a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P322B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 322)--also see <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī)), among those who participated in the Raid of ʿAbd Allāh b. Jaḥsh (<a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P601F</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 601) to <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P602A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 602)), and in the list of submitters present at Badr (<a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P684C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 684)). He is also listed in <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī) as among the first to arrive in Madīnah. Placement will be inserted in each of the places listed in other witnesses.

[^comment-NYMXV02P537A-1]: This passage is similar to that found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) beginning on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P691B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 691). Also see <a href="../references.html#ref-TKXX" class="source-ref">TKXXV03P357A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Saʿd</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Ṭabaqāt al-kubrā</span>, vol. 3 p. 357) and <a href="../references.html#ref-TKXX" class="source-ref">TKXXV03P468A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Saʿd</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Ṭabaqāt al-kubrā</span>, vol. 3 p. 468), where Muḥammad b. Saʿd states: وأما موسى بن عقبة ومحمد بن اسحاق وأبو معشر فلم يذكروا الحارث بن قيس فيمن شهد عندهم بدرا ولا يشكون جميعا في روايتهم أن بن أخيه جبر بن عتيك قد شهد بدرا وغلطوا في نسبه فقالوا جبر بن عتيك بن الحارث بن قيس بن هيشة فنسبوه إلى عمه وليس كذلك هو جبر بن عتيك بن قيس بن أخي الحارث بن قيس. And <a href="../references.html#ref-TKXX" class="source-ref">TKXXV03P357A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Saʿd</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Ṭabaqāt al-kubrā</span>, vol. 3 p. 357) where Muḥammad b. Saʿd states, وأما موسى بن عقبة ومحمد بن اسحاق وأبو معشر فلم يذكروا الحارث بن قيس فيمن شهد بدرا وقال محمد بن اسحاق وأبو معشر هو جبر بن عتيك بن الحارث بن قيس بن PageV03P358 هيشة وقال محمد بن عمر وعبد الله بن محمد بن عمارة الأنصاري غلط محمد بن اسحاق وأبو معشر أو من روى عنهما في نسب جبر بن عتيك فنسباه إلى عمه الحارث وقد شهد معه عمه بدرا ونسبه كما وصفنا ومن حلفاء بني معاوية بن مالك نعمان بن عصر. Also see <a href="../references.html#ref-RWDX" class="source-ref">RWDXV05P185A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. ʿAbd Allāh Suhaylī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Rawḍ al-unuf fī sharḥ al-Sīrah al-Nabawīyah li-Ibn Hishām</span>, vol. 5 p. 185) in which al-Suhayli indicates that Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd also witnessed this tradition but does to provide the <em>matn</em>. For a similar passage via <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī), see <a href="../references.html#ref-MGHK" class="source-ref">MGHKV03P134A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Mughalṭāy b. Qalīj</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Ikmāl tahdhīb al-Kamāl fī asmāʾ al-rijāl</span>, vol. 3 p. 134); without a witness, see <a href="../references.html#ref-BRSX" class="source-ref">BRSXV01P222A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Istīʿāb fī maʿrifat al-aṣḥāb</span>, vol. 1 p. 222), <a href="../references.html#ref-THRX" class="source-ref">THRXV01P494A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn al-Athīr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Usd al-ghābah fī maʿrifat al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 1 p. 494), <a href="../references.html#ref-DHSL" class="source-ref">DHSLV03P362A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Dhahabī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Siyar aʿlām al-nubalāʾ</span>, vol. 3 p. 362), <a href="../references.html#ref-KHLW" class="source-ref">KHLWV11P023A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Khalīl b. Aybak al-Ṣafadī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Wāfī bi-l-wafiyāt</span>, vol. 11 p. 23), <a href="../references.html#ref-HJRS" class="source-ref">HJRSV01P548A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Iṣābah fī tamyīz al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 1 p. 548), <a href="../references.html#ref-HJRS" class="source-ref">HJRSV01P549A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Iṣābah fī tamyīz al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 1 p. 549).

For a similar Ibn Isḥāq statement via Salamah b. al-Faḍl, see <a href="../references.html#ref-TBRC" class="source-ref">TBRCV02P477A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Ṭabarī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh al-rusul waʾl-mulūk</span>, vol. 2 p. 477); without a witness, see <a href="../references.html#ref-KTHB" class="source-ref">KTHBV03P314A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Kathīr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Bidāyat waʾl-nihāyah</span>, vol. 3 p. 314), <a href="../references.html#ref-QZHX" class="source-ref">QZHXV09P122A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Maqrīzī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Imtāʿ al-asmāʿ bi-mā li-l-nabī min al-aḥwāl waʾl-amwāl waʾl-hafadat waʾl-mutāʿ</span>, vol. 9 p. 122). [^comment-ZTKXV01P166A-1]: A similar fragment is also found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P003E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. There appear to be no other similar passages with an analogous structure in the corpus. Placement is based on content.

It is assumed that this is the continuation of <a href="../references.html#ref-ZTTH" class="source-ref">ZTTHV01P386A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Khaythamah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Tārīkh al-kabīr al-safar al-thālith</span>, vol. 1 p. 386) (listed above).

Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 44), although it is much longer than that found in <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī).

Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 46).
[^comment-ZTTHV02P005B-1]: This passage follows immediately after <a href="../references.html#ref-ZTTH" class="source-ref">ZTTHV02P005A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Khaythamah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Tārīkh al-kabīr al-safar al-thālith</span>, vol. 2 p. 5).
[^comment-HBHXV10P284A-1]: Placement is provisional based on content. This passage is not in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Khuwaylah or Khawlah <em>bint</em> Ḥakīm b. Umayyah b. al-Awqaṣ al-Sulamīyah is only mentioned once in the witness of <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) (see <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P484C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 484)) in the story of the capture of Ṭāʾif where she asks Muḥammad for the jewelry of specific women among the Thaqīf (also see <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī) in <a href="../references.html#ref-TBRC" class="source-ref">TBRCV03P085A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Ṭabarī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh al-rusul waʾl-mulūk</span>, vol. 3 p. 85)). The <a href="../references.html#ref-HBHX" class="source-ref">HBHXV43P334A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Ḥanbal</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad</span>, vol. 43 p. 334) passage above must take place before the events described in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P484C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 484) because the Raid on Ṭāʾif occurs after the death of ʿUthmān b. Maẓʿūn. According to <a href="../references.html#ref-TBRC" class="source-ref">TBRCV02P458A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Ṭabarī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh al-rusul waʾl-mulūk</span>, vol. 2 p. 458), ʿUthmān b. Maẓʿūn died in <em>Dhū al-Ḥijjah</em> in the year 2 after or during the Battle of Sawīq. A similar passage but with a different construction is also found in <a href="WMSAH.html" class="witness-link">WMSAH</a> (Muḥammad b. Salamah b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Bāhilī al-Ḥarrānī).
[^comment-TMKXV01P158A-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Placement is based on content. <a href="../references.html#ref-TMKX" class="source-ref">TMKXV01P158A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Tirmidhī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>ʿIlal al-Tirmidhī al-kabīr</span>, vol. 1 p. 158) states: وفي الحديث قصة. سألت محمدا عن هذا الحديث فقال لا أعرف هذا الحديث إلا من حديث ابن اسحاق.
[^comment-DYIIV02P682A-1]: This passage is found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Placement is based on context as an aside to the story of the death of ʿUthmān b. Maẓʿūn. Khuwaylah or Khawlah <em>bint</em> Ḥakīm b. Umayyah b. al-Awqaṣ al-Sulamīyah is only mentioned once in the witness of <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) (see <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P484C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 484)) in the story of the capture of Ṭāʾif where she asks Muḥammad for the jewelry of specific women among the Thaqīf (also see <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī) in <a href="../references.html#ref-TBRC" class="source-ref">TBRCV03P085A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Ṭabarī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh al-rusul waʾl-mulūk</span>, vol. 3 p. 85)). According to <a href="../references.html#ref-TKXX" class="source-ref">TKXXV08P124E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Saʿd</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Ṭabaqāt al-kubrā</span>, vol. 8 p. 124), she offered herself in marriage to the prophet after the death of her husband, but he did not give her an answer. One of the earliest submitters and was one of the <em>muhājirūn</em>.
[^comment-KTMXV02P638A-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām, but one that touches on the same subject, the anger of the prophet, is found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P048E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 48). Placement is based on content.
[^comment-DHRQV01P351A-1]: This passage is split across two distinct fragments in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī), with the first half on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P050D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 50) and the second on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P050F</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 50). <a href="../references.html#ref-DHRQ" class="source-ref">DHRQV01P350A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn al-Mundhir</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Kitāb tafsīr al-Qurʾān</span>, vol. 1 p. 350) to p.352A is a continuous passage broken here by subheadings to agree with the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Notice the present order of passages is different from that found in <a href="../references.html#ref-DHRQ" class="source-ref">DHRQV01P350A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn al-Mundhir</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Kitāb tafsīr al-Qurʾān</span>, vol. 1 p. 350) to p. 352A.
[^comment-HBHXV04P221A-1]: This passage is similar to that found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) beginning on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P055C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 55), also found in <a href="../references.html#ref-NSSX" class="source-ref">NSSXV02P107E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Abū ʿAbd Allāh al-Ḥākim al-Nīsābūrī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Mustadrak ʿalā al-ṣaḥīḥīn</span>, vol. 2 p. 107).
[^comment-DHRQV01P353A-1]: This passage is similar to that found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) beginning on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P059E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 59).
[^comment-DHRQV01P402A-1]: The preamble that discusses the <em>isnād</em> is almost exactly the same in <a href="../references.html#ref-DHRQ" class="source-ref">DHRQV01P402A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn al-Mundhir</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Kitāb tafsīr al-Qurʾān</span>, vol. 1 p. 402), <a href="../references.html#ref-DHRQ" class="source-ref">DHRQV02P484A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn al-Mundhir</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Kitāb tafsīr al-Qurʾān</span>, vol. 2 p. 484), and <a href="../references.html#ref-DHRQ" class="source-ref">DHRQV02P429A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn al-Mundhir</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Kitāb tafsīr al-Qurʾān</span>, vol. 2 p. 429) as is found in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P059E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 59). The fragment found in <a href="../references.html#ref-DHRQ" class="source-ref">DHRQV01P354A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn al-Mundhir</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Kitāb tafsīr al-Qurʾān</span>, vol. 1 p. 354) (below) picks up the narrative in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P060G</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 60). All four passages in this group then follow the narrative found in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P063C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 63). The Qurʾān passages found in <a href="../references.html#ref-DHRQ" class="source-ref">DHRQV01P402A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn al-Mundhir</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Kitāb tafsīr al-Qurʾān</span>, vol. 1 p. 402) (but not in the other variations on this block) are located in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P109B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 109). focusing on revelations that concern the Battle of Uḥud. It is evident that between the <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī) and <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) versions there was a great deal of revising done to expand the narrative.

[^comment-ZZBXV18P252B-1]: The event occurs after the imposition of modesty on the prophet’s wives (with the revelation of Qurʾān 33:53), which does not appear in the redaction of Ibn Hishām, although it is mentioned in several passages as a marker of time, usually in reference to events that occur before the imposition of the <em>ḥijāb</em>, which is generally thought to occur in the year 5/626-627 in relation to Muḥammad’s marriage to Zaynab <em>bint</em> Jaḥsh (see <a href="../references.html#ref-KTHB" class="source-ref">KTHBV04P145A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Kathīr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Bidāyat waʾl-nihāyah</span>, vol. 4 p. 145) to p. 149), which is not described in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. This seems to be the only reference to Aflaḥ in the Ibn Isḥāq corpus. According to <a href="../references.html#ref-THRX" class="source-ref">THRXV01P262A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn al-Athīr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Usd al-ghābah fī maʿrifat al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 1 p. 262), he is only known in reference to this tradition as reported in a handful of sources via other <em>asānid</em>. He is sometimes referred to as Akhū Abī al-Quʿays. Placement is due to reference to the marriage in <a href="../references.html#ref-ZTTH" class="source-ref">ZTTHV02P006A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Khaythamah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Tārīkh al-kabīr al-safar al-thālith</span>, vol. 2 p. 6).

Hibat Allāh b. Mākūlā</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Tahdhīb mustamirr al-awhām</span>, vol. 1 p. 234) are not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. al-Suhaylī, in <a href="../references.html#ref-RWDX" class="source-ref">RWDXV06P189A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. ʿAbd Allāh Suhaylī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Rawḍ al-unuf fī sharḥ al-Sīrah al-Nabawīyah li-Ibn Hishām</span>, vol. 6 p. 189), places the event between the story of <em>Biʾr</em> Maʿūnah (<a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P183A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 183)) and the story of the expulsion of the <em>Banū</em> al-Naḍīr (<a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P190A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 190)). <a href="../references.html#ref-DRQM" class="source-ref">DRQMV02P1085A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Dāraquṭnī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Muʾtalif waʾl-mukhtalif</span>, vol. 2 p. 1085) and <a href="../references.html#ref-MKKT" class="source-ref">MKKTV01P234A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAlī b. Hibat Allāh b. Mākūlā</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Tahdhīb mustamirr al-awhām</span>, vol. 1 p. 234) mention a witness named Zabbān b. Qaswar al-Kalfī and a Zabbān b. Qaswar al-Kalbī, neither person is mentioned in the redaction of Ibn Hishām, nor is Wādī al-Shawḥiṭ. For passages analogous to <a href="../references.html#ref-DRQM" class="source-ref">DRQMV02P1085A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Dāraquṭnī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Muʾtalif waʾl-mukhtalif</span>, vol. 2 p. 1085) and <a href="../references.html#ref-MKKT" class="source-ref">MKKTV01P234A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAlī b. Hibat Allāh b. Mākūlā</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Tahdhīb mustamirr al-awhām</span>, vol. 1 p. 234) via the witness of Yūnus b. Bukayr, see <a href="../references.html#ref-RWDX" class="source-ref">RWDXV06P186A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. ʿAbd Allāh Suhaylī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Rawḍ al-unuf fī sharḥ al-Sīrah al-Nabawīyah li-Ibn Hishām</span>, vol. 6 p. 186) to <a href="../references.html#ref-RWDX" class="source-ref">RWDXV06P201A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. ʿAbd Allāh Suhaylī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Rawḍ al-unuf fī sharḥ al-Sīrah al-Nabawīyah li-Ibn Hishām</span>, vol. 6 p. 201).
[^comment-MKKXV04P173A-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-MKKX" class="source-ref">MKKXV04P173A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAlī b. Hibat Allāh b. Mākūlā</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Ikmāl fī rafʿ al-irtiyāb</span>, vol. 4 p. 173) mentions a witness named Zabbār, he is not mentioned in the redaction of Ibn Hishām.
[^comment-SBTXV02P200A-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Placement is based on content. <a href="../references.html#ref-YSSX" class="source-ref">YSSXV02P560A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Yūsuf b. ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿAbd al-Barr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Istīʿāb fī maʿrifat al-aṣḥāb</span>, vol. 2 p. 560), <a href="../references.html#ref-THRX" class="source-ref">THRXV02P303A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn al-Athīr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Usd al-ghābah fī maʿrifat al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 2 p. 303), and <a href="../references.html#ref-SBTX" class="source-ref">SBTXV02P200A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Subkī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Ṭabaqāt al-Shāfiʿīyah al-kubrā</span>, vol. 2 p. 200) are used as identifiers in the biographies for Zabbān b. Qaswar.
[^comment-HBHXV32P210A-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-HBHX" class="source-ref">HBHXV32P210A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Ḥanbal</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad</span>, vol. 32 p. 210) is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. According to <a href="../references.html#ref-AZKH" class="source-ref">AZKHV02P679A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Abū Zuhrah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Khātim al-nabīyīn ṣalā Allāh ʿalayhi wa Ālhi wa salam</span>, vol. 2 p. 679) (a late source), the statement is placed after the expulsion of the <em>Banū</em> al-Naḍīr, and thus in Ibn Isḥāq&#x27;s narrative, just prior to the <em>Ghazwā</em> Dhāt al-Riqāʿ. For references to flogging for the drinking of <em>khamr</em> (without historical context), see <a href="../references.html#ref-TKXX" class="source-ref">TKXXV07P301A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Saʿd</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Ṭabaqāt al-kubrā</span>, vol. 7 p. 301), <a href="../references.html#ref-JWTX" class="source-ref">JWTXV01P493A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn al-Jawzī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Talqīḥ fuhūm ahl al-athar fī ʿuyūn al-Tārīkh waʾl-siyar</span>, vol. 1 p. 493), AND <a href="../references.html#ref-HJRL" class="source-ref">HJRLV04P484A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Kitāb lisān al-mīzān</span>, vol. 4 p. 484). For refeneces to the Ibn Isḥāq tadition without witness, see <a href="../references.html#ref-BKHB" class="source-ref">BKHBV01P244A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Muḥammad b. Ismāʿīl b. Ibrāhīm al-Bukhārī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh al-kabīr</span>, vol. 1 p. 244), <a href="../references.html#ref-MGHK" class="source-ref">MGHKV10P364A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Mughalṭāy b. Qalīj</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Ikmāl tahdhīb al-Kamāl fī asmāʾ al-rijāl</span>, vol. 10 p. 364), and <a href="../references.html#ref-HJRS" class="source-ref">HJRSV04P363A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Iṣābah fī tamyīz al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 4 p. 363). See VAR_<a href="../references.html#ref-MGHK" class="source-ref">MGHKV04P297A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Mughalṭāy b. Qalīj</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Ikmāl tahdhīb al-Kamāl fī asmāʾ al-rijāl</span>, vol. 4 p. 297) via the witness of <a href="WMUTK.html" class="witness-link">WMUTK</a> (Muḥammad b. ʿUbayd b. Abī Umayyah ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Īyādī al-Ṭanāfisī al-Kūfī).
[^comment-ZTTHV02P008B-1]: This passage is similar to that found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) beginning on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P203E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 203).
[^comment-KHZXV02P301B-1]: These passages refer to the &quot;fear prayer&quot; (صلاة الخوف) that in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) occurs, in the redaction of Ibn Hishām, on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P204D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 204) just before the expedition to Dhāt al-Riqāʿ in the year 4. Quotations that deal with the events surrounding the fear prayer are also found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-DHTI" class="source-ref">DHTIV02P249C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Dhahabī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh al-Islām</span>, vol. 2 p. 249) and <a href="../references.html#ref-HJRQ" class="source-ref">HJRQV04P116F</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taghlīq al-taʿlīq ʿalā Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī</span>, vol. 4 p. 116) but these quotations are not complete and only include elements of the story. Fragments on the fear prayer are also found in <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-TBRB" class="source-ref">TBRBV02P555C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Ṭabarī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh al-rusul waʾl-mulūk (1967)</span>, vol. 2 p. 555), <a href="../references.html#ref-TBRB" class="source-ref">TBRBV02P556B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Ṭabarī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh al-rusul waʾl-mulūk (1967)</span>, vol. 2 p. 556), and in <a href="../references.html#ref-BQSX" class="source-ref">BQSXV03P375A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Bayhaqī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Sunan al-kubrā</span>, vol. 3 p. 375). In <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) no sources are mentioned that provide any clue as to the origins of the account. In the <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī) account found in al-Ṭabarī the source is listed as Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Nawfal b. al-Aswad. <a href="../references.html#ref-BQSX" class="source-ref">BQSXV03P375A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Bayhaqī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Sunan al-kubrā</span>, vol. 3 p. 375) lists two sources, Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Nawfal b. al-Aswad and Muḥammad b. Jaʿfar b. al-Zubayr b. al-ʿAwwām, although al-Bayhaqī does not say much about how, or if, these two sources present differing views. <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī) provides variations of the Muḥammad b. Jaʿfar b. al-Zubayr traditions on <a href="../references.html#ref-ZZBX" class="source-ref">ZZBXV14P347B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Abū Bakr Aḥmad b. ʿAmr al-Bazzār</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad al-Bazzār</span>, vol. 14 p. 347) and <a href="../references.html#ref-THSM" class="source-ref">THSMV01P314B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Muḥammad al-Ṭaḥāwī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Sharḥ maʿānī al-āthār</span>, vol. 1 p. 314). al-Bayhaqī includes a mention of <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī) in his account mentioned above saying that Ibn Bukayr includes accounts from both Muḥammad b. Jaʿfar and Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān without providing any details. <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī) provides the most diverse collection of stories on the fear prayer, listing traditions from an unknown source (<a href="../references.html#ref-HJRQ" class="source-ref">HJRQV04P116F</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taghlīq al-taʿlīq ʿalā Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī</span>, vol. 4 p. 116)), Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Nawfal b. al-Aswad (<a href="../references.html#ref-KHZX" class="source-ref">KHZXV02P301B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Khuzaymah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Saḥīḥ</span>, vol. 2 p. 301) and <a href="../references.html#ref-HYZX" class="source-ref">HYZXV01P153F</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Nūr al-Dīn ʿAlī b. Abī Bakr al-Haythamī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Mawārid al-ẓamʾān ilā zawāʾid Ibn Ḥibbān</span>, vol. 1 p. 153)), Muḥammad b. Jaʿfar (<a href="../references.html#ref-HBHX" class="source-ref">HBHXV43P373B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Ḥanbal</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad</span>, vol. 43 p. 373), <a href="../references.html#ref-KHZX" class="source-ref">KHZXV02P303B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Khuzaymah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Saḥīḥ</span>, vol. 2 p. 303), <a href="../references.html#ref-BNIB" class="source-ref">BNIBV07P124B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Ḥibbān</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Ṣaḥīḥ Ibn Ḥibbān bi-tartīb Ibn Balbān</span>, vol. 7 p. 124), <a href="../references.html#ref-NSSX" class="source-ref">NSSXV01P487A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Abū ʿAbd Allāh al-Ḥākim al-Nīsābūrī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Mustadrak ʿalā al-ṣaḥīḥīn</span>, vol. 1 p. 487), <a href="../references.html#ref-BQSX" class="source-ref">BQSXV03P375A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Bayhaqī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Sunan al-kubrā</span>, vol. 3 p. 375), <a href="../references.html#ref-BQSX" class="source-ref">BQSXV03P376B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Bayhaqī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Sunan al-kubrā</span>, vol. 3 p. 376), and <a href="../references.html#ref-HYZX" class="source-ref">HYZXV01P154E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Nūr al-Dīn ʿAlī b. Abī Bakr al-Haythamī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Mawārid al-ẓamʾān ilā zawāʾid Ibn Ḥibbān</span>, vol. 1 p. 154)), and from Dāwūd b. al-Ḥuṣayn, a <em>mawlā</em> of ʿAmr b. ʿUthmān (<a href="../references.html#ref-HBHX" class="source-ref">HBHXV04P212A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Ḥanbal</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad</span>, vol. 4 p. 212), <a href="../references.html#ref-ANSS" class="source-ref">ANSSV03P170A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Nasāʾī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sunan al-ṣughrā</span>, vol. 3 p. 170), <a href="../references.html#ref-NSKX" class="source-ref">NSKXV02P367A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Nasāʾī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sunan al-kubrā</span>, vol. 2 p. 367), and <a href="../references.html#ref-BQSX" class="source-ref">BQSXV03P367D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Bayhaqī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Sunan al-kubrā</span>, vol. 3 p. 367)). There are also several unwitnessed versions in the corpus via Dāwūd b. al-Ḥuṣayn (<a href="../references.html#ref-RJSB" class="source-ref">RJSBV08P366B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Rajab</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Fatḥ al-bāri sharḥ Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī</span>, vol. 8 p. 366), <a href="../references.html#ref-IMBT" class="source-ref">IMBTV05P014C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn al-Mulaqin</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Badr al-munīr fī takhrīj al-ahādīth waʾl-āthār al-wāqiʿah fī al-sharḥ al-kabīr</span>, vol. 5 p. 14) and <a href="../references.html#ref-HJTH" class="source-ref">HJTHV02P181B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Al-Talkhīṣ al-ḥabīr fī takhrīj aḥādīth al-Rāfiʿī al-Kabīr</span>, vol. 2 p. 181), who quotes al-Bayhaqī). In the <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī) collection, the passages are grouped by source for comparison.

These appear to be the only known instances of the passage in the corpus. Updated on 11/27/23.

Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 242) set during the attack on the <em>Banū</em> Qurayẓah following the Battle of the Trench. In addition to <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī), similar passage also found in <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī).
[^comment-ZTTHV02P010A-1]: This fragment is divided into several parts in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī), although all are worded differently. &quot;انصرف رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم عن الخندق راجعا إلى المدينة&quot; is found on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P233F</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 233). The following clause, &quot;أتى جبريل رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم&quot; is also found a few lines below on 233F. The third clause, &quot;قال إن ربك يأمرك أن تسير إلى بني قريظة,&quot; is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Portions of the forth clause, &quot;فحاصرهم رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم خمسا وعشرين ليلة حتى جهدهم الحصار,&quot; are found on p. 235C, and the final clause, &quot;فلما انقضى شأن بنى قريظة انفجر بسعد بن معاذ جرحه فمات به شهيدا رحمه الله,&quot; is found on p. 250D. <a href="../references.html#ref-ZTTH" class="source-ref">ZTTHV02P010A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Khaythamah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Tārīkh al-kabīr al-safar al-thālith</span>, vol. 2 p. 10) may have combined disparate quotations or fragments of quotations into a single narrative, or it may be the original arrangment of the <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī) text. Portions of the first and second clause are also found in <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī) in a single passage. Passage three is quoted in nine instances in the corpus but without a witness beside that given in <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī). There are variations of the fourth passage found in <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī) embedded in a much more detailed passage and in a similar fragment. A detailed passage is also located in <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī). The fifth fragment, in addition to <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) (<a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P250D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 250)), is also located in at least nine unwitnessed passages, but no additional witnesses are mentioned. Placement to be located at the point where Saʿd b. Muʿādh’s death is described in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Updated 11/27/23.

Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 251)) includes several death stories for Saʿd b. [^comment-HBHXV43P377B-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. The passage deals with an unidentified man who while fasting has sex with his wife during <em>Ramaḍān</em>. The prophet prescribes charity for the man in the form of dates that were being sold by a trader. The location seems to refer to the Fort (<em>fāriʿ</em>) of Ḥassān. Such a location is referred to in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P228B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 228) and <a href="../references.html#ref-HMMX" class="source-ref">HMMXV03P617B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Al-Ḥusayn b. Masʿūd b. Muḥammad al-Baghawī al-Shāfiʿī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Maʿālim al-tanzīl fī tafsīr al-Qurʾān</span>, vol. 3 p. 617) (without a witness) as belonging to Ḥassān b. Thābit, and occurs after the Battle of the Trench and during the conflict with the <em>Banū</em> Qurayẓah. This took place in <em>Shaʿbān</em>, in the year 5 (January 627). Also see <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī), <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī), and <a href="WSASN.html" class="witness-link">WSASN</a> (Sharīk b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Abī Sharīk al-Najaʿī al-Kūfī). Placement approximate and should be after the story of the conflict with the <em>Banū</em> Qurayẓah, assuming it occurs in the following month.
