[^comment-ZTTHV02P011A-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-BKHB" class="source-ref">BKHBV02P311A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Muḥammad b. Ismāʿīl b. Ibrāhīm al-Bukhārī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh al-kabīr</span>, vol. 2 p. 311) and <a href="../references.html#ref-ZTTH" class="source-ref">ZTTHV02P011A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Khaythamah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Tārīkh al-kabīr al-safar al-thālith</span>, vol. 2 p. 11) are variations on the last section of <a href="../references.html#ref-HBHX" class="source-ref">HBHXV29P312A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Ḥanbal</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad</span>, vol. 29 p. 312).
[^comment-TDSHV16P226A-1]: This passage is similar to that found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P276F</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 276) (latter half of the passage). The <em>isnād</em> in the above passage drops the name of Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd, skipping him and running from Yaʿqūb b. Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd to Ibn Isḥāq.
[^comment-ZTTHV02P011A-1]: Similar passage found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P278F</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 278) in the story of the submission of ʿAmr b. al-ʿĀṣ and Khālid b. al-Walīd, which in the redaction of Ibn Hishām, is preceeded by a poem. A much longer version is also found in <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī).
[^comment-ZTTHV02P012A-1]: A similar passage witnessed by <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) is located in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P279D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 279). Also see <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī), <a href="WAIYA.html" class="witness-link">WAIYA</a> (ʿAbd Allāh b. Idrīs b. Yazīd al-Awdī al-Zaʿāfarī), and <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī) for references to the attack on the <em>Banū</em> Liḥyān. <a href="WHAYA.html" class="witness-link">WHAYA</a> (Yazīd b. Hārūn al-Wāsiṭī) witnessed a passage in which the prophet curses the <em>Banū</em> Liḥyān that is not located in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. The <em>Banū</em> Liḥyān is also referenced in <a href="WUASQ.html" class="witness-link">WUASQ</a> (ʿUthmān b. ʿAmr b. Sājj al-Qurashī), but in what appears to be a telling of the story of Tubbaʿ and his clothing the Kaʿbah. Updated 11/27/23.
[^comment-HBHXV43P384A-1]: <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) includes a similar story in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P294H</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 294) in the story of the Raid on the <em>Banū</em> al-Muṣṭaliq and the Prophet&#x27;s marriage to Jūwayrīyah <em>bint</em> al-Ḥārith in a narrative structure much like that found in <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī), <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī), <a href="WMSAH.html" class="witness-link">WMSAH</a> (Muḥammad b. Salamah b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Bāhilī al-Ḥarrānī), <a href="WSSAA.html" class="witness-link">WSSAA</a> (Ṣadaqah b. Sābiq al-Muqʿad), <a href="WAMAQ.html" class="witness-link">WAMAQ</a> (ʿAlī b. Mushir al-Kūfī al-Qurashī), and <a href="WJHZA.html" class="witness-link">WJHZA</a> (Jarīr b. Ḥāzim b. Zayd b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Shajāʿ al-Azdī al-ʿAtkī al-Baṣrī). <a href="WMSAH.html" class="witness-link">WMSAH</a> (Muḥammad b. Salamah b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Bāhilī al-Ḥarrānī) also witnessed an account completely unlike all other versions. The story related by <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī) is narratively different and more similar to that found in <a href="WAIYA.html" class="witness-link">WAIYA</a> (ʿAbd Allāh b. Idrīs b. Yazīd al-Awdī al-Zaʿāfarī). <a href="WZAZA.html" class="witness-link">WZAZA</a> (Zakarīyā b. Abī Zāʾidah) also relates the story with yet another narrative structure. <a href="WBSAB.html" class="witness-link">WBSAB</a> (Bakr b. Sulaymān al-Aswārī al-Baṣrī) produced a truncated version. <a href="WAKMW.html" class="witness-link">WAKMW</a> (Aḥmad b. Khālid b. Mūsā al-Wahbī al-Kindī) witnessed a tradition that lists Jūwayrīyah <em>bint</em> al-Ḥārith as an eyewitness not found in other witnesses.
[^comment-HBHXV30P263A-1]: <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī), in the account of ʿAmmār b. Yāsir (<a href="../references.html#ref-HBHX" class="source-ref">HBHXV30P263A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Ḥanbal</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad</span>, vol. 30 p. 263)), makes reference to <a href="../references.html#ref-HBHX" class="source-ref">HBHXV30P259A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Ḥanbal</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad</span>, vol. 30 p. 259) as the object of his statement in the <em>masjid</em>. <a href="../references.html#ref-HBHX" class="source-ref">HBHXV30P259A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Ḥanbal</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad</span>, vol. 30 p. 259) implies that Ibn Isḥāq also related this tradition but there is no record of it. According to <a href="../references.html#ref-AMQM" class="source-ref">AMQMV01P280A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Muḥammad b. Abī Bakr al-Qasṭallānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Mawāhib al-ladunīyah bil-minaḥ al-Muḥammadīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 280), the event occured either during the expedition of al-Mustaliq or the expedition of Dhāt al-Riqāʿ. The passage is not located in the redaction of Ibn Hishām and the placement is provisional.
[^comment-HBHXV43P341A-1]: This is a fragment of a passage found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P297D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 297), in the Raid on al-Muṣṭaliq. Also see <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī), <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī), <a href="WSABZ.html" class="witness-link">WSABZ</a> (Saʿīd b. Bazīʿ), <a href="WAIYA.html" class="witness-link">WAIYA</a> (ʿAbd Allāh b. Idrīs b. Yazīd al-Awdī al-Zaʿāfarī) and for a more detailed version see <a href="WISIB.html" class="witness-link">WISIB</a> (Ismāʿīl b. Ibrāhīm b. Muḥammad b. Ṭalḥah al-Ḥijāzī).
[^comment-HBHXV43P362A-1]: The passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām although a similar reference is found in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P297C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 297). Turbān is only mentioned in the redaction of Ibn Hishām as a loaction the submitters passed on their way to Badr (see <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P613B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 613)). According to <a href="../references.html#ref-YNQX" class="source-ref">YNQXV04P004A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-ʿAynī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>ʿUmdat al-qārī sharḥ Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī</span>, vol. 4 p. 4), this refers to the same event where accusations were made against ʿĀʾishah after the Raid on al-Muṣṭaliq (see <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P297A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 297)). A similar passage, that describes a delay caused by ʿĀʾishah that forced the people to perform <em>tayammum</em> is also found in <a href="WIMTR.html" class="witness-link">WIMTR</a> (Ibrāhīm b. al-Mukhtār al-Tamīmī al-Rāzī) and <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī). These passages also refer to the accusation. The story is also dealth with by <a href="WMAAI.html" class="witness-link">WMAAI</a> (Muḥammad b. Abī ʿAdī (Ibrāhīm) al-Baṣrī).
[^comment-DWNXV01P086A-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. As in the above, the fragment is related by <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī) via Yaʿqūb b. Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd but from Ṣāliḥ b. Kaysān (see <a href="../references.html#ref-HBHX" class="source-ref">HBHXV30P259A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Ḥanbal</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad</span>, vol. 30 p. 259), <a href="../references.html#ref-JNSM" class="source-ref">JNSMV01P040A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn al-Jārūd</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Muntaqā min al-sunan al-musnadah</span>, vol. 1 p. 40), <a href="../references.html#ref-MYWX" class="source-ref">MYWXV03P198A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Abū Yaʿlā Aḥmad b. ʿAlī al-Mawṣilī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad</span>, vol. 3 p. 198), <a href="../references.html#ref-BQMX" class="source-ref">BQMXV02P016A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Bayhaqī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Maʿrifat al-sunan waʾl-āthār</span>, vol. 2 p. 16)). <a href="../references.html#ref-BNSX" class="source-ref">BNSXV01P275A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Ḥibbān</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrat al-nabuwīyah wa akhbār al-khulafāʾ</span>, vol. 1 p. 275) places the event following the expedition of al-Mustaliq. This appears to be the only reference to the tradition being related by Ibn Isḥāq to <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī). Placement is based on content.
[^comment-NSSXV01P482A-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. <a href="../references.html#ref-JWTX" class="source-ref">JWTXV01P40A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn al-Jawzī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Talqīḥ fuhūm ahl al-athar fī ʿuyūn al-Tārīkh waʾl-siyar</span>, vol. 1 p. 40) places this event in the year 6 between Mustaliq and Ḥudaybīyah. <a href="../references.html#ref-YFXX" class="source-ref">YFXXV0P18A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Yāfiʻī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Kitāb mirʼāt al-jinān wa-ʻibrat al-yaqẓān fī maʻrifat mā yuʻtabaru min ḥawādith al-zamān</span>, vol. 0 p. 18) states there were two eclipses, one in year 6 and one in year 10 when Muḥammad&#x27;s son Ibrāhīm died. Since there is no reference to Ibrāhīm&#x27;s death in Ibn Hishām, I will provisionally place the passage in year 6.
[^comment-ZTTHV02P014A-1]: This passage is similar to that found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) beginning on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P308G</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 308).
[^comment-SBDAV01P097A-1]: The <em>ḥadīth</em> that follow use the <em>isnād</em> from Ibn Isḥāq as follows: حدثنا أحمد بن محمد البغدادي حدثنا عبد الله بن سعد حدثنا عمي حدثنا أبي عن. The passage is not in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Refers to the hardships of the trip to Ḥudaybīyah. Placement approximate based on context.
[^comment-HJRTV04P137C-1]: This passage is found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. The passage refers to the year of Ḥudaybīyah and appears to reference the beginning of the trip.
[^comment-TMKXV01P381A-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-TMKX" class="source-ref">TMKXV01P381A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Tirmidhī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>ʿIlal al-Tirmidhī al-kabīr</span>, vol. 1 p. 381) states: سألت محمدا عن هذا الحديث فقال قد عرفته ولم أره يعرفه إلا من هذا الوجه. This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Placement is established because the section in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P310E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 310) to <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P311B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 311) is the only reference to al-Barāʾ b. al-ʿĀzib, who is alledged to have gone into the well looking for Muḥammad&#x27;s arrow.
[^comment-KJHHV01P045A-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-KJHH" class="source-ref">KJHHV01P045A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Muḥammad b. Jaʿfar al-Kharāʾiṭī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Hawātif al-jinān</span>, vol. 1 p. 45) is suspected by scholars of being forged. It does not occur in the redaction of Ibn Hishām but the placement is established by the story of the well in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P310E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 310) to <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P311B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 311).
[^comment-KTHSV01P364A-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-KTHS" class="source-ref">KTHSV01P364A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Kathīr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrat al-nubuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 364), <a href="../references.html#ref-DHMN" class="source-ref">DHMNV01P524A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Dhahabī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Al-Muntqā min minhāj al-iʿtidāl fī naqḍ kalām ahl al-rafḍ waʾl-iʿtizāl</span>, vol. 1 p. 524), <a href="../references.html#ref-TYMX" class="source-ref">TYMXV08P162A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Taymīyah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Minhāj al-sunnat al-Nabawīyah fī naqḍ kalām al-Shīʿat al-qadarīyah</span>, vol. 8 p. 162), <a href="../references.html#ref-KJHH" class="source-ref">KJHHV01P045A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Muḥammad b. Jaʿfar al-Kharāʾiṭī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Hawātif al-jinān</span>, vol. 1 p. 45) and <a href="../references.html#ref-KTHB" class="source-ref">KTHBV02P334A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Kathīr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Bidāyat waʾl-nihāyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 334) are not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Placement is based on the context of the account being the approach toward Mecca on the day of Ḥudaybīyah in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P310E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 310) to <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P311B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 311).
[^comment-TBTCV01P357A-1]: This passage is found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Refers a version of the Qurʾān copied by Ubayy b. Kaʿb that contained two Qurʾānic passages, Qurʾān 113:001 and Qurʾān 114:001. The passage is also found in <a href="WMHNS.html" class="witness-link">WMHNS</a> (Muḥammad b. Naṣr) but it states that Ibn Isḥāq read the <em>muṣḥaf</em> of Ubayy b. Kaʿb and goes on to quote a portion of the text. Ubayy b. Kaʿb is mentioned twice by <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) in the redaction of Ibn Hishām: as a participant at Badr (<a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P703C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 703)) and as receiving two shares from the dispribution of lots following Khaybar (<a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P358A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 358)). Ibn Isḥāq quotes traditions from Ubayy b. Kaʿb extensively in <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī) on different sections of the Qurʾān, as does <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī). According to Muḥammad b. Saʿd, Ubayy was was among the first people of Yabrib to give allegiance to Muḥammad at ʿAqabah and was unusual in that he was literate. He made copies of sections of the Qurʾān in Muḥammad’s lifetime and was one of the most important memorizers of the text. He was one of the people ʿUthmān turned to in producing the so-called ʿUthmānī Codex. <a href="WMSAH.html" class="witness-link">WMSAH</a> (Muḥammad b. Salamah b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Bāhilī al-Ḥarrānī) also includes a similar passage without mentioning Ubayy b. Kaʿb. The <a href="WMSAH.html" class="witness-link">WMSAH</a> (Muḥammad b. Salamah b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Bāhilī al-Ḥarrānī) reference to the <em>sūrah</em> is set in the voice of ʿAqabah b. ʿĀmir, who says that he was traveling with Muḥammad when, between Juḥfah and al-Abwāʾ (on the route between Mecca and Madīnah), it suddenly became dark and the wind began to blow. Muḥammad then turns to ʿAqabah and says to recite the <em>sūrah</em>. <a href="../references.html#ref-WHWX" class="source-ref">WHWXV04P572A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAlī b. Aḥmad b. Muḥammad al-Wāḥidī al-Nīsābūrī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Wasīṭ fī tafsīr al-Qurʾān al-majīd</span>, vol. 4 p. 572) places the context of the <em>sūrah</em> in the story of Labīd b. Aʿṣam, a member of the Jewish Zurayq tribe, who is said to have cast a spell on Muḥammad by tying eleven knots in a rope and casting it in the well of Dharwān. This story is alluded to in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P515D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 515) but the <em>sūrah</em> is not mentioned, nor is the name of the well. Labīd b. Aʿṣam appears to be mentioned only in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) and does not occur elsewhere in the witnessed corpus. <a href="../references.html#ref-AMQM" class="source-ref">AMQMV01P198B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Muḥammad b. Abī Bakr al-Qasṭallānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Mawāhib al-ladunīyah bil-minaḥ al-Muḥammadīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 198) quotes Ibn Isḥāq and &quot;others,&quot; but does not cite a witness, recounting the story of Labīd b. Aʿṣam, the curse, and the well of Dharwān, although he states that some say the well was known as &quot;Dhū Arwān&quot; (this is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām). Dhū Arwān is not found in the witnessed corpus and is not mentioned except in <a href="../references.html#ref-AMQM" class="source-ref">AMQMV01P198B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Muḥammad b. Abī Bakr al-Qasṭallānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Mawāhib al-ladunīyah bil-minaḥ al-Muḥammadīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 198). From the context of the passage it is not possible to know where this should be placed. Given the reference to Juḥfah and al-Abwāʾ in <a href="WMSAH.html" class="witness-link">WMSAH</a> (Muḥammad b. Salamah b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Bāhilī al-Ḥarrānī) placement is provisional after the story of the approach toward Mecca on the day of Ḥudaybīyah and the role Juḥfah plays in it.

[^comment-ZTTHV02P015A-1]: This fragment is difficult to place within the context of the redaction of Ibn Hishām because there is too little content on its own. There are six places in the redaction of Ibn Hishām where the phrase &quot;وولي تلك الحجة المشركون&quot; occurs. There are two passages that speak of the Prophet&#x27;s &quot;return&quot; during <em>Dhū al-Ḥijjah</em>, the beginning of the story of the Raid on Dūmah al-Jindal (<a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P213E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 213)) and the first section of the story of Khaybar (<a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P328C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 328)). There are no other fragments that have this particular construction in the corpus. <a href="../references.html#ref-ZTTH" class="source-ref">ZTTHV02P015A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Khaythamah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Tārīkh al-kabīr al-safar al-thālith</span>, vol. 2 p. 15) places this in the section of his history for year 6, which would place it in the run-up to the events of Khaybar. Placement is based on context and information provided by <a href="../references.html#ref-ZTTH" class="source-ref">ZTTHV02P015A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Khaythamah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Tārīkh al-kabīr al-safar al-thālith</span>, vol. 2 p. 15). It sould be read in combination to the passage below.

Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 328) gives the year as 7.

Zurayʿ, <a href="../references.html#ref-NYMX" class="source-ref">NYMXV02P1065A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Abū Nuʿaym</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Maʿrifat al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 2 p. 1065); via the witness of ʿAbd Allāh b. Mubārak, see <a href="../references.html#ref-NYMX" class="source-ref">NYMXV02P1065A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Abū Nuʿaym</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Maʿrifat al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 2 p. 1065); via the witness of Zuḥayr b. Abī Zāʾidah), and for versions of this passage from Ibn Isḥāq without a wintess, see <a href="../references.html#ref-NYMX" class="source-ref">NYMXV02P1064A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Abū Nuʿaym</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Maʿrifat al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 2 p. 1064) (a truncated version), <a href="../references.html#ref-KTHS" class="source-ref">KTHSV03P364A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Kathīr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrat al-nubuwīyah</span>, vol. 3 p. 364).
[^comment-TDSHV12P037A-1]: The above is in reference to Ḥanash b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Ṣanʿānī, who is mentioned only once in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P331D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 331) in the story to the Battle of Khaybar (see <a href="../references.html#ref-MDMX" class="source-ref">MDMXV01P645A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Mandah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Maʿrifat al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 1 p. 645) in a similar passage, Ḥanash states that he &quot;غزونا مع رويفع بن ثابت الأنصاري المغرب&quot;). In the <a href="../references.html#ref-TDSH" class="source-ref">TDSHV12P037A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn ʿAsākir</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh madīnat Dimashq</span>, vol. 12 p. 37) there is no context for Ḥanash&#x27; statement and occurs in the biography of Ḥabīb b. Shuḥayd. Ḥabīb is the source of the <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P330A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 330) passage as well. Ibn ʿAsākir states in <a href="../references.html#ref-TDSH" class="source-ref">TDSHV12P038A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn ʿAsākir</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh madīnat Dimashq</span>, vol. 12 p. 38) that the statement is &quot;like&quot; the one found in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P330A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 330) and goes on to quote the passage. The clear implication is that Ibn ʿAsākir thought this was a mistake and that the reference to Abū Zurayʿ was wrong. The similarity between &quot;رويفع&quot; and &quot;زريع&quot; suggests that a scribal error may be to blame. Ibn Isḥāq does not mention Abū Zurayʿ in the redaction of Ibn Hishām and <a href="../references.html#ref-TDSH" class="source-ref">TDSHV12P038A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn ʿAsākir</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh madīnat Dimashq</span>, vol. 12 p. 38) is the only instance found in the corpus that mentions Abū Zurayʿ, Ḥanash, and Ibn Isḥāq.

Ḥanbal</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad</span>, vol. 28 p. 209) is a variation on the text found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P331D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 331), which is itself a variation on <a href="../references.html#ref-HBHX" class="source-ref">HBHXV28P207A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Ḥanbal</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad</span>, vol. 28 p. 207) and <a href="../references.html#ref-HBHX" class="source-ref">HBHXV28P563A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Ḥanbal</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad</span>, vol. 28 p. 563).
[^comment-HBHXV28P563A-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-HBHX" class="source-ref">HBHXV28P563A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Ḥanbal</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad</span>, vol. 28 p. 563) is a variation on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P331B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 331) and <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P331D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 331) and is a variation on <a href="../references.html#ref-HBHX" class="source-ref">HBHXV28P207A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Ḥanbal</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad</span>, vol. 28 p. 207) and <a href="../references.html#ref-HBHX" class="source-ref">HBHXV28P209A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Ḥanbal</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad</span>, vol. 28 p. 209). It is clear from the <em>isnād</em> statement on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P331B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 331) that the context is the same as that stated in <a href="../references.html#ref-HBHX" class="source-ref">HBHXV28P563A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Ḥanbal</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad</span>, vol. 28 p. 563). The speaker, ʿAqabah b. ʿĀmir al-Juhanī, participated in the Battle of Ṣiffīn (<a href="../references.html#ref-TKXX" class="source-ref">TKXXV04P256A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Saʿd</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Ṭabaqāt al-kubrā</span>, vol. 4 p. 256)) at which he is purported to have killed ʿAmmār b. Yāsir (<a href="../references.html#ref-TKXX" class="source-ref">TKXXV03P196A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Saʿd</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Ṭabaqāt al-kubrā</span>, vol. 3 p. 196)). He participated in the conquest of Egypt and was appointed over the Egyptian army under Muʿawīyah in 47/667 (<a href="../references.html#ref-SJTX" class="source-ref">SJTXV01P246A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Daʿlaj b. Aḥmad al-Sijistānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Muntaqā min musnad al-muqillīn</span>, vol. 1 p. 246)). His involvment at Ṣiffīn would explain why he goes unnamed in the <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) copy. <a href="../references.html#ref-MDRX" class="source-ref">MDRXV03P1661A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Dārimī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad al-Dārimī</span>, vol. 3 p. 1661) via copy of Yazīd b. Zurayʿ; <a href="../references.html#ref-WKKH" class="source-ref">WKKHV01P160A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Muḥammad b. Khalaf al-Wakīʿ</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Akhbār al-quḍāh</span>, vol. 1 p. 160) via copy of <a href="WABAB.html" class="witness-link">WABAB</a> (ʿAbd al-Aʿlā b. ʿAbd al-Aʿlā al-Shāmī al-Baṣrī).

[^comment-HJRQV03P476A-1]: This passage is the eyewitness account of Jābir b. ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿAmr b. Ḥarām set during the calipahate of Abū Bakr. In it, Jābir recounts the story of the prophet&#x27;s instructions on how to collect funds from his agent in Khaybar. According to <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) (see <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P349D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 349)), Jābir was absent from Khaybar when the spoils were distributed. The recollection seems to place his conversation with the prophet after the events of Khaybar, after the prophet&#x27;s return to Madīnah. This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām, but is placed here due to content.
[^comment-HBHXV26P019A-1]: This passage is similar to that found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) beginning on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P355A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 355) and continuing to 355C, although the relationhsip between the above and <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) is not exact.

Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 357).
[^comment-BRWXV06P453A-1]: The first section of this passage is similar to that found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P357D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 357), down to the reference to Zayd b. Thābit. The discussion of Ismāʿīl is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. In <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī), following the mention of Zayd b. Thābit, the passage reads: وكان ما قسم عمر بن الخطاب من وادي القرى لعثمان بن عفان خطر ولعبد الرحمن بن عوف خطر ولعمر بن أبي سلمة خطر ولعامر بن أبي ربيعة خطر ولعمرو بن سراقة خطر ولأشيم خطر.
[^comment-NYMXV02P939B-1]: Reference to the return of ʿAmr b. Umayyah and Khālid b. Saʿīd from Abyssinia is located in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P359E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 359). Umaymah <em>bint</em> Khālid b. Asʿad, Khālid b. Saʿīd’s wife, is not located in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. <a href="../references.html#ref-NYMX" class="source-ref">NYMXV02P939B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Abū Nuʿaym</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Maʿrifat al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 2 p. 939) is drawn from the biographical entry for Khālid b. Saʿīd. This appares to be the only reference to Umaymah <em>bint</em> Khālid in the Ibn Isḥāq corpus.
[^comment-TKXXV04P152A-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-TKXX" class="source-ref">TKXXV04P152A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Saʿd</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Ṭabaqāt al-kubrā</span>, vol. 4 p. 152) is similar in context to <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P363B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 363) and reference to Ḥāṭib b. al-Ḥārith comes before Shuraḥbīl b. Ḥasanah. The short insertion of Hāshim b. Muḥammad&#x27;s comment has been left in the passage for the sake of clarity. <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P364A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 364) gives the name Fāṭimah <em>bint</em> al-Muhallal as Fāṭimah <em>bint</em> Mujallal. Umm Jamīl is mentioned as going to Abyssinia in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P352C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 352) and <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P355E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 355), but her return is not described in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Ḥāṭib b. al-Ḥārith’s submission is described in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P257D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 257), and his trip to Abyssinia is mentioned is several instances. Ḥārith b. Ḥāṭib is mentioned in several places in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī), and is described as being present at Khaybar (<a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P343F</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 343)). Muḥammad b. Ḥāṭib does not appear to be mentioned in the redaction of Ibn Hishām.
[^comment-NYMXV03P1465A-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. It is set in the Caliphate of ʿUmar to explain how Shuraḥbīl b. Ḥasanah became allied with the <em>Banū</em> Zuhrah. Placement is possible for the period after the death of the prophet or here, in the context of the return from Abyssinia, treating the context of the story of the alignment with the <em>Banū</em> Zurhah as an aside.
[^comment-TKXXV04P149A-1]: Reference to Bishr b. al-Ḥārith comes before Saʿīd b. ʿAmr in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P363B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 363).
[^comment-TKXXV04P149B-1]: Reference to Saʿīd b. ʿAmr comes before Saʿīd b. al-Ḥārith in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P363B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 363).
[^comment-TDSHV21P040A-1]: The reference to Saʿīd b. al-Ḥārith and his death at Yarmūk is located in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P365A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 365) in the account of those returning from Abyssinia. For a reference to the return of Saʿīd b. al-Ḥārith from Abyssinia that is different from <a href="../references.html#ref-TDSH" class="source-ref">TDSHV21P404A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn ʿAsākir</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh madīnat Dimashq</span>, vol. 21 p. 404) via the witness copies of Salamah b. al-Faḍl and Yūnus b. Bukayr, see <a href="../references.html#ref-TDSH" class="source-ref">TDSHV21P038A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn ʿAsākir</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh madīnat Dimashq</span>, vol. 21 p. 38); and for the witness of Bakr b. Sulaymān see <a href="../references.html#ref-TDSH" class="source-ref">TDSHV21P039A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn ʿAsākir</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh madīnat Dimashq</span>, vol. 21 p. 39). Saʿīd&#x27;s death date is attributed to Ibn Isḥāq without a witness in <a href="../references.html#ref-THRX" class="source-ref">THRXV02P47A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn al-Athīr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Usd al-ghābah fī maʿrifat al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 2 p. 47).
[^comment-DYDHV01P069A-1]: In <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) (<a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P363B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 363)) the story is recounted as an aside regarding Nuʿmān b. ʿAdī who returned from Abyssinia at this time, including a version of the poem. This is an example of the difficulty placing such material if there is no clue provided by the redaction of Ibn Hishām.
[^comment-ZTKXV02P656A-1]: This passage is similar to that found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P663B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 663), in the middle of the passage.

Maʿmar are mentioned as returning from Abyssinia in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P363B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 363), and placement is based on this context.
[^comment-TKXXV04P095A-1]: The passages on <a href="../references.html#ref-TKXX" class="source-ref">TKXXV04P153A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Saʿd</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Ṭabaqāt al-kubrā</span>, vol. 4 p. 153) and <a href="../references.html#ref-TKXX" class="source-ref">TKXXV04P095A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Saʿd</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Ṭabaqāt al-kubrā</span>, vol. 4 p. 95) do not occur in this exact form in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 363). Reference to Muḥammad b. ʿUmar and other transmitters is not redacted from <a href="../references.html#ref-TKXX" class="source-ref">TKXXV04P095A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Saʿd</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Ṭabaqāt al-kubrā</span>, vol. 4 p. 95) to preserve the original passage.

Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 372).
[^comment-HJRTV07P437A-1]: This passage is similar to that found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P372C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. [^comment-STBXV11P173A-1]: A similar passage is found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P372B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Similar passages are also found in <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī), <a href="WZAZA.html" class="witness-link">WZAZA</a> (Zakarīyā b.
