Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī).
[^comment-HBHXV25P325A-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Placement is based on content. <a href="../references.html#ref-BNSX" class="source-ref">BNSXV01P152A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Ḥibbān</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrat al-nabuwīyah wa akhbār al-khulafāʾ</span>, vol. 1 p. 152) places this event in Muharram 8.
[^comment-KTHRV08P369A-1]: This passage is in the biography of Hind b. Asmāʾ al-Aslamī who is described as an “<em>aṣḥāb</em> of al-Ḥudaybīyah.”
[^comment-ZTTHV02P017A-1]: A version of the passage is located in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P373C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 373). Also located in <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī), but it does not appear in this form elsewhere.
[^comment-ZTTHV02P020A-1]: This is composed of four fragments, each appear to follow the same <em>isnād</em> from Ibn Isḥāq. The first clause, &quot;فأقام النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم المحرم وصفر وشهري ربيع وبعث في جمادى الأولى بعثه إلى الشام الذين أصيبوا بمؤتة,&quot; is most similar to one found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P373C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 373) that opens the story of Mūʾtah. Clause one is also found in <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī) but is not located in other witnesses. The second clause, &quot;قال بعث النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم إلى مؤتة بعثة في جمادى الأولى من سنة ثمان ,&quot; is similar to the following sentence in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) (vol. 2, 373C). The second clause is also loctaed in <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī), in both the fragmentary form found in <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī), and as a part of a much longer narrative. <a href="WMSAH.html" class="witness-link">WMSAH</a> (Muḥammad b. Salamah b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Bāhilī al-Ḥarrānī) and <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī) combine clauses two and three (below) and both include versions that embed them in longer accounts similar to that found in <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī). <a href="WBSAB.html" class="witness-link">WBSAB</a> (Bakr b. Sulaymān al-Aswārī al-Baṣrī), likewise, combines the two clauses, but they are worded slightly differently from <a href="WMSAH.html" class="witness-link">WMSAH</a> (Muḥammad b. Salamah b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Bāhilī al-Ḥarrānī) and <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī). Unlike <a href="WMSAH.html" class="witness-link">WMSAH</a> (Muḥammad b. Salamah b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Bāhilī al-Ḥarrānī), <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī), and <a href="WBSAB.html" class="witness-link">WBSAB</a> (Bakr b. Sulaymān al-Aswārī al-Baṣrī), <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī) does not combine the second and third clauses in any form, but organizes the narrative differently from other witnesses. The third clause, &quot;فأصيب بها زيد بن حارثة وجعفر بن أبي طالب وعبد الله بن رواحة وفي هذه السنة افتتح رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم مكة,&quot; is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām in the form stated here. The closest similarity is found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P621A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 621) is a section that summarizes all of the battles and raids of the last ten years of the prophet&#x27;s life, although that sentence does not refer to the conquest of Mecca and the phrasing is slightly different. Similar phrasing is also found in <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī). Does not appear to exist in extant corpus in this form, except when combined with clause two. The fourth clause, &quot;قال ابن إسحاق كان فتح مكة لعشر ليال بقين من شهر رمضان سنة ثمان,&quot; is the same as that found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P437C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 437) that closes the story of Khālid b. al-Walīd’s mission to destroy the image of al-ʿUzzā at Nakhlah. As with other compound quotations of fragments from Ibn Isḥāq, it is not known how these were related in the script provided to <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī), how these were arrange in the text Aḥmad b. Muḥammad b. Ayyūb copied for the court, or if the way the fragments are arranged by Ibn Hishān reflects the manuscript he received from <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī). This clause is also found as a stand alone fragment in <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī) (see <a href="../references.html#ref-ZTKX" class="source-ref">ZTKXV01P096A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Khaythamah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Tārīkh al-kabīr sifr al-thānī</span>, vol. 1 p. 96)). A similar passage is also found in <a href="WAIYA.html" class="witness-link">WAIYA</a> (ʿAbd Allāh b. Idrīs b. Yazīd al-Awdī al-Zaʿāfarī), <a href="WBSAB.html" class="witness-link">WBSAB</a> (Bakr b. Sulaymān al-Aswārī al-Baṣrī) (which omits reference to the year), and <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī). Placement is based on initial reference in the first clause.
[^comment-NYHXV01P119A-1]: The poem and following passage is found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P373E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 373) set as the army leaves Madīnah on their way to Muʾtah. The first part of the passage is not similar to <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) but the poem and following passage are more similar. <a href="../references.html#ref-NYHX" class="source-ref">NYHXV01P119A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Abū Nuʿaym</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Ḥilyat al-awlīyāʾ wa-ṭabaqāt al-aṣfīyāʾ</span>, vol. 1 p. 119) is a condensed version of that found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī), <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī), and <a href="WMSAH.html" class="witness-link">WMSAH</a> (Muḥammad b. Salamah b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Bāhilī al-Ḥarrānī). <a href="WMSAH.html" class="witness-link">WMSAH</a> (Muḥammad b. Salamah b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Bāhilī al-Ḥarrānī) includes the poems and an extensive account of Muʾtah. Updated and revised comment 11/29/23.
[^comment-MZTXV35P374A-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. The same passage is also attributed to <a href="WABAB.html" class="witness-link">WABAB</a> (ʿAbd al-Aʿlā b. ʿAbd al-Aʿlā al-Shāmī al-Baṣrī). This passage is only reported in <a href="../references.html#ref-MZTX" class="source-ref">MZTXV35P374A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Mizzī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Tahdhīb al-kamāl fī asmāʾ al-rijāl</span>, vol. 35 p. 374) and not found elsewhere in the corpus. It seems to come before <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P380C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 380) as a missing preramble to the account that follows that announcing the beginning of the Asmā <em>bint</em> ʿUmays story. An extensive account of Muʾtah is found, in addition to <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī), in <a href="WAIYA.html" class="witness-link">WAIYA</a> (ʿAbd Allāh b. Idrīs b. Yazīd al-Awdī al-Zaʿāfarī).
[^comment-HBHXV45P025A-1]: A similar passage located on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P380C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 380) to <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P381A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 381). In addition to <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī), see <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī) and <a href="WYSAU.html" class="witness-link">WYSAU</a> (Yaḥyā b. Saʿīd b. Abān al-Qurashī al-Umawī al-Kūfī) for similar passages. The passage focuses on the death of Jaʿfar and Muḥammad’s reaction to it.
[^comment-HBHXV43P382A-1]: A similar passage is attributed to <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P381B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 381) and to <a href="WYSAU.html" class="witness-link">WYSAU</a> (Yaḥyā b. Saʿīd b. Abān al-Qurashī al-Umawī al-Kūfī), <a href="WAANH.html" class="witness-link">WAANH</a> (ʿAbd Allāh b. Numayr al-Hamdānī al-Khāraqī al-Kūfī), and <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī).
[^comment-ZTTHV02P153A-1]: This passage is not located in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. This is an identity passage, here to establish that Ibn Isḥāq had met al-Qāsim b. Muḥammad. al-Qāsim b. Muḥammad b. Abī Bakr al-Ṣiddīq, was the grandson of the first caliph. His daughter, Farwah, was married to Muḥammad b. ʿAlī b. Ḥusayn, b. ʿAlī b. Abī Ṭālib. He was known as a critic of the Qadarīyah movement and a collector of traditions, which he arranged alphabetically. He died in 108, at the age of 70 or 72 (<a href="../references.html#ref-TKXX" class="source-ref">TKXXV05P142C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Saʿd</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Ṭabaqāt al-kubrā</span>, vol. 5 p. 142) to p. 148F). Ibn Isḥāq is quoted in unwitnessed passages speaking about the qualities of al-Qāsim b. Muḥammad, giving the impression that he knew him fairly well (<a href="../references.html#ref-JWSS" class="source-ref">JWSSV01P351I</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Ibn Jawzī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Ṣifat al-ṣafwah</span>, vol. 1 p. 351), as well as <a href="../references.html#ref-JWZX" class="source-ref">JWZXV07P123C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn al-Jawzī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Muntaẓam fī Tārīkh al-mulūk waʾl-umam</span>, vol. 7 p. 123)), similar fragments are also found in <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī), <a href="WAZID.html" class="witness-link">WAZID</a> (ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. Muḥammad b. ʿUbayd b. Abī ʿUbayd al-Darāwardī), and <a href="WABAB.html" class="witness-link">WABAB</a> (ʿAbd al-Aʿlā b. ʿAbd al-Aʿlā al-Shāmī al-Baṣrī). He is mentioned as a link in six different <em>asānid</em> of transmission in the redaction of Ibn Hishām, but in none of these is he mentioned as a direct source. Ibn Isḥāq does transmit directly from his son, ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. al-Qāsim b. Muḥammad, in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P381B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 381) (also see <a href="WSHAK.html" class="witness-link">WSHAK</a> (Sulaymān b. Ḥayyān al-Azdī al-Aḥmar al-Kūfī al-Jaʿfarī)). al-Qāsim b. Muḥammad is also mentioned in <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī) in several places. In addition, he is cited in traditions related via <a href="WISUL.html" class="witness-link">WISUL</a> (Ismāʿīl b. ʿUlayah), <a href="WMHAL.html" class="witness-link">WMHAL</a> (Muḥammad b. al-Ḥajjāj al-Lakhmī), <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī), and <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī). <a href="WMSAH.html" class="witness-link">WMSAH</a> (Muḥammad b. Salamah b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Bāhilī al-Ḥarrānī) includes a story in which al-Qāsim b. Muḥammad is a character as well as traditions in which he is a transmitter. Placement to follow first reference to al-Qāsim b. Muḥammad in the <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī) text.
[^comment-ZTTHV02P155A-1]: This passage is not located in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. This is an identity passage, here to establish that Ibn Isḥāq had met al-Qāsim b. Muḥammad. See above for information and placement rationale.
[^comment-HBHXV21P144B-1]: Placement is based on similarity of content found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P380G</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 380). Seems to be an aside common in the Ibn Isḥāq corpus. Seems to be the only reference in the corpus.
[^comment-YZLXV01P092A-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. <a href="../references.html#ref-YZLX" class="source-ref">YZLXV01P092A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Muḥammad b. al-ʿAbbās b. Muḥammad al-Yazīdī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Kitāb al-Amālī: fīhā marāth wa-ashʿār ukhrā wa-akhbār wa-lugha wa-ghayrahā</span>, vol. 1 p. 92) is an odd tradition; it begins by stating that ʿAlī b. Abī Ṭālib, Jaʿfar b. Abī Ṭālib, and Zayd b. Ḥārithah get together and debate who Muḥammad prefers most. Muḥammad then addresses them, adding a Ziyād, although it is not clear whom this is. A similar tradition touching on the same topic with with different wording and omitting Ziyād is found in <a href="WMSAH.html" class="witness-link">WMSAH</a> (Muḥammad b. Salamah b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Bāhilī al-Ḥarrānī). The passage is placed after the Battle of Muʾtah where both Zayd and Jaʿfar are killed. A common mode of remembrance.
[^comment-HBHXV04P194A-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-HBHX" class="source-ref">HBHXV04P194A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Ḥanbal</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad</span>, vol. 4 p. 194) is a condenced version of <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P399C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 399) to p. 400C.
[^comment-HBHXV04P222A-1]: A Similar passage is located in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P400C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 400) in the story of the events that led up to the conquest of Mecca. Also see <a href="WAIYA.html" class="witness-link">WAIYA</a> (ʿAbd Allāh b. Idrīs b. Yazīd al-Awdī al-Zaʿāfarī), <a href="WMSAH.html" class="witness-link">WMSAH</a> (Muḥammad b. Salamah b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Bāhilī al-Ḥarrānī), <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī), which embed the fragment in a longer passage, and see <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī), <a href="WASKA.html" class="witness-link">WASKA</a> (ʿAbdah (ʿAbd al-Raḥmān) b. Sulaymān al-Kilābī al-Kūfī), and <a href="WSSAA.html" class="witness-link">WSSAA</a> (Ṣadaqah b. Sābiq al-Muqʿad) for another variation which are similar to each other. Updated on 02/02/23 and 11/29/23@.
[^comment-NYMXV05P2586A-1]: This is a compound statement. It is not known if these two passages were original to <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī), or were combined by a later author. The poem is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām.
[^comment-MJSXV01P391A-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām, which omits mention of al-ʿAbbās during the conquest of Mecca. Mujāshiʿ b. Masʿūd al-Sulamī is not mentioned in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. A similar account, although referring to Abū Maʿbad, is found in <a href="../references.html#ref-KTHB" class="source-ref">KTHBV04P320A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Kathīr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Bidāyat waʾl-nihāyah</span>, vol. 4 p. 320) (not transmitted by Ibn Isḥāq). Mujāshiʿ b. Masʿūd b. Thaʿlabah b, Wuhayb b. ʿĀʾidh is described in <a href="../references.html#ref-TKXX" class="source-ref">TKXXV07P022A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Saʿd</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Ṭabaqāt al-kubrā</span>, vol. 7 p. 22) as taking his brother, (Abū Maʿbad) Mujālid b. Masʿūd to see Muḥammad during the conquest so he could give his oath. Mujāshiʿ was killed on the Day of the Camel fighting for ʿĀʾishah (see <a href="../references.html#ref-TKHL" class="source-ref">TKHLV01P099A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Khalīfah b. Khayyāṭ al-Shaybānī al-ʿAṣfarī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Ṭabaqāt khalīfah b. Khayyāṭ</span>, vol. 1 p. 99)).
[^comment-HBHXV44P517A-1]: The story of the submission of Abū Quḥāfah is also found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P405E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 405).
[^comment-ZTKXV01P190A-1]: This is an identification clarification passage drawn from a section of Ibn Abī Khaythamah’s text for people with an <em>ism</em> beginning with <em>ḥā</em>. It seems to suggest that in some places Ibn Isḥāq identified the individual as al-Ashʿar b. Rabīʿah b. Aḥram b. Ḍubays b. Ḥarām and in a tradition related by Ibn Isḥāq via <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī), it is listed as Khunays b. Khālid. Al-Ashʿar b. Rabīʿah is not mentioned in the redaction of Ibn Hishām, but Khunays b. Khālid b. Rabīʿah b. Asʿram, an allied of the <em>banū</em> Munqidh, is mentioned in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P407E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 407) as a member of Khālid b. al-Walīd’s cavalry troop on the day of the conquest of Mecca. He was killed later that day. There is clearly a great deal of variation in the rendering of the name. There appears to be no other references in the corpus to this individual. The fragment will be placed corresponding to the location of <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P407E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 407).
[^comment-ZTTHV01P185A-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Ḥuwayṭib b. ʿAbd al-ʿUzzā was the manumitter of Ibn Isḥāq&#x27;s materal grandfather, Ṣabīḥ (<a href="../references.html#ref-BKHB" class="source-ref">BKHBV04P318A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Muḥammad b. Ismāʿīl b. Ibrāhīm al-Bukhārī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh al-kabīr</span>, vol. 4 p. 318)). This particular iteration of the story seems to be found only in this passage in the corpus.
[^comment-TDSHV15P356B-1]: This passage is not found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) or elsewhere in the Ibn Isḥāq corpus. Placed after initial story of Ḥuwayṭib&#x27;s submission.
[^comment-BRSXV04P1534A-1]: This is a small fragment of a much longer passage found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P410E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 410) that refers to the killing of Miqyas b. Ḥubābah. This rendering of the name is unusual, however, and is only found here, in the the Saqqā edition of the redaction of Ibn Hishām, and in al-Suhaylī&#x27;s supercommentary of the Ibn Hishām redaction (<a href="../references.html#ref-RWDX" class="source-ref">RWDXV07P072C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. ʿAbd Allāh Suhaylī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Rawḍ al-unuf fī sharḥ al-Sīrah al-Nabawīyah li-Ibn Hishām</span>, vol. 7 p. 72)). The most frequent version of the name is Miqyas b. Ṣabābah, which is given in the other <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī) versions of this passage that follow, as well as in <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-TBRB" class="source-ref">TBRBV02P608B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Ṭabarī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh al-rusul waʾl-mulūk (1967)</span>, vol. 2 p. 608) and <a href="../references.html#ref-THRX" class="source-ref">THRXV05P341I</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn al-Athīr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Usd al-ghābah fī maʿrifat al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 5 p. 341). <a href="../references.html#ref-IMBT" class="source-ref">IMBTV09P155B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn al-Mulaqin</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Badr al-munīr fī takhrīj al-ahādīth waʾl-āthār al-wāqiʿah fī al-sharḥ al-kabīr</span>, vol. 9 p. 155), quotes the Ibn Hishām redaction in giving the name as Miqyas b. Ṣabābah and Ibn Isḥāq is quoted in unwitnessed accounts as citing the name Miqyas b. Ṣabābah in <a href="../references.html#ref-DRQM" class="source-ref">DRQMV01P304A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Dāraquṭnī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Muʾtalif waʾl-mukhtalif</span>, vol. 1 p. 304) and <a href="../references.html#ref-DRQM" class="source-ref">DRQMV04P2232D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Dāraquṭnī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Muʾtalif waʾl-mukhtalif</span>, vol. 4 p. 2232), <a href="../references.html#ref-JWRX" class="source-ref">JWRXV01P155B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Burrī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Jawharah fī nasab al-Nabī wa-aṣḥābihi al-ʿasharah</span>, vol. 1 p. 155), <a href="../references.html#ref-THRX" class="source-ref">THRXV05P341C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn al-Athīr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Usd al-ghābah fī maʿrifat al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 5 p. 341), <a href="../references.html#ref-DHTI" class="source-ref">DHTIV02P553B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Dhahabī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh al-Islām</span>, vol. 2 p. 553), <a href="../references.html#ref-DHSL" class="source-ref">DHSLV02P122B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Dhahabī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Siyar aʿlām al-nubalāʾ</span>, vol. 2 p. 122), <a href="../references.html#ref-KTHB" class="source-ref">KTHBV04P156D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Kathīr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Bidāyat waʾl-nihāyah</span>, vol. 4 p. 156), <a href="../references.html#ref-SHBH" class="source-ref">SHBHV02P141F</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Muḥammad b. Aḥmad b. ʿAlī al-Fāsī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Shifāʼ al-gharām bi-akhbār al-Balad al-ḥarām</span>, vol. 2 p. 141) and <a href="../references.html#ref-SHBH" class="source-ref">SHBHV02P170D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Muḥammad b. Aḥmad b. ʿAlī al-Fāsī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Shifāʼ al-gharām bi-akhbār al-Balad al-ḥarām</span>, vol. 2 p. 170) (which appears to be drawn from the redaction of Ibn Hishām), and <a href="../references.html#ref-HJRS" class="source-ref">HJRSV06P373D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Iṣābah fī tamyīz al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 6 p. 373).
[^comment-BRWXV06P169A-1]: An analogous passage is located in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P410E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 410), in the story of those killed at the occupation of Mecca. It is also mentioned in <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-TBRB" class="source-ref">TBRBV03P058B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Ṭabarī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh al-rusul waʾl-mulūk (1967)</span>, vol. 3 p. 58). It does not apper to be located in other witnesses. Updated 12/01/23.
[^comment-HBHXV24P133A-1]: Ibn Hishām, in his commentary on the division of the spoils at the Batlle of Hawazin, mentions a Muṭīʿ b. al-Aswad b. Ḥārithah b. Nadlah as a member of the <em>Banū</em> ʿAdī b. Kaʿb (see <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P494A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 494)), but Ibn Isḥāq does not appear to mention him. Ibn Kathīr, in his <a href="../references.html#ref-KTHS" class="source-ref">KTHSV03P581A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Kathīr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrat al-nubuwīyah</span>, vol. 3 p. 581) quotes a similar passage without the Ibn Isḥāq <em>isnād</em>, and places it in the context of the conquest of Mecca. Based on content, placement will be following the mention of the killings that followed the conquest.
[^comment-THSMV03P331A-1]: The long section following the common passage may not belong to Ibn Isḥāq.
[^comment-STBXV20P292A-1]: Ibn Ayyūb&#x27;s passage is less declarative than the others.
[^comment-NYMXV05P2600A-1]: Reverses order of the passage.
[^comment-THRXV05P184A-1]: This transposes the order of the passage and is different than others in content.
[^comment-DKHXV06P016A-1]: This passage is similar to that found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) beginning on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P411F</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 411). A similar passage is also found in <a href="WZAZA.html" class="witness-link">WZAZA</a> (Zakarīyā b. Abī Zāʾidah), <a href="WAIYA.html" class="witness-link">WAIYA</a> (ʿAbd Allāh b. Idrīs b. Yazīd al-Awdī al-Zaʿāfarī), and <a href="WARBS.html" class="witness-link">WARBS</a> (ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Bashīr al-Shaybānī al-Dimishqī).
[^comment-STBXV24P323A-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-STBX" class="source-ref">STBXV24P323A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Ṭabarānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Muʿjam al-kabīr</span>, vol. 24 p. 323) drops <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī) from the <em>isnād</em>.
[^comment-NYMXV06P3378A-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-NYMX" class="source-ref">NYMXV06P3378A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Abū Nuʿaym</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Maʿrifat al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 6 p. 3378) رواه ابن بكير وابن نمير وابن أبي زائدة وعبد الرحمن بن بشير والناس عن ابن اسحاق.
[^comment-HBHXV03P316A-1]: This is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Placement is provisional based on content. <a href="../references.html#ref-HBHX" class="source-ref">HBHXV03P316A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Ḥanbal</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad</span>, vol. 3 p. 316) refers to the conquest of Mecca following the cleaning of images from the building.
[^comment-DRQLV10P082A-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-DRQL" class="source-ref">DRQLV10P082A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Dāraqutnī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-ʿIlal al-wārdah fī al-aḥādīth al-nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 10 p. 82) is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām but given the content it appears to be related to the conquest of Mecca. The passage is not reported in other sources. Placement approximate.
[^comment-HBHXV26P300A-1]: This passage is similar to that found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P415C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 415).
[^comment-ZTKXV02P775A-1]: This passage is similar to that found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P420D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 420). <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) is followed by a collection of poems not currently found in <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī).
[^comment-ZTKXV01P096A-1]: A similr passage is also found in <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī) in a compound passage in <a href="../references.html#ref-ZTTH" class="source-ref">ZTTHV02P020A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Khaythamah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Tārīkh al-kabīr al-safar al-thālith</span>, vol. 2 p. 20) (see for more details). An analogous passage is also located in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P437C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 437), at the end of the story of the conquest of Mecca.
[^comment-ZTKXV02P803C-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām and refers to the revelation of Qurʾān 58. See comment below that discusses the placement of the passage.
[^comment-BNHXV10P107A-1]: These passages are not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Aws b. al-Ṣāmit is only mentioned once in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P693F</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 693) in reference to his participation at Badr along with other members of the <em>Anṣār</em>. Similar passages are found under the witnesses of <a href="WJHZA.html" class="witness-link">WJHZA</a> (Jarīr b. Ḥāzim b. Zayd b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Shajāʿ al-Azdī al-ʿAtkī al-Baṣrī), <a href="WZAZA.html" class="witness-link">WZAZA</a> (Zakarīyā b. Abī Zāʾidah), <a href="WMMAH.html" class="witness-link">WMMAH</a> (Muḥammad b. Maslamah al-Makhzūmī al-Madīnī), <a href="WHAYA.html" class="witness-link">WHAYA</a> (Yazīd b. Hārūn al-Wāsiṭī), <a href="WJHUN.html" class="witness-link">WJHUN</a> (Jaʿfar b. al-Ḥārith b. ʿUmārah al-Nikhaʿī), <a href="WMSAH.html" class="witness-link">WMSAH</a> (Muḥammad b. Salamah b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Bāhilī al-Ḥarrānī), and <a href="WAIYA.html" class="witness-link">WAIYA</a> (ʿAbd Allāh b. Idrīs b. Yazīd al-Awdī al-Zaʿāfarī). According to <a href="../references.html#ref-IAAH" class="source-ref">IAAHV05P272A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn ʿAṭīyah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Muḥarrar al-wajīz fī tafsīr al-Kitāb al-ʿazīz</span>, vol. 5 p. 272) Qurʾān 58 is a Madīnan <em>sūrah</em> except for verse seven, which originates in the Meccan period and he goes on to say that the event occurred during the month of <em>Ramaḍān</em>, but does not specify a year. The passage describes Aws b. al-Ṣāmit as being in old age and somewhat enfeebled, since he is said to have participated in all of Muḥammad&#x27;s expeditions it must occur late, likely after the conquest of Mecca. According to <a href="../references.html#ref-AMHI" class="source-ref">AMHIV02P215A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Mālik b. Ḥusayn al-ʿIṣāmī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Samṭ al-nujūn al-ʿawālī fī anbāʾ al-awāʾil waʾl-tawālī</span>, vol. 2 p. 215), the event occured after Muḥammad returned from the conquest of Mecca. If it occured in <em>Ramaḍān</em> it must have occured prior to the Battle of Ḥunayn which took place in <em>Shawwāl</em> in the year 8. This would place it in relation to the redaction of Ibn Hishām after <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P428D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 428) since Ibn Isḥāq states on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P437C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 437) that the conquest of Mecca occured on the 20th of <em>Ramaḍān</em>. Updated 12/04/23.
[^comment-HBHXV43P335A-1]: al-Ḥawlāʾ <em>bint</em> Tūwayt is not mentioned in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. According to <a href="../references.html#ref-HJRS" class="source-ref">HJRSV08P093C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Iṣābah fī tamyīz al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 8 p. 93), she was al-Ḥawlāʾ <em>bint</em> Tūwayt b. Ḥabīb b. Asad b. ʿAbd al-ʿUzzā b. Quṣayy b. al-Qurashīyah al-Asadīyah. She seems to be known for this tradition alone although it is also related by different <em>asānid</em>. This passage is only found in the Ibn Isḥāq corpus via <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī). According to <a href="../references.html#ref-HMXX" class="source-ref">HMXXV01P408B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Muḥammad b. Habīb b. Umayya b. ʿAmr al-Hāshimī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Muḥabbar</span>, vol. 1 p. 408), she was from the same clan as Khadījah and gave her oath of allegiance to Muḥammad in Madīnah after the <em>hijrah</em>. Ibn al-Jawzī says that al-Ḥawlāʾ was the wife of ʿUthmān b. Maẓʿūn (<a href="../references.html#ref-JWTX" class="source-ref">JWTXV01P238G</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn al-Jawzī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Talqīḥ fuhūm ahl al-athar fī ʿuyūn al-Tārīkh waʾl-siyar</span>, vol. 1 p. 238)), who was also married to Khuwaylah or Khawlah <em>bint</em> Ḥakīm b. Umayyah. <a href="../references.html#ref-BRSX" class="source-ref">BRSXV04P18145A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Istīʿāb fī maʿrifat al-aṣḥāb</span>, vol. 4 p. 18145) quotes a tradition that although al-Ḥawlāʾ did not give her oath and submit until after the <em>hijrah</em> she used to visit Muḥammad while Khadījah was still alive, and she was known for her great faith. <a href="../references.html#ref-QYRX" class="source-ref">QYRXV01P673A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Muḥammad b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Nāṣir al-Dīn al-Qaysī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Tawḍīḥ al-Mushtabih fī ḍabṭ asmāʾ al-rawāh wa-ansābuhum waʾl-qābuhum</span>, vol. 1 p. 673) places her submission after the conquest of Mecca. Placement of the passage is based on this evidence. Updated on 12/04/23.
[^comment-HBHXV23P273A-1]: The passages in this section overlap as they were each fragmented differently. This passage is similar to that found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) beginning on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P442F</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 442). <a href="../references.html#ref-HBHX" class="source-ref">HBHXV23P273A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Ḥanbal</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad</span>, vol. 23 p. 273) replicates much of the fragment found in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P442F</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 442) down to the reference to Usāmah b. Zayd, although the order of names is different (in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) the last name in the fragmnent is Ayman b. ʿUbayd who is listed after Usāmah b. Zayd). The fragment beginning with &quot;ورجل من هوازن على جمل&quot; is found is a seperate quotation in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P443E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 443), which continues to &quot;وراءه فاتبعوه.&quot; The second clause that begins a new quotation in the above fragment is found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P445C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 445) to the end of the passage.

The text in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) is then broken up by a comment by Ibn Hishām and resumes <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P443I</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 443) to the end of the quotation. Also see <a href="WAIYA.html" class="witness-link">WAIYA</a> (ʿAbd Allāh b. Idrīs b. Abī Zāʾidah). Updated on 12/04/23.

Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 444).
[^comment-ZTTHV02P078A-1]: A similar fragment is found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P444I</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Also see <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī) and <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī). <a href="WAIYA.html" class="witness-link">WAIYA</a> (ʿAbd Allāh b. Idrīs b. Yazīd al-Awdī al-Zaʿāfarī) relates a version of this passage that is very different in wording.
[^comment-HBHXV37P293A-1]: This passage is similar to that found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) beginning on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P448D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 448), which ends with the clause &quot;حتى وجدت ريح الدم&quot; (&quot;حتى وجدت ريح الموت فلولا أن الدم&quot; in the above). The second half of the passage is located in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P448F</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 448). In the original <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) witness, it is likely that the two were a single quotation but in the redaction Ibn Hishām inserts a comment that necessitates breaking the passage into two sections. <a href="../references.html#ref-SBDA" class="source-ref">SBDAV01P117C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Abū al-Shaykh al-Iṣbahānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Dhikr al-aqrān wa riwāyātuhum ʿand baʿdihim baʿdan wa yalīhi juzʾ fīhi ʿAwālī Abī Shaykh</span>, vol. 1 p. 117) is also in the <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) witness but differs, placing the event at Khaybar instead of the Battle of Ḥunayn.

Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 449). Updated on 12/04/23.

Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 453).
[^comment-DYKHV01P122A-1]: This passage is similar to a fragment found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P458C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 458), which is phrased differently. Updated on 12/04/23.
[^comment-ZTTHV02P022C-1]: This is a compound passage that provides an <em>isnād</em> for the second half of the entry. The first part refers to the Battle of Ḥunayn and the following Battle for Ṭāʾif. A similar passage is found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P478D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 478) that is placed at the beginning of the story of Ṭāʾif, although the passage is longer and more detailed than the fragment found in <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī). Just prior to that is a brief mention of the Thaqīf, which, given the passage that follows, seems like a logical place to insert this passage. <a href="../references.html#ref-ZTTH" class="source-ref">ZTTHV02P023A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Khaythamah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Tārīkh al-kabīr al-safar al-thālith</span>, vol. 2 p. 23), below, contains similar elements but is worded differently and contains more detail. Note that both are related by Aḥmad b. Muḥammad b. Ayyūb. A similar passage, worded differently, is also found in <a href="WJHZA.html" class="witness-link">WJHZA</a> (Jarīr b. Ḥāzim b. Zayd b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Shajāʿ al-Azdī al-ʿAtkī al-Baṣrī). No other version of the fragment is found in the corpus. The second part refers to the actual Battle for Ṭāʾif. A similar passage is found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P482D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 482), although Abū Bakrah, or his <em>ism</em> Masrūḥ, are not mentioned in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. He was Nufayʿ b. al-Ḥārith b. Kaladah b. ʿAmr al-Thaqafī. Some say his name was Masrūḥ. He was one of four slaves who came out from Ṭāʾif whom the prophet freed. He was a companion and a source of some traditions. He died in the year 52/672 (<a href="../references.html#ref-HJTT" class="source-ref">HJTTV10P469A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Tahdhīb al-Tahdhīb</span>, vol. 10 p. 469)-470A). Abū Bakrah is mentioned in <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī) is a passage treating the same topic but constructed completely differently. He is also mentioned in <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī) and <a href="WJHZA.html" class="witness-link">WJHZA</a> (Jarīr b. Ḥāzim b. Zayd b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Shajāʿ al-Azdī al-ʿAtkī al-Baṣrī), also in reference to Ṭāʾif. The name clairification is also found in <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī) and <a href="WMSAH.html" class="witness-link">WMSAH</a> (Muḥammad b. Salamah b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Bāhilī al-Ḥarrānī).
[^comment-ZTTHV02P023A-1]: This fragment is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām or apparently elsewhere in the Ibn Isḥāq corpus. A similar passage, but with different wording and a different list of people, is found in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P478D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 478) at the beginning of the story of the conquest of al-Ṭāʾif. ## @<a href="../references.html#ref-HJRS" class="source-ref">HJRSV03P086C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Iṣābah fī tamyīz al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 3 p. 86)_BEG_WSACD ذكره ابن مندة وأخرج له من طريق إبراهيم بن المختار عن ابن إسحاق عن عيسى بن عبد الله عن سعيد بن ربيعة قال قدم وفد ثقيف على رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فضرب لهم قبة في المسجد فأسلموا في النصف من رمضان فأمرهم أن يصوموا ما استقبلوا ويقضوا ما فاتهم هكذا أورده ورواه إبراهيم بن سعد عن ابن إسحاق عن ابن عيسى فقال عن عطية بن سفيان بن ربيعة الثقفي عن بعض وفدهم وهو المحفوظ. @<a href="../references.html#ref-HJRS" class="source-ref">HJRSV03P086C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Iṣābah fī tamyīz al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 3 p. 86)_END_WSACD A roughly similar fragment is also loacted in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P482F</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 482) in reference to the arrival of the Thaqīf in Ramaḍān. Variations much more similar to this passage are also found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-NYMX" class="source-ref">NYMXV04P2217D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Abū Nuʿaym</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Maʿrifat al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 4 p. 2217) and <a href="../references.html#ref-THRX" class="source-ref">THRXV04P042C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn al-Athīr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Usd al-ghābah fī maʿrifat al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 4 p. 42). An analogous fragment is also found in <a href="WAKMW.html" class="witness-link">WAKMW</a> (Aḥmad b. Khālid b. Mūsā al-Wahbī al-Kindī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-SMJX" class="source-ref">SMJXV01P559D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Mājah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Sunan Ibn Majāh</span>, vol. 1 p. 559), <a href="../references.html#ref-STBX" class="source-ref">STBXV17P169C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Ṭabarānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Muʿjam al-kabīr</span>, vol. 17 p. 169), <a href="../references.html#ref-NYMX" class="source-ref">NYMXV04P2217A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Abū Nuʿaym</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Maʿrifat al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 4 p. 2217), <a href="../references.html#ref-NYMX" class="source-ref">NYMXV04P2217D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Abū Nuʿaym</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Maʿrifat al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 4 p. 2217), <a href="../references.html#ref-MZTX" class="source-ref">MZTXV20P150A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Mizzī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Tahdhīb al-kamāl fī asmāʾ al-rijāl</span>, vol. 20 p. 150), and <a href="../references.html#ref-KTHR" class="source-ref">KTHRV06P165B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Kathīr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Jāmiʿ al-masānīd waʾl-sunan</span>, vol. 6 p. 165); <a href="WIMTR.html" class="witness-link">WIMTR</a> (Ibrāhīm b. al-Mukhtār al-Tamīmī al-Rāzī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-DKHX" class="source-ref">DKHXV03P224B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. ʿAmr b. Abī ʿĀṣim al-Ḍaḥḥāk</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Āḥād waʾl-mathānī</span>, vol. 3 p. 224), <a href="../references.html#ref-NYMX" class="source-ref">NYMXV03P1300D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Abū Nuʿaym</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Maʿrifat al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 3 p. 1300), <a href="../references.html#ref-NYMX" class="source-ref">NYMXV04P2217D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Abū Nuʿaym</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Maʿrifat al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 4 p. 2217), <a href="../references.html#ref-THRX" class="source-ref">THRXV04P042C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn al-Athīr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Usd al-ghābah fī maʿrifat al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 4 p. 42), <a href="../references.html#ref-KTHR" class="source-ref">KTHRV06P165B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Kathīr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Jāmiʿ al-masānīd waʾl-sunan</span>, vol. 6 p. 165), and <a href="../references.html#ref-HJRS" class="source-ref">HJRSV03P086C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Iṣābah fī tamyīz al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 3 p. 86); and <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-NYMX" class="source-ref">NYMXV04P2217D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Abū Nuʿaym</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Maʿrifat al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 4 p. 2217), <a href="../references.html#ref-THRX" class="source-ref">THRXV04P042C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn al-Athīr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Usd al-ghābah fī maʿrifat al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 4 p. 42), and <a href="../references.html#ref-KTHR" class="source-ref">KTHRV06P165B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Kathīr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Jāmiʿ al-masānīd waʾl-sunan</span>, vol. 6 p. 165). Placement is based on content.
[^comment-HBHXV43P337B-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Placement is as an aside following the discussion on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P483G</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 483). Khuwaylah or Khawlah <em>bint</em> Ḥakīm b. Umayyah b. al-Awqaṣ al-Sulamīyah is only mentioned once in the witness of <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) (see <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P483G</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 483)) in the story of the capture of Ṭāʾif where she asks Muḥammad for the jewelry of specific women among the Thaqīf (also see <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī) in <a href="../references.html#ref-TBRC" class="source-ref">TBRCV03P085A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Ṭabarī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh al-rusul waʾl-mulūk</span>, vol. 3 p. 85)). According to <a href="../references.html#ref-TKXX" class="source-ref">TKXXV08P124E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Saʿd</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Ṭabaqāt al-kubrā</span>, vol. 8 p. 124), she offered herself in marriage to the prophet after the death of her husband, but he did not give her an answer. She was one of the earliest submitters and was one of the muhājirūn. Also see <a href="WHASH.html" class="witness-link">WHASH</a> (al-Ḥasan b. Aḥmad b. Shuʿayb al-Ḥarrānī) for a similar passage.
[^comment-NYMXV03P1620A-1]: This passage is similar to that found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) beginning on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P486E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 486), which is comprised of a much longer quotation.
[^comment-HBHXV09P274A-1]: The fragmnent found on <a href="../references.html#ref-HBHX" class="source-ref">HBHXV09P274A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Ḥanbal</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad</span>, vol. 9 p. 274) seems to be a condensed version of several passages found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) from the end of <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P486E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 486) to the end of <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P490C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 490) (with a variation of the latter also located in <a href="../references.html#ref-THSH" class="source-ref">THSHV11P395A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Muḥammad al-Ṭaḥāwī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Sharḥ mushkil al-āthār</span>, vol. 11 p. 395)).
[^comment-HBHXV11P612A-1]: Elements of this passage are distributed across several quotations found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) beginning at the very end of <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P486E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 486) and continuing through <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P488G</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 488), which are combined here and ending with the phrase &quot;فامنن علينا من الله عليك.&quot; <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P488G</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 488) also contains a long dialogue not found in <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī). The passage above then jumps to the fragment found in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P489C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 489) beginning with the phrase &quot;فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أبناؤكم&quot; and continuing to the end of the passage.
[^comment-TKXXV04P221D-1]: The passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. The context refers to the distribution of funds to Mecca and it most likely would have occurred after Hawāzin and if included in the redaction of Ibn Hishām would be placed around <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P492F</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 492). Versions of this passage are also found in <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī). A fragment from the <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) witness, not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām, but located in <a href="../references.html#ref-STBX" class="source-ref">STBXV17P038B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Ṭabarānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Muʿjam al-kabīr</span>, vol. 17 p. 38), refers to a similar story. That was fragment was placed following <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P492F</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 492).
[^comment-HBHXV11P596B-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Placement of <a href="../references.html#ref-HBHX" class="source-ref">HBHXV11P596B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Ḥanbal</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad</span>, vol. 11 p. 596) is provisional. Hawāzin is the only known battle in which Ibn Isḥāq places ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿAmr b. al-ʿĀṣ. The content of the passage indicates that it might be inserted approximatley around <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P496E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 496).
[^comment-HBHXV29P061A-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib b. Rabīʿah and Maḥmīyah b. Jazʾa are not mentioned in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. The event appears to have happened after the Battle of Ḥunayn, certainly after Khaybar, when the last of the main characters in the passage submitted. al-Faḍl b. ʿAbbās (or al-Faḍl b. al-ʿAbbās) was especially close to Muḥammad, participating in his burial (see <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P662A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 662)). Placement is conditionally placed after Ḥunayn, most likely after or part of the division of spoils after Hawāzin before <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P496A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 496).
[^comment-HBHXV11P613A-1]: This passage is similar to that found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) beginning on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P496E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 496).
[^comment-HBHXV18P253A-1]: This passage is similar to that found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) beginning on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P498C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 498).
[^comment-ZTKXV01P256A-1]: This is not mentioned in the redaction of Ibn Hishām but Saʿd b. ʿUbādah b. Dulaym is mentioned approximately 20 times. This seems to be the only time this formulation is mentioned in the corpus. Placement is based on the earliest mention of Saʿd b. ʿUbādah in the defragmented text.
[^comment-TKXXV04P221A-1]: The redaction of Ibn Hishām does not mention the <a href="../references.html#ref-TKXX" class="source-ref">TKXXV04P221A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Saʿd</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Ṭabaqāt al-kubrā</span>, vol. 4 p. 221) passage. The placement of the passage is provisional based on information in the passage that it occured after the conquest of Mecca. The Battle of Hawazin is the first major event after the conquest in which large sums of money are distributed. <a href="../references.html#ref-TKXX" class="source-ref">TKXXV04P221A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Saʿd</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Ṭabaqāt al-kubrā</span>, vol. 4 p. 221), <a href="../references.html#ref-HBHX" class="source-ref">HBHXV37P159A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Ḥanbal</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad</span>, vol. 37 p. 159), <a href="../references.html#ref-DWNX" class="source-ref">DWNXV04P266A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Abū Dāwūd Sulaymān b. al-Ashʿath</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Sunan Abī Dāwūd</span>, vol. 4 p. 266), <a href="../references.html#ref-ZTKX" class="source-ref">ZTKXV01P376A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Khaythamah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Tārīkh al-kabīr sifr al-thānī</span>, vol. 1 p. 376), <a href="../references.html#ref-HKMT" class="source-ref">HKMTV01P023A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Ḥusayn b. Muḥammad b. Abī Maʿshur al-Jazarī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Muntaqā min kitāb al-ṭabaqāt</span>, vol. 1 p. 23), <a href="../references.html#ref-QNMX" class="source-ref">QNMXV02P214A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Qāniʿ</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Muʿjam al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 2 p. 214), <a href="../references.html#ref-NYMX" class="source-ref">NYMXV04P1991A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Abū Nuʿaym</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Maʿrifat al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 4 p. 1991), <a href="../references.html#ref-THRX" class="source-ref">THRXV04P250A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn al-Athīr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Usd al-ghābah fī maʿrifat al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 4 p. 250), and <a href="../references.html#ref-MZTX" class="source-ref">MZTXV15P368A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Mizzī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Tahdhīb al-kamāl fī asmāʾ al-rijāl</span>, vol. 15 p. 368) are arranged by the date of the source. The collection is remarkably similar with only minor variations in <a href="../references.html#ref-DWNX" class="source-ref">DWNXV04P266A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Abū Dāwūd Sulaymān b. al-Ashʿath</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Sunan Abī Dāwūd</span>, vol. 4 p. 266) and <a href="../references.html#ref-NYMX" class="source-ref">NYMXV04P1991A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Abū Nuʿaym</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Maʿrifat al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 4 p. 1991), which seem to follow a common source. <a href="../references.html#ref-ZTKX" class="source-ref">ZTKXV01P376A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Khaythamah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Tārīkh al-kabīr sifr al-thānī</span>, vol. 1 p. 376) and <a href="../references.html#ref-THRX" class="source-ref">THRXV04P250A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn al-Athīr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Usd al-ghābah fī maʿrifat al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 4 p. 250) both delete the second half of the passage. Only <a href="../references.html#ref-QNMX" class="source-ref">QNMXV02P214A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Qāniʿ</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Muʿjam al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 2 p. 214) is significantly different with major sections redacted but with no new information added when compared to <a href="../references.html#ref-TKXX" class="source-ref">TKXXV04P221A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Saʿd</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Ṭabaqāt al-kubrā</span>, vol. 4 p. 221). All passages are transmitted via except <a href="../references.html#ref-STBX" class="source-ref">STBXV17P036A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Ṭabarānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Muʿjam al-kabīr</span>, vol. 17 p. 36) and <a href="../references.html#ref-NYMX" class="source-ref">NYMXV04P1991A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Abū Nuʿaym</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Maʿrifat al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 4 p. 1991), which are transnitted via through Aḥmad b. Hanbal. Updated and corrected on 12/05/23.
[^comment-TMSXV05P132A-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Placement is based on content. <a href="../references.html#ref-RNMX" class="source-ref">RNMXV00P154A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Ṭabarī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Riyāḍ al-naḍirah fī manāqib al-ʿasharah</span>, vol. 0 p. 154) accociates the quotation with the birth of the Prophet&#x27;s son, Ibrāhīm, in Dhu al-Hijja, 8, which is not mentioned in the redaction of Ibn Hishām.
[^comment-ZTTHV02P025A-1]: This passage appears to follow the same <em>isnād</em> as <a href="../references.html#ref-ZTTH" class="source-ref">ZTTHV02P025A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Khaythamah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Tārīkh al-kabīr al-safar al-thālith</span>, vol. 2 p. 25): حدثنا ابن أيوب قال أخبرنا إبراهيم عن ابن إسحاق. A similar passage is found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P500D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 500) to <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P500G</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 500) but with a different order and more details. The redaction of Ibn Hishām section is divided into four seperate statements from Ibn Isḥāq although Ibn Hishām inserted comments into the passage resulting in multiple statements beginning with &quot;qāla Ibn Isḥāq.&quot; It is not known how the original text that al-Bakkāʾī relayed to Ibn Hishām may have been structured. A similar passage is also found in <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī) and <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī), although these too are structred in a slightly different form than each other as well as <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī) and <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī). A much more brief version of the first clause is also found in <a href="WBSAB.html" class="witness-link">WBSAB</a> (Bakr b. Sulaymān al-Aswārī al-Baṣrī).
[^comment-ZTTHV02P027A-1]: This passage appears to follow the same <em>isnād</em> as <a href="../references.html#ref-ZTTH" class="source-ref">ZTTHV02P025A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Khaythamah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Tārīkh al-kabīr al-safar al-thālith</span>, vol. 2 p. 25): حدثنا ابن أيوب قال أخبرنا إبراهيم عن ابن إسحاق. The passage is not located in the redaction of Ibn Hishām, nor is there any mention of Fāṭimah <em>bint</em> al-Ḍaḥḥāk. Her father, al-Ḍaḥḥāk b. Sufyān al-Kilābī, is mentioned in three passages in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) as found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām, once in the story of the Battle of Ḥunayn and twice in reference to the sack of al-Ṭāʾif. She is mentioned in a list of the prophet&#x27;s wides in <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī). She is also mentioned by <a href="WBSAB.html" class="witness-link">WBSAB</a> (Bakr b. Sulaymān al-Aswārī al-Baṣrī) in reference to the Muḥammad’s ʿumrah in Dhū al-Qaʿdah in the year 8. Based on <a href="WBSAB.html" class="witness-link">WBSAB</a> (Bakr b. Sulaymān al-Aswārī al-Baṣrī), passage is placed following this discussion.
[^comment-HBHXV29P473A-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Placement is based on content.
[^comment-ZTKXV02P669A-1]: A similar fragment is found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P519F</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 519), although without an <em>isnād</em>. Also see <a href="WAIYA.html" class="witness-link">WAIYA</a> (ʿAbd Allāh b. Bashīr al-Shaybānī al-Dimishqī), <a href="WJHZA.html" class="witness-link">WJHZA</a> (Jarīr b. Ḥāzim b. Zayd b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Shajāʿ al-Azdī al-ʿAtkī al-Baṣrī), <a href="WMSAH.html" class="witness-link">WMSAH</a> (Muḥammad b. Salamah b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Bāhilī al-Ḥarrānī), and <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī).
[^comment-ZTKXV02P670A-1]: A similar fragment is also found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P520B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Bashīr al-Shaybānī al-Dimishqī), <a href="WJHZA.html" class="witness-link">WJHZA</a> (Jarīr b. Ḥāzim b. Zayd b. ʿAbd Allāh b.
