Salamah b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Bāhilī al-Ḥarrānī), and <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī) for accounts of the statement. NOTE: this passage is not listed are a VAR because it is a seperate fragment.
[^comment-DYMRV01P096A-1]: ʿĀʾishah <em>bint</em> Saʿd is not mention in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Placement is based on content.
[^comment-MWNXV02P119A-1]: It is not clear who Abū Muḥammad ʿAbd Allāh b. Muḥammad b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Anṣārī al-Madinī is. <a href="../references.html#ref-TMTT" class="source-ref">TMTTV01P354A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Qawwām al-Sunnah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taghrīb waʾl-tarhīb</span>, vol. 1 p. 354) mentiones that he related a tradition to Muḥammad b. Muḥammad b. al-Nuʿmān in the year 203. Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī states in <a href="../references.html#ref-HJRT" class="source-ref">HJRTV05P154A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Itḥāf al-maharah bi-al-fawāʾid al-mubtakarah min aṭrāf al-ʿasharah</span>, vol. 5 p. 154) that he related traditions concerning rain prayers (ṣalāt al-istisqāʾ) from Ibn Isḥāq via <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī). He gives the kunyā as “al-Balawī.” This passage is similar to that found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P222D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 222) but the context of the wider passage places it in this area of the text. As happens in Ibn Isḥāq, there is a recycling of the verbiage.
[^comment-HJRTV05P154A-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-DYMR" class="source-ref">DYMRV01P096A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī al-Dunyā</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Maṭar waʾl-raʿd waʾl-barq waʾl-rīḥ</span>, vol. 1 p. 96), <a href="../references.html#ref-MWNX" class="source-ref">MWNXV02P119A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Yaʿqūb b. Isḥāq Abū ʻAwānah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Mustakhraj Abī ʿAwānah</span>, vol. 2 p. 119), and <a href="../references.html#ref-HJRT" class="source-ref">HJRTV05P154A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Itḥāf al-maharah bi-al-fawāʾid al-mubtakarah min aṭrāf al-ʿasharah</span>, vol. 5 p. 154) are not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. The passages seem linked by content and refer to a battle in which Saʿd b. Abī Waqqas participated with the Prophet. The tone of desperation is similar to that found in Ibn Isḥāq&#x27;s account via al-Bakkāʾī (see <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P515D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 515) to <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P528E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 528)) of the story of Tabūk, including the presence of the Munāfiqīn in <a href="../references.html#ref-MWNX" class="source-ref">MWNXV02P119A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Yaʿqūb b. Isḥāq Abū ʻAwānah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Mustakhraj Abī ʿAwānah</span>, vol. 2 p. 119). Muḥammad&#x27;s prayer for rain is alluded to in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P522C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 522), is a short passage without an <em>isnād</em>. Placement is based on this account. ʿĀʾishah b. Saʿd b. Abī Waqqas is not mentioned in the redaction of Ibn Hishām as a witness or a participant. For a passage analogous to <a href="../references.html#ref-MWNX" class="source-ref">MWNXV02P119A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Yaʿqūb b. Isḥāq Abū ʻAwānah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Mustakhraj Abī ʿAwānah</span>, vol. 2 p. 119) and <a href="../references.html#ref-HJRT" class="source-ref">HJRTV05P154A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Itḥāf al-maharah bi-al-fawāʾid al-mubtakarah min aṭrāf al-ʿasharah</span>, vol. 5 p. 154) but without a witness, see <a href="../references.html#ref-IMBT" class="source-ref">IMBTV05P166A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn al-Mulaqin</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Badr al-munīr fī takhrīj al-ahādīth waʾl-āthār al-wāqiʿah fī al-sharḥ al-kabīr</span>, vol. 5 p. 166). For a different Ibn Isḥāq tradition transmitted from ʿĀʾishah <em>bint</em> Saʿd b. Abī Waqqas via the witness of Yūnus b. Bukayr, see <a href="../references.html#ref-NSSX" class="source-ref">NSSXV03P028A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Abū ʿAbd Allāh al-Ḥākim al-Nīsābūrī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Mustadrak ʿalā al-ṣaḥīḥīn</span>, vol. 3 p. 28).
[^comment-TKXXV04P177A-1]: This passage is similar to that found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P523E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 523) and <a href="../references.html#ref-STBX" class="source-ref">STBXV02P148D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Ṭabarānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Muʿjam al-kabīr</span>, vol. 2 p. 148). Elements of the Abū Dhurr story are also found in <a href="WJHZA.html" class="witness-link">WJHZA</a> (Jarīr b. Ḥāzim b. Zayd b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Shajāʿ al-Azdī al-ʿAtkī al-Baṣrī), <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī), <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī), and <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī).
[^comment-HBHXV21P145B-1]: This passage is similar to that found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) beginning on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P526D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 526). For similar content in the witness of <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) but different from the recation of Ibn Hishām, see <a href="../references.html#ref-DHSL" class="source-ref">DHSLV02P166A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Dhahabī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Siyar aʿlām al-nubalāʾ</span>, vol. 2 p. 166) and <a href="../references.html#ref-DHSL" class="source-ref">DHSLV02P166D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Dhahabī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Siyar aʿlām al-nubalāʾ</span>, vol. 2 p. 166).
[^comment-HBHXV31P425A-1]: This passage is similar to that found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P528E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 528) and <a href="../references.html#ref-STBX" class="source-ref">STBXV19P185A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Ṭabarānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Muʿjam al-kabīr</span>, vol. 19 p. 185).
[^comment-HBHXV21P137A-1]: The position of this quotation is based on content and similarity to <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P529D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 529). The exact passage is not in the redaction of Ibn Hishām.
[^comment-HBHXV44P373A-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-HBHX" class="source-ref">HBHXV44P373A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Ḥanbal</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad</span>, vol. 44 p. 373) is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Placement provisional based on the subject of the passage, Khidhām b. Khālid, who is a major protagonist in the story of the opposition <em>masjid</em> described in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P529D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 529). <a href="../references.html#ref-HBHX" class="source-ref">HBHXV44P373A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Ḥanbal</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad</span>, vol. 44 p. 373) identified by passim.
[^comment-ZTTHV02P028A-1]: This passage appears to follow the same <em>isnād</em> as <a href="../references.html#ref-ZTTH" class="source-ref">ZTTHV02P025A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Khaythamah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Tārīkh al-kabīr al-safar al-thālith</span>, vol. 2 p. 25): حدثنا ابن أيوب قال أخبرنا إبراهيم عن ابن إسحاق. This passage refers to the three submitters who refused to participate in the Battle of Tabūk that is mentioned in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) beginning on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P531E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 531). Hilāl b. Umayyah al-Wāqifī is listed by <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī) and <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī), but in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) as Hilāl b. Abū Umayyah. The event is also mentioned in <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī) is great detail. The story does not appear to be mentioned elsewhere in the extant corpus and in the classical Arabic corpus it is not mentioned frequently, fewer than 25 times. They are mentioned together in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P531E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 531).
[^comment-ZTTHV02P028D-1]: This passage is similar to that found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) beginning on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P531E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 531).
[^comment-HBHXV45P106A-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-HBHX" class="source-ref">HBHXV45P106A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Ḥanbal</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad</span>, vol. 45 p. 106) not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Umm Kalthūm&#x27;s death occured in Shaʿbān, 9 according to <a href="../references.html#ref-TKXX" class="source-ref">TKXXV08P030A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Saʿd</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Ṭabaqāt al-kubrā</span>, vol. 8 p. 30). According to <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P537D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 537), Muḥammad returned from Tabūk in Ramaḍān, and therefore one month after Umm Kalthūm&#x27;s death. Placement is based on date of Umm Kalthūm&#x27;s death relative to events. For a similar Ibn Isḥāq tradition without a witness see, <a href="../references.html#ref-ASHD" class="source-ref">ASHDV06P072A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-ʿAynī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Sharḥ Sunan Abī Dāwūd</span>, vol. 6 p. 72), <a href="../references.html#ref-ASHD" class="source-ref">ASHDV06P087A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-ʿAynī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Sharḥ Sunan Abī Dāwūd</span>, vol. 6 p. 87) (states it is based on the Bayhaqī transmission), <a href="../references.html#ref-IQBW" class="source-ref">IQBWV05P052A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn al-Qaṭṭān</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Bayān al-wahm waʾl-ihām fī kitāb al-aḥkām</span>, vol. 5 p. 52), <a href="../references.html#ref-NHXX" class="source-ref">NHXXV02P258A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd Allāh b. Yūsuf b. Muḥammad al-Zaylaʿī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Nasb al-rāyah li-aḥādīth al-hidāyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 258), <a href="../references.html#ref-YNBH" class="source-ref">YNBHV03P202A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-ʿAynī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Bināyah sharḥ al-Hidāyah</span>, vol. 3 p. 202), <a href="../references.html#ref-HJTH" class="source-ref">HJTHV02P257A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Al-Talkhīṣ al-ḥabīr fī takhrīj aḥādīth al-Rāfiʿī al-Kabīr</span>, vol. 2 p. 257), <a href="../references.html#ref-HJRS" class="source-ref">HJRSV08P306B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Iṣābah fī tamyīz al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 8 p. 306), <a href="../references.html#ref-HJTT" class="source-ref">HJTTV10P482A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Tahdhīb al-Tahdhīb</span>, vol. 10 p. 482). Also found in the witness of <a href="WMSAH.html" class="witness-link">WMSAH</a> (Muḥammad b. Salamah b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Bāhilī al-Ḥarrānī) and <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī).

[^comment-BKHBV08P111A-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-BKHB" class="source-ref">BKHBV08P111A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Muḥammad b. Ismāʿīl b. href="../references.html#ref-IMBT" class="source-ref">IMBTV05P218A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn al-Mulaqin</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Badr al-munīr fī takhrīj al-ahādīth waʾl-āthār class='ref-title'>Sharḥ Sunan Abī Dāwūd</span>, vol. 6 p. 87). These cite Laylā <em>bint</em> Qānif as the source. Placement is based on context.
[^comment-ZTKXV01P155A-1]: A passage is found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P540E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 540) that mentions the submission of the Thaqīf but highlights the role of Bilāl. This passage would seem to come before that passage which is also found in <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī) (below). This appaears to be the only formulation of the statement in the corpus.
[^comment-ZTKXV01P401A-1]: This passage is similar to that found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) beginning on SEE_<a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P540E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 540).
[^comment-ZTKXV01P155A-1]: This is a compound passage. The first section: &quot;قال كان من آخر ما عهد إلي رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم حين بعثني على ثقيف قال يا عثمان تجاوز في الصلاة وأقدر الناس بأضعفهم,&quot; refers to a similar passage found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P541D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 541), although the structure of the passage is different. The section recounts the admonition given to ʿUthm̄an b. Abī al-ʿĀṣ when the prophet sent him to Thaqīf. The second clause, &quot;ولما كتب رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم لثقيف كتابهم أمر عليهم عثمان بن أبي العاص وكان من أحدثهم سنا وذلك أنه كان من أحرصهم على التفقه في الإسلام وتعلم القرآن,&quot; is similar to that found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P538B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 538). The third clause, &quot;فلما افتتح النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم مكة وفرغ من تبوك وأسلمت ثقيف وبايعت ضربت إليه وفود العرب من كل وجه وإنما كانت العرب تربص بالإسلام أمر هذا الحي من قريش,&quot; refers to a similar passage in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P560C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 560) that begins the section retelling the series of representatives from the Arab tribes who arrive in Madīnah after the war against the Quraysh came to an end. The final clause, &quot;قريشا كانوا إمام الناس وهاديهم وأهل البيت والحرم وصريح ولد إسماعيل وقادة العرب لا ينكرون ذلك فلما افتتحت مكة ودانت قريش عرفت العرب أنه لا طاقة لهم بحرب النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم وعداوته فدخلوا في دين الله كما قال الله جل وعز أفواجا يضربون إليه من كل وجه,&quot; is similar to a passage found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P560C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 560) recounting the submission of the Arabs. This clause is related as a seperate fragment in <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī) found on <a href="../references.html#ref-ZTKX" class="source-ref">ZTKXV02P722A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Khaythamah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Tārīkh al-kabīr sifr al-thānī</span>, vol. 2 p. 722), although there are slight differences, especially in reference to the passage from Qurʾān 110:002. As with other compound passages, it is not known if the original text was structured in the way presented above or if Ibn Abī Khaythamah, the author of the al-Tārīkh al-kabīr sifr al-thānī, restructured the passage in order to make it fit the structure of his narrative. See below for more information of the fourth clause. NOTE: each section should be searched seperately. The fourth clause was searched on 2/10/23 and no other similar fragments were found in the corpus. Updated and corrected on 12/06/23.
[^comment-HBRXV01P283A-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Placement is based on reference to the death of Ibrāhīm b. Muḥammad. Updated and corrected on 12/06/23.
[^comment-ZZBXV18P254A-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-ZZBX" class="source-ref">ZZBXV18P252A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Abū Bakr Aḥmad b. ʿAmr al-Bazzār</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad al-Bazzār</span>, vol. 18 p. 252) states &quot;وهذا الحديث لا نعلمه يروى إلا عن عائشة رضي الله عنها بهذا اللفظ.&quot; For the full passage, see below.

Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 543). The <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) witness includes a detailed discusion of Qurʾān 9:1..
[^comment-SBDAV01P092D-1]: The <em>isnād</em> after Ibn Isḥāq is حدثنا أحمد بن محمد البغدادي حدثنا عبيد الله بن سعد حدثنا عمي حدثني أبي عن. Tis passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Miḥjan b. al-Adraʿ (محجن بن الأدرع) is not mentioned in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. According to <a href="../references.html#ref-TKXX" class="source-ref">TKXXV04P236A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Saʿd</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Ṭabaqāt al-kubrā</span>, vol. 4 p. 236), his full name was Miḥjan b. al-Adraʿ al-Aslamī, of the <em>Banū</em> Sahm. He was an early companion who lived and died in Madīnah during the Calipahe of Muʿawīyah. <a href="../references.html#ref-SFTX" class="source-ref">SFTXV01P129A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Khalīfah b. Khayyāṭ al-Shaybānī al-ʿAṣfarī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh</span>, vol. 1 p. 129) states that that Ibn al-Adraʿ traveled to al-Baṣrah and designed its <em>masjid</em> in the year 14/635 under the direction of ʿUtbah b. Ghazwān (عتبة بن غزوان). According to <a href="../references.html#ref-IHJS" class="source-ref">IHJSV01P289A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Ḥāzim</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Jawāmiʿ al-sīrah wa khams risāʾil akhrā li-Ibn Ḥazm</span>, vol. 1 p. 289), his kunya was Abū al-Jaʿd, which does not appear in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. According to <a href="../references.html#ref-HJRS" class="source-ref">HJRSV05P579A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Iṣābah fī tamyīz al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 5 p. 579), Ibn Isḥāq mentions Ibn al-Adraʿ in the &quot;Maghāzī&quot; in reference to the well-known story of the shooting competition, which is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Ibn Hajar does not specify which witness version he references. This is a truncated version of a tradition that seems to stem from ʿAbd Allāh b. Shaqīq. The more complete version, found in <a href="../references.html#ref-HBHX" class="source-ref">HBHXV33P457A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Ḥanbal</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad</span>, vol. 33 p. 457) states, &quot;حدثنا عفان حدثنا أبو عوانة حدثنا أبو بشر عن عبد الله بن شقيق عن رجاء بن أبي رجاء الباهلي عن محجن قال عفان وهو ابن الأدرع قال وحدثنا حماد عن الجريري عن عبد الله بن شقيق عن محجن بن الأدرع قال قال رجاء أقبلت مع محجن ذات يوم حتى إذا انتهينا إلى مسجد البصرة فوجدنا بريدة الأسلمي على باب من أبواب المسجد جالسا قال وكان في المسجد رجل يقال له سكبة يطيل الصلاة فلما انتهينا إلى باب المسجد وعليه بريدة قال وكان بريدة صاحب مزاحات قال يا محجن ألا تصلي كما يصلي سكبة قال فلم يرد عليه محجن شيئا ورجع قال وقال لي محجن إن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أخذ بيدي فانطلق يمشي حتى صعد أحدا فأشرف على المدينة فقال ويل أمها من قرية يتركها أهلها كأعمر ما تكون يأتيها الدجال فيجد على كل باب من أبوابها ملكا مصلتا فلا يدخلها قال ثم انحدر حتى إذا كنا بسدة المسجد رأى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم رجلا يصلي في المسجد ويسجد ويركع ويسجد.&quot; <a href="../references.html#ref-NYMX" class="source-ref">NYMXV05P2573A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Abū Nuʿaym</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Maʿrifat al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 5 p. 2573) states &quot;حدثنا حبيب بن الحسن ثنا أبو مسلم الكشي ثنا عبد الرحمن بن حماد الشعيثي ثنا كهمس بن الحسن عن عبد الله بن شقيق عن محجن بن الأدرع قال بعثني رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم لحاجة ثم عرض لي وأنا خارج من طريق المدينة قال فأخذ بيدي فانطلقنا حتى صعدنا أحدا فأقبل على المدينة فقال لها قولا وكان فيما قال ويل أمها قرية يوم يدعها أهلها كأينع ما يكون قال قلت يا رسول الله من يأكل ثمرها قال عافية الطير والسباع لا يدخلها الدجال كلما أراد أن يدخلها تلقاه بكل نقب ملك مصلتا ثم أقبل حتى إذا كنا بباب المسجد إذا رجل يصلي فقال تقوله صادقا قال قلت يا نبي الله هذا فلان هذا أكثر أهل المدينة صلاة أو من أكثر أهل المدينة صلاة فقال لا تسمعه فيهلك لا تسمعه فيهلك رواه حماد بن سلمة عن الجريري عن عبد الله بن شقيق نحوه ورواه أبو بكر بن عياش عن الأعمش عن أبي بشر عن عبد الله بن شقيق عن عمران بن حصين وهو وهم والصواب ما تقدم.&quot; This places the context for the passage in the period after the conquest of Mecca as Muḥammad sends Ibn al-al-Adraʿ on the ḥajj, although why he would go by Uḥud is not clear. This most likely happened in AH9, the year Abū Bakr led the pilgrimage since it appears Muḥammad did not attend. Updated and ammended on 12/06/23.
[^comment-ZTTHV02P030A-1]: This passage appears to follow the same <em>isnād</em> as <a href="../references.html#ref-ZTTH" class="source-ref">ZTTHV02P029B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Khaythamah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Tārīkh al-kabīr al-safar al-thālith</span>, vol. 2 p. 29): حدثنا ابن أيوب قال أخبرنا إبراهيم عن ابن إسحاق. A similar fragment is found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P545E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 545) (and quoted in other sources) in the story of the pilgrimage led by Abū Bakr in the year 9. There is similar wording in the fragment but elements are in a different order. Analogous fragments are also found in <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī), and both <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī) and <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) give the <em>isnād</em> as وحدثني حكيم بن حكيم بن عباد بن حنيف عن أبي جعفر محمد بن علي. Also see <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī) for a fragment without an <em>isnād</em>..
[^comment-HBHXV01P254A-1]: This passage is similar to that found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) beginning on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P552C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 552).
[^comment-ZTKXV02P722A-1]: A similar passage, worded in a different order, is found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P560C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 560), recounting the submission of the Arabs. A similar fragment is included in a compound passage from <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī) found on <a href="../references.html#ref-ZTKX" class="source-ref">ZTKXV01P155A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Khaythamah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Tārīkh al-kabīr sifr al-thānī</span>, vol. 1 p. 155) (see above for more details). No other references to this fragment are found in the corpus.
[^comment-HBHXV03P022A-1]: This story is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. It relates the account of a &quot;shaykh&quot; who told Abū al-Naḍr Sālim b. Abī Umayyah about how he had acquired a letter (kitāb) from Muḥammad that the Tamīm tribe would not be punished regarding their payment of ṣadaqah (alms). They sought out Ṭalḥah b. ʿUbayd Allāh al-Taymī, a member of their tribe, who upon their submission, got this letter from the prophet. Sālim b. Abī Umayyah is not mentioned in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. The story of the remembrance is set in Baṣrah during the era of al-Ḥajjaj b. Yūsuf, who ruled Iraq from 74/694 until his death in 95/714. Also See <a href="WHSDB.html" class="witness-link">WHSDB</a> (Ḥammād b. Salamah b. Dīnār al-Baṣrī) and <a href="WYZAA.html" class="witness-link">WYZAA</a> (Yazīd b. Zurayʿ al-ʿAyshī al-Baṣrī) in same section for analogous passages. Placement is based on the story of the submission of the Taym tribe in the year 9, when a group of them arrived in Madīnah, found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P560C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 560) to <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P567C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 567). Updated and corrected on 12/06/23.

Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 561), although Qurʾān 49:9 is discussed on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P567C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Ḥanash’ visit to the prophet on behalf of the <em>banū</em> ʿAbd al-Qays. Also see unwitnessed versions on <a href="../references.html#ref-KTHB" class="source-ref">KTHBV05P048B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Kathīr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Bidāyat waʾl-nihāyah</span>, vol. 5 p. 48) and <a href="../references.html#ref-THRX" class="source-ref">THRXV01P498B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn al-Athīr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Usd al-ghābah fī maʿrifat al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 1 p. 498).
[^comment-ZTKXV01P067A-1]: A similar fragment is found is found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P585E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 585). The passage recounts the arrival of al-Ashʿath b. Qays and the delegation of the <em>banū</em> Kindah that came to visit the prophet in Madīnah. Also see <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī) for a much more detailed account that found in <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī) or <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) beginning on <a href="../references.html#ref-BQWX" class="source-ref">BQWXV05P368A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Bayhaqī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Dalāʾil al-nubūwah wa maʿarifah aḥwāl ṣāḥib al-sharīʿah</span>, vol. 5 p. 368), which includes two poems, a short poem found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P582</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 582) (that is not concerned with al-Ashʿath b. Qays) and another not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām.
[^comment-HBHXV18P292A-1]: This passage has analogous elements to that found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) beginning on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P595A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 595), which deals with the prophet&#x27;s instruction to Khālid b. Walīd in his mission to pacify the <em>Banū</em> al-Ḥārith b. Kaʿb in Najrān. The passage may not deal with the event and if no new information is found then the passage should be moved to the sunnah section below.
[^comment-KHZXV03P138A-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-KHZX" class="source-ref">KHZXV03P138A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Khuzaymah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Saḥīḥ</span>, vol. 3 p. 138) mentions this passage among other reports to help explain Qurʾān 7:204.
[^comment-KTHQV08P121A-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-KTHQ" class="source-ref">KTHQV08P121A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Kathīr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Tafsīr al-Qurʾān al-ʿAẓīm</span>, vol. 8 p. 121) is part of the commentary on Qurʾān 62:9-11.
[^comment-HBHXV18P335A-1]: This passage is similar to that found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) beginning on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P599E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 599).
[^comment-HBHXV43P365A-1]: A similar passage is found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P601H</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 601) at the beginning of the discussion of the Farewell Pilgrimage and in <a href="../references.html#ref-TBRB" class="source-ref">TBRBV03P148B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Ṭabarī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh al-rusul waʾl-mulūk (1967)</span>, vol. 3 p. 148) in the witness of <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī).
[^comment-DHRQV01P404A-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Placement is based on content.
[^comment-HBHXV21P143A-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-HBHX" class="source-ref">HBHXV21P143A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Ḥanbal</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad</span>, vol. 21 p. 143) is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Position is provisional due to location of Dhū Ḥulayfah and its location as the site of Muḥammad taking Ihram during the farewell pilgrimage.
[^comment-NSSXV01P661A-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-NSSX" class="source-ref">NSSXV01P661A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Abū ʿAbd Allāh al-Ḥākim al-Nīsābūrī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Mustadrak ʿalā al-ṣaḥīḥīn</span>, vol. 1 p. 661) is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Placement provisional due to discusion of rules for iḥrām for women.
[^comment-HBHXV29P459A-1]: Placement provisional due to content. This passage is found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām but the content indicates that the event occurs before the arival in Mecca but after the departure from Madīnah during the pilgrimage.
[^comment-GHHXV01P249A-1]: Also see another variant on <a href="../references.html#ref-HBHX" class="source-ref">HBHXV29P459A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Ḥanbal</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad</span>, vol. 29 p. 459), <a href="../references.html#ref-GHHX" class="source-ref">GHHXV01P249A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Abū Isḥāq Ibrāhīm b. Isḥāq al-Ḥarbī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Gharīb al-ḥadīth</span>, vol. 1 p. 249), and <a href="../references.html#ref-MKTX" class="source-ref">MKTXV03P055A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Yaḥyā b. Maʿīn</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Kitāb al-taʾrīkh fī rawāyah al-Dawrī</span>, vol. 3 p. 55) via the witness of Muḥammad b. ʿUbayd al-Ṭanāfisī in <a href="../references.html#ref-TKXX" class="source-ref">TKXXV04P222A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Saʿd</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Ṭabaqāt al-kubrā</span>, vol. 4 p. 222).
[^comment-HBHXV02P116A-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Placement is based on content.
[^comment-KTHSV04P272A-1]: This passage is similar to that found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) beginning on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P602B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 602).
[^comment-DRQSV03P315A-1]: This passage is found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām, nor is Nubayshah mentioned. This tradition seems to be the only reference to Nubyashah in the extant Ibn Isḥāq corpus. For what appears to be the only unwitnesed tradition related by Ibn Isḥāq, see <a href="../references.html#ref-DHNQ" class="source-ref">DHNQV02P009B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Dhahabī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Tanqīḥ al-taḥqīq fī aḥādīth al-taʿlīq</span>, vol. 2 p. 9) (quoting <a href="../references.html#ref-DRQS" class="source-ref">DRQSV03P315A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Dāraquṭnī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Sunan al-Dāraquṭnī</span>, vol. 3 p. 315)). The passage refers to the saying of the &quot;talbīyah,&quot; and when the prophet, hearing someone performing the pilgrimage for someone else (Nubayshah), says they should do it for themselves first the then for Nubayshah. The prophet performed ʿumrah three times, 7AH, 8AH, and the farewell pilgrimage in 10AH. Without any evidence to the contrary, this passage will be placed in the farewell pilgrimage. This passage appears to reference Nubayshah al-Hudhalī, or as some refer to him, Nubayshah al-Khayr (<a href="../references.html#ref-TKXX" class="source-ref">TKXXV07P036B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Saʿd</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Ṭabaqāt al-kubrā</span>, vol. 7 p. 36)). There seems to be little agreement about his lineage. <a href="../references.html#ref-BKHB" class="source-ref">BKHBV08P127B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Muḥammad b. Ismāʿīl b. Ibrāhīm al-Bukhārī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh al-kabīr</span>, vol. 8 p. 127) and <a href="../references.html#ref-RZJX" class="source-ref">RZJXV08P506C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Jarḥ waʾl-taʿdīl</span>, vol. 8 p. 506) give his full name as Nubayshah al-Khayr al-Hudhalī, Ibn ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿAttāb b. al-Ḥārith b. Nuṣayr b. Ḥuṣayn b. Nābaghah b. Luḥaynah b. Hudhayl; <a href="../references.html#ref-BNMU" class="source-ref">BNMUV01P072B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Ḥibbān</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Mashāhīr ʿulamāʾ al-amṣār wa-aʿlām fuqahāʾ al-aqṭār</span>, vol. 1 p. 72) lists him as Nubayshah b. ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿAmr al-Hudhalī; <a href="../references.html#ref-MHDK" class="source-ref">MHDKV01P275A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Muḥammad b. al-Ḥusayn b. Aḥmad al-Azdī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Kitāb dhikr ism kull ṣaḥābī rawā ʿan Rasūl</span>, vol. 1 p. 275) as Nubayshah al-Khayr b. ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿAttāb b. al-Ḥārith b. Ḥuṣayn b. Rāyʿah b. Layān b. Hudhayl; <a href="../references.html#ref-MRSX" class="source-ref">MRSXV02P296B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Abū Bakr Aḥmad b. ʿAlī b. Manjuwayh</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Rijāl Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim</span>, vol. 2 p. 296) as Nubayshah al-Khayr b. ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar b. ʿAttāb b. al-Ḥārith b. Ḥuḍayr; <a href="../references.html#ref-WSTX" class="source-ref">WSTXV01P047B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aslam b. Sahl al-Wāsiṭī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh al-wāsiṭ</span>, vol. 1 p. 47) as Nubayshah b. Ḥabīb al-Hudhalī; <a href="../references.html#ref-NYMX" class="source-ref">NYMXV05P2702B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Abū Nuʿaym</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Maʿrifat al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 5 p. 2702) gives it as Nubayshah al-Khayr al-Hudhalī, Ibn ʿAbd Allāh b. Shaybān b. ʿAttāb b. al-Ḥārith b. Ḥuṣayn b. al-Ḥārith b. ʿAbd al-ʿUzzā b. Wāʾil b. Layḥān b. Hudhayl, and his kunyā as Abū Ṭarīf. Almost all say he was a companion who settled in Baṣrah. He was also widely described as the nephew of Salamah b. al-Muḥabbaq. No date of death is given in the sources.
[^comment-HBHXV18P337A-1]: This passage is similar to that found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P603C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 603).
[^comment-KTHBV07P346A-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Placement is based on content. There appears to be confusion on the name of Aḥmad b. Ayyūb, rendering it as Aḥmad b. Yaʿqūb. This passage recounts much of what is mentioned below but includes transition material.
[^comment-HBFXV02P579A-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Placement is based on reference to ʿAlī’s expedition to Yemen and the criticism he received for his management of the affair. Also found in <a href="WAHJK.html" class="witness-link">WAHJK</a> (ʿAmr b. Hāshim (or Hishām) Abū Mālik al-Junubī al-Kūfī), <a href="WSAAS.html" class="witness-link">WSAAS</a> (Ṣāliḥ b. Abī al-Aswad), <a href="WMAAK.html" class="witness-link">WMAAK</a> (Mandal (ʿAmr) b. ʿAlī al-ʿAnzī al-Kūfī), <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī), <a href="WMSJK.html" class="witness-link">WMSJK</a> (Masʿūd b. Saʿd al-Juʿfī al-Kūfī), <a href="WMKHW.html" class="witness-link">WMKHW</a> (Muḥammad b. Khālid al-Wahbī), <a href="WABRM.html" class="witness-link">WABRM</a> (ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Maghrāʾ b. ʿIyāḍ al-Dawsī al-Rāzī al-Kūfī), and <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī).
[^comment-ZTKXV01P376A-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-ZTKX" class="source-ref">ZTKXV01P376A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Khaythamah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Tārīkh al-kabīr sifr al-thānī</span>, vol. 1 p. 376) refers to similar passages witnessed by <a href="WMSJK.html" class="witness-link">WMSJK</a> (Masʿūd b. Saʿd al-Juʿfī al-Kūfī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-ZTKX" class="source-ref">ZTKXV01P375C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Khaythamah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Tārīkh al-kabīr sifr al-thānī</span>, vol. 1 p. 375).
[^comment-HBHXV04P192A-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. See <a href="../references.html#ref-RWDX" class="source-ref">RWDXV07P502A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. ʿAbd Allāh Suhaylī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Rawḍ al-unuf fī sharḥ al-Sīrah al-Nabawīyah li-Ibn Hishām</span>, vol. 7 p. 502) and <a href="../references.html#ref-TBRC" class="source-ref">TBRCV03P148A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Ṭabarī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh al-rusul waʾl-mulūk</span>, vol. 3 p. 148) who place similar traditons in the context of the farwell pilgrimage.
[^comment-BKHSV03P002A-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-BKHS" class="source-ref">BKHSV03P002A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Muḥammad b. Ismāʿīl b. Ibrāhīm al-Bukhārī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī</span>, vol. 3 p. 2) not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Placement provisional due to content.
[^comment-HBHXV10P280B-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-HBHX" class="source-ref">HBHXV10P280B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Ḥanbal</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad</span>, vol. 10 p. 280) is not in the redaction of Ibn Hishām but covers analogous content as <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P605A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 605) to p. 606A.
[^comment-HBHXV27P318A-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-HBHX" class="source-ref">HBHXV27P318A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Ḥanbal</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad</span>, vol. 27 p. 318) is not in the redaction of Ibn Hishām but covers analogous content as Ibn Hishām, vol. 2, 605-6A. The scene is set at the <em>masjid</em> of al-Khayf at Mīnah. The evaluative comment at the end of <a href="../references.html#ref-HBHX" class="source-ref">HBHXV27P318A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Ḥanbal</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad</span>, vol. 27 p. 318) and on <a href="../references.html#ref-HBHX" class="source-ref">HBHXV27P319A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Ḥanbal</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad</span>, vol. 27 p. 319) is also found in <a href="../references.html#ref-MYWX" class="source-ref">MYWXV13P408A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Abū Yaʿlā Aḥmad b. ʿAlī al-Mawṣilī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad</span>, vol. 13 p. 408). Similar evaluative traditions are found in the biographies of Maʿbad b. Kaʿb (see <a href="../references.html#ref-HBHX" class="source-ref">HBHXV37P291A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Ḥanbal</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad</span>, vol. 37 p. 291))and Abū Ḥurayrah (see <a href="../references.html#ref-HBHX" class="source-ref">HBHXV15P78A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Ḥanbal</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad</span>, vol. 15 p. 78)).
[^comment-HBHXV36P094A-1]: This passage is found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Placement is based on content.
[^comment-HJTZV01P200A-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Placement approximate due to reference to Muḥammad at ʿArafāt.
[^comment-MYWXV02P497A-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-MYWX" class="source-ref">MYWXV02P497A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Abū Yaʿlā Aḥmad b. ʿAlī al-Mawṣilī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad</span>, vol. 2 p. 497) not mentioned in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. It refers to the practice of duʿāʾ al-istakhārah, or the prayer of seeking counsel. This tradition appears to have been transmitted only by the witness of <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī). Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī is mentioned as an eyewitness by Ibn Isḥāq several times in the redaction of Ibn Hishām (<a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P396D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 396), <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P403D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 403) to <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P406F</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 406) (dealing with the night journey [قصة المعراج]), <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P498C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 498) (conserning the division of spoils after the Battle of Hawāzin), <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P599E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 599) (referring to the counter-prophets Musaylimah and al-ʿAnsī), <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P603C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 603) (in which Muḥammad defends ʿAlī during the Farewell Pilgrimage), and <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P639F</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 639) (concerning the expodition to ʿAlqamah b. Mujazziz). <a href="../references.html#ref-NWMM" class="source-ref">NWMMV07P221A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Nawawī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Al-Majmūʿ sharḥ al-Muhadhdhab</span>, vol. 7 p. 221) places the statement during the Farewell Pilgrimage. <a href="../references.html#ref-IHRB" class="source-ref">IHRBV02P342B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ismāʿīl b. Ḥaqqī b. Muṣṭafā al-Istānbūlī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Rūh al-bayān</span>, vol. 2 p. 342) places the statement after the ʿaṣr prayer on the day of ʿArafah. Placement is based on these statements.

[^comment-SBDAV01P093C-1]: The <em>isnād</em> after Ibn Isḥāq is حدثنا أحمد بن محمد البغدادي حدثنا عبيد الله بن سعد حدثنا عمي حدثني أبي عن. Not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. The context appears to be similar to that found above dealing with the ritual sacrifice on the Fairwell Pilgrimage described in Ibn Hishām, vol. 2, 605-6A. The speaker of the story is Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, who is mentioned in the redaction of Ibn Hishām 13 times. He is one of Ibn Isḥāq&#x27;s primary sources for the Mihraj and was present on the Fairwell Pilgrimage. [^comment-ZTKXV01P111A-1]: A similar quotation is found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P621F</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 621). This fragment refers to the story of how ʿĀʾishah acquired a Jewish slave who the prophet free in exchanged for an enslaved captive from the <em>banū</em> ʿAnbar in the aftermath of the Battle with ʿUyaynah b. Ḥiṣn of the <em>banū</em> ʿAnbar. It is also located in <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-TBRB" class="source-ref">TBRBV03P157B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Ṭabarī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh al-rusul waʾl-mulūk (1967)</span>, vol. 3 p. 157), <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-MDMX" class="source-ref">MDMXV01P610B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Mandah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Maʿrifat al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 1 p. 610) (in a more detailed account) and <a href="../references.html#ref-NYMX" class="source-ref">NYMXV05P2735A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Abū Nuʿaym</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Maʿrifat al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 5 p. 2735). It does not appear to be found elsewhere in the Ibn Isḥāq corpus.
[^comment-ZTKXV01P219C-1]: This fragment is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. al-Suhaylī, in his commentary on Ibn Hishām’s redaction, mentions the passage in a very long comment that begins with the death scene of the prophet. The comment covers a number of topics, including aspects of the Fairwell Pilgrimage not covered in Ibn Isḥāq, the letters send to the kings of foreign lands, and the battles that occurred at the end of Muḥammad’s life and shortly after. It is in a reference to an expedition undertaken by Abū Bakr in which Rāfiʿ b. ʿAmīrah participated. The story of Rāfīʿ and the wolf is mentioned to help identify Rāfīʿ since he wa also known by Rāfīʿ b. Abī Rāfīʿ (see <a href="../references.html#ref-RNXX" class="source-ref">RNXXV07P525C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Suhaylī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Rawḍ al-unuf fī sharḥ al-Sīrah al-Nabawīyah li-Ibn Hishām</span>, vol. 7 p. 525)). He does not attribute the story to Ibn Isḥāq. The name Rāfīʿ b. ʿAmīrah al-Ṭāʾī is only mentioned once in the redaction of Ibn Hishām, on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P623B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 623), which is an account of the raid on the Dhāt al-Salāsil, led by Abū Bakr. In the story, Rāfiʿ b. ʿAmīrah tells the story of how, before converting from Christianity, he used to hide ostrich eggs of water in the desert. The story does not include the account of his conversion, which is found in the above account. Rāfīʿ b. Abī Rāfīʿ is mentioned three times in the redaction of Ibn Hishām: <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P515A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 515) as one of the Jewish opponents to Muḥammad, ibid. vol. 1, 550C as a part of the delegation of Jews who questioned Muḥammad on the change of <em>qiblah</em>, and in the above account of the story of the wolf. Since the Rāfīʿ in the present story converted from Christianity, the other Rāfīʿ b. Abī Rāfīʿ cannot be the same person. An interesting note: in the Dhāt al-Salāsil story ʿRāfīʿ b. ʿAmīrah states that his Christian name was Sarjas, but how he acquired not only the name “Rāfīʿ b. ʿAmīrah” but his genealogical name is not mentioned. Ibn al-Athīr mentions the wolf story in his biographical entry for Rāfrīʿ b. ʿAmīrah, but, quoting Ibn al-Kalbī, gives his name as Rāfīʿ b. ʿAmīrah b. Ḥārithah b. ʿAmr. He states that he served as guide for Khālid b. al-Walīd during the invasion of Iraq and Syria. He died in 23 during the caliphate of ʿUmar (<a href="../references.html#ref-THRX" class="source-ref">THRXV02P241A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn al-Athīr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Usd al-ghābah fī maʿrifat al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 2 p. 241)). Unwitnessed versions are also found in <a href="../references.html#ref-BRSX" class="source-ref">BRSXV02P483A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Istīʿāb fī maʿrifat al-aṣḥāb</span>, vol. 2 p. 483), ibid., vol. 2, 639C, <a href="../references.html#ref-THRX" class="source-ref">THRXV02P241A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn al-Athīr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Usd al-ghābah fī maʿrifat al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 2 p. 241), <a href="../references.html#ref-KHLW" class="source-ref">KHLWV14P048H</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Khalīl b. Aybak al-Ṣafadī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Wāfī bi-l-wafiyāt</span>, vol. 14 p. 48), and <a href="../references.html#ref-HJRS" class="source-ref">HJRSV02P367C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Iṣābah fī tamyīz al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 2 p. 367). It does not appear to be found in any witness except <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī). Placement will correspond to <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P623B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 623) and the Raid of Dhāt al-Salāsil.

[^comment-RZZIV03P563A-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Placement approximate due to reference in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P642F</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 642) to the visiting of the graves at the onset of Muḥammad&#x27;s illness. <a href="../references.html#ref-RZZI" class="source-ref">RZZIV03P563A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-ʿIlal</span>, vol. 3 p. 563) is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. <a href="../references.html#ref-THRX" class="source-ref">THRXV02P270A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn al-Athīr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Usd al-ghābah fī maʿrifat al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 2 p. 270) places the passage in the biography of Rabīʿah b. Mālik al-Anṣārī but does not provide a witness. The passages states: روى ابن اسحاق عن محمد بن خالد الأنصاري عن أبي أسيد واسمه ربيعه بن مالك قال خرج رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ذات يوم إلى بقيع الغرقد فإذا الذئب مفترش ذراعيه فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم هذا أويس يستطعم قالوا رأيك يا رسول الله قال من كل سائمة عشرة قالوا كثير يا رسول الله فقال له رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وأشار بيده أن خالسهم. As seems common when attributing a <em>matn</em> to two different <em>asānid</em>, it is not possible to know if the tradition attributed to the witness of Ibn Saʿd is the same as that attributed to Muḥammad b. Salamah. <a href="../references.html#ref-BQWX" class="source-ref">BQWXV06P040B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Bayhaqī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Dalāʾil al-nubūwah wa maʿarifah aḥwāl ṣāḥib al-sharīʿah</span>, vol. 6 p. 40) mentions this tradition but with Muḥammad b. Salamah as the witness. It states: أخبرنا الحسين بن الفضل أنبأنا عبد الله بن جعفر حدثنا يعقوب بن سفيان حدثنا محمد بن وهب بن عمر بن أبي كريمة حدثنا محمد بن سلمة عن محمد بن اسحاق عن الزهري عن حمزة بن أبي أسيد قال خرج رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم في جنازة رجل من الأنصار بالبقيع فإذا الذئب مفترشا ذراعيه على الطريق فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم هذا أويس يستفرض فافرضوا له قالوا نرى رأيك يا رسول الله قال من كل سائمة شاة في كل عام قالوا كثير قال فأشار إلى الذئب أن خالسهم فانطلق الذئب. According to <a href="../references.html#ref-QZHX" class="source-ref">QZHXV05P235A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Maqrīzī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Imtāʿ al-asmāʿ bi-mā li-l-nabī min al-aḥwāl waʾl-amwāl waʾl-hafadat waʾl-mutāʿ</span>, vol. 5 p. 235), this passage was related by al-Bayhaqī and Abū Nuʿaym but witholut a witness. It states: فخرج أبو نعيم والبيهقي من حديث محمد بن اسحاق عن الزهري عن محمد بن خالد الأنصاري عن حمزة بن أبي أسيد الأنصاري قال خرج رسول اللَّه صلّى اللَّه عليه وسلّم في جنازة رجل من الأنصار إلى البقيع فإذا الذئب مفترش ذراعيه على الطريق فقال رسول اللَّه صلّى اللَّه عليه وسلّم هذا أويس يستفرض فأفرضوا له قالوا رأيك يا رسول اللَّه قال من كل سائمة شاة في كل عام قالوا كثير فأشار إليه أن خالسهم فانطلق الذئب.

[^comment-BRSXV01P398A-1]: These passages are not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Sinān b. Abī Sinān al-Dūʾlī is rarely mentioned in <em>asānid</em> for Ibn Isḥāq. There are two people mentioned in the redaction of Ibn Hishām with this name: Sinān b. Abī Sinān b. Miḥṣanas, who was a participant at Badr among the Meccan submitters (<a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P679E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 679), also see <a href="../references.html#ref-NYMX" class="source-ref">NYMXV03P1428A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Abū Nuʿaym</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Maʿrifat al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 3 p. 1428) for the witness of <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī)), According to <a href="../references.html#ref-TKXX" class="source-ref">TKXXV03P069B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Saʿd</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Ṭabaqāt al-kubrā</span>, vol. 3 p. 69) he died in 32/651-2. This could not be the individual mentioned in the <em>isnād</em>. There is also an individual by this name listed in the <em>isnād</em> of a tradition also found in <a href="WHSDB.html" class="witness-link">WHSDB</a> (Ḥammād b. Salamah b. Dīnār al-Baṣrī), <a href="WJHZA.html" class="witness-link">WJHZA</a> (Jarīr b. Ḥāzim b. Zayd b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Shajāʿ al-Azdī al-ʿAtkī al-Baṣrī), <a href="WZAZA.html" class="witness-link">WZAZA</a> (Zakarīyā b. Abī Zāʾidah), <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī), and <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī). <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) places it in the context of the Battle of Ḥunayn (See <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P442C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 442)). <a href="../references.html#ref-TKXX" class="source-ref">TKXXV05P193C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Saʿd</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Ṭabaqāt al-kubrā</span>, vol. 5 p. 193) lists a Sinān b. Abī Sinān al-Daʾilī (not al-Dūʾlī) who died in 105/723 at the age of 82. He is noted as relating to al-Zuhrī, although he only related a few traditions. Al-Ḥusayn b. Abī Ṭālib was killed in 680, when Sinān b. Abī Sinān would have been around 19 years of age. Given that al-Ḥusayn was born only in 626 or 627, the statement, if heard by al-Ḥusayn, could only have occurred in the last year or so of the prophet&#x27;s life. Placement is based on similar types of material found in death scenes.
[^comment-BQRXV01P208B-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. This refers to an event apparently late in Muḥammad&#x27;s life when it became difficult for him to complete the recitation of the prayer. It is also found in the witnesses of <a href="WWAAA.html" class="witness-link">WWAAA</a> (al-Waḍāḥ b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Yashkarī al-Wāsiṭī al-Bazzāz), <a href="WASKA.html" class="witness-link">WASKA</a> (ʿAbdah (ʿAbd al-Raḥmān) b. Sulaymān al-Kilābī al-Kūfī), <a href="WISUL.html" class="witness-link">WISUL</a> (Ismāʿīl b. ʿUlayah), <a href="WMSAH.html" class="witness-link">WMSAH</a> (Muḥammad b. Salamah b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Bāhilī al-Ḥarrānī), <a href="WAKMW.html" class="witness-link">WAKMW</a> (Aḥmad b. Khālid b. Mūsā al-Wahbī al-Kindī) and WAYA but the list of witnesses is somewhat different. The eyewitness to the event is listed as ʿUbādah b. al-Ṣāmit (see <a href="../references.html#ref-BYTX" class="source-ref">BYTXV01P131A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Muḥammad b. Ibrāhīm al-Thaʿlabī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Al-Kashf waʾl-bayān ʿan tafsīr al-Qurʾān</span>, vol. 1 p. 131)). Although the passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām, and due to content and apparent reference to the weakness of Muḥammad and to prayer, it is placed here in relation to discussion of prayer in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P650A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 650).

Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 353) (at the end of the story of the division of spoils after Khaybar), but uses a different <em>isnād</em> citing ʿUbayd Allāh b. ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUtbah as the eyewitness (this passage also found in <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī)).
[^comment-ZZBXV15P040D-1]: This passage appears to be the only instance of it in the Ibn Isḥāq corpus. It is a saying about the excesses or injustice of the wealthy and is placed in the prophet’s ādāb section. It is part of a genre of sayings that deal with injustice. For other injustice passages, see <a href="WAKMW.html" class="witness-link">WAKMW</a> (Aḥmad b. Khālid b. Mūsā al-Wahbī al-Kindī) <a href="../references.html#ref-IHMA" class="source-ref">IHMAV06P475C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Ḥāzim</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Muḥallā bil-Āthār</span>, vol. 6 p. 475). For other <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī) <a href="../references.html#ref-SBAN" class="source-ref">SBANV02P375B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Abū al-Shaykh al-Iṣbahānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Akhlāq al-Nabī wa-ādābuhu</span>, vol. 2 p. 375) (as an example).
[^comment-ZZBXV15P041B-1]: This passage is not located in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. It is a type of ādāb passage that is not a fiqhic sunnah but more typical of &quot;sayings.&quot; It is a sub-genre dealing with camels, in this case weak camels. Also see <a href="WAKMW.html" class="witness-link">WAKMW</a> (Aḥmad b. Khālid b. Mūsā al-Wahbī al-Kindī) <a href="../references.html#ref-BKAM" class="source-ref">BKAMV01P277G</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Muḥammad b. Ismāʿīl b. Ibrāhīm al-Bukhārī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Adab al-mufrad</span>, vol. 1 p. 277), <a href="../references.html#ref-THQX" class="source-ref">THQXV02P306C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Muḥammad al-Ṭaḥāwī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Aḥkām al-Qurʾān al-karīm</span>, vol. 2 p. 306), <a href="../references.html#ref-THSM" class="source-ref">THSMV02P160E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Muḥammad al-Ṭaḥāwī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Sharḥ maʿānī al-āthār</span>, vol. 2 p. 160), and <a href="../references.html#ref-HJRT" class="source-ref">HJRTV15P622A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Itḥāf al-maharah bi-al-fawāʾid al-mubtakarah min aṭrāf al-ʿasharah</span>, vol. 15 p. 622), as well as <a href="WABAB.html" class="witness-link">WABAB</a> (ʿAbd al-Aʿlā b. ʿAbd al-Aʿlā al-Shāmī al-Baṣrī) <a href="../references.html#ref-MZMF" class="source-ref">MZMFV01P083B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Mizzī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Muntaqā min al-fawāʾid al-ḥisān fī al-ḥadīth</span>, vol. 1 p. 83) and <a href="WSYSL.html" class="witness-link">WSYSL</a> (Saʿdān Saʿīd b. Yaḥyā b. Ṣāliḥ al-Lakhmī al-Kūfī) <a href="../references.html#ref-TDSH" class="source-ref">TDSHV52P346C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn ʿAsākir</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh madīnat Dimashq</span>, vol. 52 p. 346).
[^comment-JJKXV07P268B-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Placement is based on content. Establishes the sunnah of the prophet.
[^comment-SMJXV02P1199A-1]: This quotation is not in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Placement approximate based on content (physical description of Muḥammad) commonly placed after death scenes. Placement approximate based on content dealing with Muḥammad&#x27;s hairstyle.

Idris, see <a href="../references.html#ref-ZTKX" class="source-ref">ZTKXV02P921A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Khaythamah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Tārīkh al-kabīr sifr al-thānī</span>, vol. 2 p. 921).

Ḥanbal</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Faḍāʾil al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 2 p. 629), <a href="../references.html#ref-HBFX" class="source-ref">HBFXV02P725A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Ḥanbal</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Faḍāʾil al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 2 p. 725), <a href="../references.html#ref-KTMX" class="source-ref">KTMXV01P108A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿUmar b. Shabbah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Kitāb taʾrīkh al-Madīnah al-munawwarah</span>, vol. 1 p. 108), <a href="../references.html#ref-DLNX" class="source-ref">DLNXV01P112A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Muḥammad b. Aḥmad b. Ḥammād al-Dawlābī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Dhurīyat al-ṭāhirat al-nabawīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 112), <a href="../references.html#ref-MJSX" class="source-ref">MJSXV01P150A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Muḥammad b. ʿAmr b. al-Bakhtarī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Majmūʿ fīhi muṣannafāt</span>, vol. 1 p. 150), <a href="../references.html#ref-NYMX" class="source-ref">NYMXV06P3507A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Abū Nuʿaym</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Maʿrifat al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 6 p. 3507), <a href="../references.html#ref-THRX" class="source-ref">THRXV07P332A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn al-Athīr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Usd al-ghābah fī maʿrifat al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 7 p. 332), and <a href="../references.html#ref-KTHS" class="source-ref">KTHSV04P648A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Kathīr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrat al-nubuwīyah</span>, vol. 4 p. 648) represent one of the most complex sets of traditions in the Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd transmission of Ibn Isḥāq&#x27;s text. The traditions were transmitted by seven people: <a href="WHAYA.html" class="witness-link">WHAYA</a> (Yazīd b. Hārūn al-Wāsiṭī), Muṣʿab b. ʿAbd Allāh, Abū Naḍr Hāshim b. al-Qāsim, Muḥammad b. Jaʿfar al-Warakanī (who, according to Ibn Ḥanbal, transmitted the same tradition as Abū Naḍr), Muḥammad b. Abī Rajāʾ, Yaʿqūb b. Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd, and ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz, with the last two being described as transmitting the same tradition. NOTE: The traditions in this group are arranged by transmitter. A tradition touching on the same topic is located in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-STBX" class="source-ref">STBXV22P399D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Ṭabarānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Muʿjam al-kabīr</span>, vol. 22 p. 399). Updated and corrected on 12/07/23.
[^comment-DLNXV01P112A-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-DLNX" class="source-ref">DLNXV01P112A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Muḥammad b. Aḥmad b. Ḥammād al-Dawlābī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Dhurīyat al-ṭāhirat al-nabawīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 112) transmitted by and , tends to be most similar to <a href="../references.html#ref-KTMX" class="source-ref">KTMXV01P108A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿUmar b. Shabbah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Kitāb taʾrīkh al-Madīnah al-munawwarah</span>, vol. 1 p. 108) transmitted by but the latter is much shorter with fewer details and does not mention ʿAlī.

A similar tradition is located in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-BGHX" class="source-ref">BGHXV03P452E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Baghawī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Muʿjam al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 3 p. 452).
[^comment-DKHXV01P379A-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. This is a comparative passage rating the greatness of the Caliphs following Muḥammad. It appears to be the only occurance in the Ibn Isḥāq corpus. Placement is based on the type of statement usually found after the death of an individual. Notice that ʿAlī b. Abī Ṭālib is not mentioned. Placement is in each individual&#x27;s &quot;attributes&quot; following their deaths
[^comment-DHRQV01P046A-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Placement provisional based on content suggesting this occured immediately after Abū Bakr&#x27;s death
[^comment-TDSHV09P178B-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. The Battle of ʿAyn al-Tamr is covered extensively in <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī).
[^comment-NYMXV03P1188A-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. In biography for Zayd b. Surāqah b. Kaʿb. referring to his death at the Battle of the Bridge (yawm al-jisr) on the Euphrates river against Sasanian forces in 14 (October, 634), see <a href="../references.html#ref-TBRB" class="source-ref">TBRBV03P442S</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Ṭabarī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh al-rusul waʾl-mulūk (1967)</span>, vol. 3 p. 442). For other references to the Battle of the Bridge see <a href="WMSAH.html" class="witness-link">WMSAH</a> (Muḥammad b. Salamah b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Bāhilī al-Ḥarrānī) and <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī).
[^comment-DRQMV01P376A-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. This refers to the Battle of the Bridge (yawm al-jisr) on the Euphrates river against Sasanian forces in 14 (October, 634), see <a href="../references.html#ref-TBRB" class="source-ref">TBRBV03P442S</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Ṭabarī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh al-rusul waʾl-mulūk (1967)</span>, vol. 3 p. 442).
[^comment-BRTXV01P037A-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. <a href="../references.html#ref-BRTX" class="source-ref">BRTXV01P037A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Abū al-ʿAbbās Aḥmad b. Muḥammad al-Birtī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. ʿAwf : riwāyat Abī Sahl Aḥmad b. Muḥammad b. The passage, according to <a href="../references.html#ref-TBRB" class="source-ref">TBRBV04P058B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Ṭabarī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh al-rusul waʾl-mulūk (1967)</span>, vol. 4 p. 58) refers to ʿUmar’s invasion of Syria, at the village of Sargh, in 17/638. Similar accounts of the event are found in <a href="WBSAB.html" class="witness-link">WBSAB</a> (Bakr b. Sulaymān al-Aswārī al-Baṣrī) and <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī).
[^comment-ZTKXV01P298A-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Placement is based on content.

[^comment-HBHXV07P394A-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Placement is based on content. <a href="../references.html#ref-TBRB" class="source-ref">TBRBV04P145A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Ṭabarī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh al-rusul waʾl-mulūk (1967)</span>, vol. 4 p. 145) places the appointment of ʿAmmār b. Yasār and ʿAbd Allāh b. Masʿūd in 21, near the end of his life.
[^comment-KTMXV03P879A-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām or al-Ṭabarī’s Taʾrīkh. <a href="../references.html#ref-KTMX" class="source-ref">KTMXV03P879A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿUmar b. Shabbah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Kitāb taʾrīkh al-Madīnah al-munawwarah</span>, vol. 3 p. 879) is set in the context of the Caliphate of ʿUmar in which he and Ibn al-ʿAbbās discuss succession after his death. <a href="../references.html#ref-BRSX" class="source-ref">BRSXV03P1119A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Istīʿāb fī maʿrifat al-aṣḥāb</span>, vol. 3 p. 1119) expands on this by listing each of the members of the council ʿUmar would appoint just before his death. The context indicates that the discussion should be placed just prior to ʿUmar&#x27;s death.
[^comment-RWTXV02P895A-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Placement is based on content. Passage refers to the stabbing of ʿUmar b. al-Khaṭṭāb. The story is witnessed by <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) (<a href="../references.html#ref-TMMX" class="source-ref">TMMXV01P067A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Muḥammad b. Aḥmad al-Tamīmī al-Maghribī al-Ifrīrī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Miḥan</span>, vol. 1 p. 67), <a href="../references.html#ref-TMMX" class="source-ref">TMMXV01P067B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Muḥammad b. Aḥmad al-Tamīmī al-Maghribī al-Ifrīrī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Miḥan</span>, vol. 1 p. 67),<a href="../references.html#ref-TMMX" class="source-ref">TMMXV01P069B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Muḥammad b. Aḥmad al-Tamīmī al-Maghribī al-Ifrīrī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Miḥan</span>, vol. 1 p. 69)) but not mentiond in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. His date of death is also discussed in <a href="WYSAU.html" class="witness-link">WYSAU</a> (Yaḥyā b. Saʿīd b. Abān al-Qurashī al-Umawī al-Kūfī) (which he dates to 23AH). These appear to be the only instances in the corpus.
[^comment-BKHBV07P314A-1]: Passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Qurʾān 109:001 is discussed in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P362B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 362) in the context of Abū Jahl’s harassment of Muḥammad. This passage refers to the ʿUmar and his practices when on the pilgrimage he changed the recitation of the morning prayer. Placment is after the death of ʿUmar in texts that often give details of the characteristics of a person after their death. Also see <a href="WYWAT.html" class="witness-link">WYWAT</a> (Yaḥyā b. Wāḍiḥ al-Anṣārī Abū Tumaylah).
[^comment-DKHXV01P379A-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. A comparative passage rating the greatness of the Caliphs following Muḥammad. Appears to be the only occurance in the Ibn Isḥāq corpus. Placement is based on the type of statement usually found after the death of an individual. Notice that ʿAlī b. Abī Ṭālib is not mentioned. Placement is in each individual&#x27;s &quot;attributes&quot; following their deaths
[^comment-ZTTHV03P116A-1]: The passage is set during the caliphate of ʿUmar b. al-Khaṭṭāb when he gives a sermon in the Prophet’s <em>masjid</em> in Madīnah about the restrictions on the amount of money women may give in charity. The passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām or elsewhere in the Ibn Isḥāq corpus. Placement will be in the section on the practices of ʿUmar following an account of his death. The source Ibn Isḥāq cites in <a href="../references.html#ref-ZTTH" class="source-ref">ZTTHV03P116A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Khaythamah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Tārīkh al-kabīr al-safar al-thālith</span>, vol. 3 p. 116) is Muḥammad b. al-Mujālid b. Saʿīd, while <a href="../references.html#ref-KHFM" class="source-ref">KHFMV01P370B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Khaṭīb al-Baghdādī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Faqīh waʾl-mutafaqqih</span>, vol. 1 p. 370), <a href="../references.html#ref-IQSI" class="source-ref">IQSIV01P147A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn al-Qaysarānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Iṭrạf al-gharāʾib waʾl-afrād min ḥadīth Rasūl Allāh</span>, vol. 1 p. 147), <a href="../references.html#ref-ZYTX" class="source-ref">ZYTXV01P296D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd Allāh b. Yūsuf b. Muḥammad al-Zaylaʿī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Takhrīj al-aḥādīth waʾl-āthār al-wāqiʿah fī tafsīr</span>, vol. 1 p. 296), <a href="../references.html#ref-KTHQ" class="source-ref">KTHQV02P243C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Kathīr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Tafsīr al-Qurʾān al-ʿAẓīm</span>, vol. 2 p. 243), and <a href="../references.html#ref-HYMX" class="source-ref">HYMXV02P334B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Nūr al-Dīn ʿAlī b. Abī Bakr Haythamī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Maqṣid al-ʿalī fī zawāʾid Abī Yaʿlā al-Mawṣilī</span>, vol. 2 p. 334) list him not as the primary source to Ibn Isḥāq but as the secondary source via Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Saʿīd to Ibn Isḥāq. Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Saʿīd ia only listed twice in the Shamela corpus (as of 01/21/24), both in this complex of traditions. The name &quot;Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān&quot; is too common to locate his identity. Al-Mujālid b. Saʿīd is sometimes listed as Mujālid b. Saʿīd. According to Muḥammad b.
